description:
Specialising in a diverse range of limited company structures and address services, QCF provides expert help and advice to new and established business owners in the UK. 
Whether you want to set up a private limited company with one or more share classes, a bespoke limited by guarantee company, a charity company, an LLP, a property company, or a PLC – we have something here to suit your needs.

records.title: Registered address not compliant with legal obligations
records.text: The company was incorporated in 24 hours and the price is very convenient. I opted for the "privacy plus package" to avoid displaying my public address.On their website, on the page about "registered office address" it is written "Companies and LLPs must make their statutory records available for public inspection at their registered office" but when I asked if my online documents were available in case of an inspection, I was told that they don't offer this service. I have to opt for a SAIL address instead and pay extra money.What's the point in providing a registered address if that doesn't satisfy the legal obligations for a registered address?Disappointed.

records.title: Good, efficient, but ultimately sketchy
records.text: They did great and I was about to rate them 5 stars when I realized that they will withhold your credit card information without your consent and without any option to delete it. When asked about it, they categorically refuse to let you delete card information once it's entered on the site. I simply wanted the option to do my renewing manually, and they will simply not allow that. I don't really think this is legal, so I'm probably going to move away to another more ethical service provider.

records.title: Great company registration service, not so good with other services.
records.text: Dear All, as a business consultant and mediator focused on time efficiency and lean processes, I am really happy to confirm that Quality Company Formations has got my 5 stars. I registered in few simple steps my company. The assistance before the registration was great, and people were well trained; ready to answer to my questions. The customer service reply to your emails inquiry in few minutes. The ID verification was easy with the APP. It means saving time at the Local Post office, avoiding queuing - meeting people, and paying at least 15pounds at the post office. The price for a LTD is cheaper comparing to other suppliers. in the complete package you get the VAT registration; Furthermore of aforementioned the partnership with payment systems (POS), or Mettle in order to open a bank account, it really simplify a lot the process of Starting a new business. There are other options like insurance, etc..Good Luck with your new business.After registering my company, I ordered the certificate of good standing the 30/12/2020 and I never received it. I was in touch with the customer support several times now, and i was told that it was a busy period. I was refunded by 60pounds, and I would have get the free certificate of good standing. today 4th march 2021, I haven't got my certificate of good standing. My brother registered his company the same day 30/12/2020, and he got the certificate of good standing after 7 days.-----------lat update 10/03/2021I got my certificate of Good Standing. I sent emails and I had a chat with Quality formation staff in January and February.

records.title: We were very disappointed in the…
records.text: We were very disappointed in the service that we received.We completed all the information required in order to set up the company and as far as we were concerned on completing the information the company had been setup.However, after four weeks our client contacted us to enquire as to where we were with the incorporation.We hadn't received anything from Quality Company formations and so we contacted them.If fact the company had not been setup and because they were apparently waiting for information to verify the director of our company.This was the first we knew that they required this information but apparently they called and left a message about this (a message then we never received).They then didn't chase up this information as any point and we will be luck not to lose this client as it reflects very badly on our company.Once they had the information they required everything was OK but the customer service before that was poor.

records.title: Not for foreigners
records.text: My experience has been unsatisfactory because of delays (two weeks for company formation of the simplest sort) and support (see below).On a personal level, I minded a suspicious, inflexible attitude to foreigners declaring their address.As a London resident I could register ok, i.e., I didn't have to submit any document.But my partner is a resident of Italy and has been bombarded by requests to prove his residential address with documents.Since the city he lives in had re-assigned street numbers, the utility bills did not match, and this provoked an increasingly stiff e-mail exchange.Also, they want to see recent utility bills (fair enough) but don't accept that in some countries the billing cycle might be longer than one month, eg., quarterly; such bills were refused.In the end we were lucky that my partner had recently purchased a new car and the address was in the certificate, so they had to accept it.Furthermore, even though we were assigned to one admin person, the person actually answering our messages kept changing, apparently because of summer vacations.So in the end we were corresponding daily with a team of at least three people, which added to confusion.I even tried phoning in to see whether we could discuss the issue and find out a solution but the person who answered was frank in saying that you could get help only from the people working on your case, who unfortuately had all left for the day, or were on vacation.

description:
Rapid Formations is a leading provider of online company formation in the UK. We offer various company formation packages; setting up companies limited by shares, limited by guarantee and limited liability partnerships.


We also offer registered office, service address and business address services from our prestigious locations in Covent Garden, London and Glasgow city centre, at very competitive rates.


If you have any questions you can contact us by telephone, e-mail or online chat, and a member of our highly knowledgeable team will be happy to assist you.

Previous experience with Portfolio has been pretty poor also; approaching line managers literally after hanging up the phone when during that call they were asked not to, and this has happened on a number of occasions also.

records.title: Harassing staff member
records.text: I applied for a role through Portfolio Payroll and consequently had a call from James in the temp side. Within the first 10mins I was told I was basically being paid too much for my skills (awful way to start a rapport FYI), then insisted I interview for a role paying 5k less and outside of London, I accepted the interview because I needed a job but mentioned I needed an afternoon slot due to my nephew which seemed ok.The next day I was asked to have a pre-interview with James (seemed pointless but hey) who didn’t even call at the agreed time and instead emailed to say he was “in a meeting” and wanted to call the morning after instead. The day of my interview arrived and despite having said I needed the morning free I had almost 30 missed calls from him and multiple WhatsApp’s? It turned me off portfolio payroll as a whole and I had to block his phone number.Rosie who I have been in contact with Also seemed professional however.

description:
Companies MadeSimple is the leading Companies House authorised company formation agent. Specialising in the registration of limited companies and LLPs, we’ve incorporated over 1 million companies since 2002.
We offer various business services including address services from our Central London location, like Registered Office, Directors Service Address and Mail Forwarding.
We would be happy to assist you if you have any questions please call or email us.

Register your company online
You can set up your company in just 4 simple steps with Companies MadeSimple

Check if the company name you want is available
Choose a company formation package that best suits your needs
Purchase the package
Complete the details that are necessary to register your company.

Affordable Incorporation Packages
We offer cost-effective company incorporation packages to suit the needs of all business owners. View our Package Comparison Matrix on the website to see what’s included in each and find the one most suitable for you.
Registered Office Address Service


Use our address, 20-22 Wenlock Road, London, N1 7GU as your company’s registered office (official and legally required) address. Service charge paid annually.

Directors Service Address
Use this service to protect your director(s) residential address(es) from being publicly listed on the Companies House register.

Mail Forwarding
Receive letters and parcels for your company at our London office address. Choose to have mail forwarded, scanned or you can even collect from our office.

records.title: Abhorrent during a crisis
records.text: Zilch has been amazing so far, however during a personal crisis they are abhorrent. My child was in and out of hospital for two months due to a severe burst appendix and complications that arose because of this. She was admitted for emergency major surgery in September and was admitted again in October due to complications, along with multiple appointments in-between and appointments since. She was finally discharged from hospital care two weeks ago. During this time my finances were a bit of a mess and I had to ask Zilch to put my account on hold. Which they did. I was told as soon as my balance was completely cleared, I would be able to use my account again. My account is completely cleared, earlier than the time frame Zilch allocated me, and I have been told that I cannot use my account because they need to 'review my circumstances'. So I am facing scrutiny because my child, quite literally, almost died. So Zilch are great until you face a personal circumstance and then they add nothing but psychological distress to an already stressful time.

records.text: I truly regret getting in touch with this company. There behaviour has been to the point of harassment. I wanted a quote for the transcription of the coroner's verdict from an inquest. The quote was £100 for 14 minutes of audio which was significantly higher than other companies, so I declined their services. Although I have told them this verbally, they have called me more than once, sent several emails and I simply cannot get rid of them. I have more pressing matters to deal with and just want to be left alone but will these people give up no. I have indicated that should they continue to contact me I will hand the matter over to my solicitors and told they would not contact me further. However, this afternoon, I returned home to another message. Enough. I will talk to my solicitors tomorrow and will pursue them for the cost.An UPDATE 18/03/2020Wow. A simple apology and sorry we got it wrong would have been enough, but instead you have decided to craft a narrative which is inaccurate, so let’s get the facts out there shall we. I have two audio recordings from an inquest, a total of 60 minutes. The first was the main hearing conducted by HM Coroner which goes through the key facts including a medical cause of death, hanging and a second shorter recording which is the verdict, subject committed suicide. Your first quote for the 60 minutes was £175 + VAT. Having listen to the recordings and consulted my solicitors, it was decided that the contents of the main hearing would be too distressing for any reader and agreed only the transcription of the verdict was necessary. The verdict portion of the recording is 14 minutes for which you quoted £75 + VAT. If this is change you are talking about, ok. I declined which I believe is my right to do. Dictate2us call me several times on my mobile and land line and sent emails from 4 different people. Fed up, I asked not to be contacted further. Yet low and behold, I received an email on 17 March 2020. It is only after this that I made Trust Pilot entry. I then received a further  unsolicited call to my home in the late evening of 17 March 2020 which my husband answered. There was even a suggestion that I had not sent an email asking not to be contacted and it must have gone to spam. When I did present the email which clearly shows that this was not only communicated to Dictate2us but actually responded to, you change tack with this response.

However having paid for the Executive Incorporation package I was dissapointed that hard copy mem and arts. cert of incorporation and hard copy company registry did not arrive until I prompted Company Wizard. records.title: Significant Control…

The wizard has given Cos House the information without reference to me and it is incorrect. I cannot amend this online and so am having to write to Cos Hse to correct the register.

records.title: Easy to purchase but difficult to…
records.text: Easy to purchase but difficult to contact the number they provide for help I call them few times for help but they didn't answer the call.All you have to do it yourself don't wait for them to help because they're not answering any call therefore I giving them 3***

records.title: Happy enough but much slower than…
records.text: Happy enough but much slower than expected...I was using The Company Wizard to incorporate LLP - I filled in everything on Thursday just before midday and expected the incorporation the same day, the next day at the latest.I didn't get an email to say there was an issue with the application but when I logged in to check up on the application - some issue was highlighted. It wasn't clear why it wasn't accepted so I checked everything and submitted it again without changing anything with the application itself. This time the application has gone through to Companies House around midday on Friday and our LLP was eventually incorporated on Monday around 1:00PM.The service is good, but can be clunky for no apparent reason and slower than expected.

records.title: Beware

description:
Putting people at the heart of everything we do, we provide entrepreneurs with the tools, technology and support to build flourishing travel businesses as part of a company that truly cares. 

Unlock a future of unlimited earnings, a better work/life balance and a career you’ll love, by starting your own travel business.

Whatever your experience in travel, or indeed outside of it, with your commitment and motivation, and our continued support and investment in all aspects of your business, with Travel Counsellors it’s truly an award-winning partnership.

records.title: No pressure and tremendous support
records.text: I am still in the process of completing my six months training, however the recruitment process and onboarding so far has been brilliant. Julia Speed was really helpful, honest and friendly , whilst ensuring I took my time to make the decision to start my new business.  Kristina and Josie have been fantastically patient and knowledgeable throughout the induction training and I'm so pleased I made the leap to join this franchise.

records.title: Lovely people and a seamless transition
records.text: I was given a lot of support and afforded a lot of patience as my process of becoming a TC was likely longer than usual. Overall though, the onboarding process was seamless and I now feel that I couldn’t have joined a better company as a franchise business owner - it feels truly like home. Big thanks to Julia Speed, Kristina Seed and Josie Sailor who were all amazing and a played a huge part in helping me to join Travel Counsellors.

records.title: Fantastic experience so far!
records.text: I am still undergoing the initial 6 months training programme but so far have found the head office team and local TCs a pleasure to work with. Everyone is more than happy to help. My initial conversations prior to signing up were great. Ashley was happy to answer all of my queries and made me feel extremely comfortable - no question was too silly!

records.title: Best decision I've ever made
records.text: The onboarding experience has been amazing with TC. The tools they have and the care and attention they take to make sure you feel confident when you launch your own business

records.title: I had been out of the Travel Industry…
records.text: I had been out of the Travel Industry for several years when I decided to re kindle my passion for travel, I thoroughly researched several companies and eventually settled on Travel Counsellors as they had been in the business for 30 years and came across as a very professional company. Now 2 months in I can wholeheartedly say what a wonderful company I have chosen, everybody is so friendly, nothing is too much trouble and I have made many friends for life. Even though I work from home running my own business I am never alone. So if you are thinking of joining Travel Counsellors - do it - you really won't be sorry!

records.title: Training and becoming a TC
records.text: I'd been looking for a career that would provide me with the flexibility to work and travel and with TC I believe I have found it. The on-boarding process was thorough, friendly and very accommodating of my situation and travel needs; a great help to me!Looking forward to what 2025 brings in this new career.

records.title: Fantastic training and intro to TC
records.text: I have thoroughly enjoyed the training, the training team are so supportive, super quick responses on any issues you have and have provided a very positive, upbeat environment to ensure you succeed. The feeling of the TC community shines through and I’m excited to start my journey with travel counsellors.

records.title: Discovering Travel Counsellors
records.text: The discovery day at Venus was excellent, very informative and answered many questions.

records.title: I chose Travel Counsellors because they are a family
records.text: I chose Travel Counsellors because of the support and training that they highlighted as part of the signing up process. It most certainly has not disappointed and I love being part of a family. I'm blown away - if you're looking for something in travel you can't go wrong with these guys :)

records.title: Nothing but good experiences
records.text: Joining and training has, so far, been incredible. Regular check-ins, no end of encouragement, quick and accurate answers to my questions and concerns and all round lovely people. Special thanks to Sue L, Kristina S and Dawn B for everything they’ve done.If only I could win a round of Kahoot, then it would be a perfect onboarding!

records.title: Fantastic, and extremely patient trainers!
records.text: The only thing I think that needs discussing in more detail prior to training and equipment being delivered is how we actually work on an individual basis. I encountered issues with not having the right adapters etc for screens, and a conversation with the tech team prior to the laptop being sent could have eradicated quite a lot of stress and unnecessary expense. Some are happy to work just from a laptop, others need additional equipment to function, due to poor sight in my situation. However, I cannot fault the trainers and team overall - all are extremely responsive to concerns/issues, and the trainers (Ben & Josie) are beyond patient and extremely knowledgeable, with many years of industry experience and definitely know their stuff! Would rate the rest of the team as 5*, the slightly lower score only reflects the set-up issues I personally experienced.

records.title: Becoming A Travel Counsellor
records.text: I felt that the process from beginning to end was fantastic. I had heard great things about Travel Counsellors before i joined and these were only confirmed ten times over during the onboarding phase. From the moment our training started i felt like i would never be on my own. The amount of support from head office and my fellow TC's has been great. You'll never look back!

records.title: Although I didn't do my training on an…
records.text: Although I didn't do my training on an Academy level , I do feel that we were thrown in the deep end & there were some areas that we were never told during training. For example, for Maldives it was not mentioned that we were not able to book transfers for non direct contract. I do think that it would be better to be given a "Mentor" that lives closer to where you live.

records.title: I am glad I stepped out
records.text: I joined Travel Counsellors in January and so during the time when there is no one travelling. It has not been time wasted because I have been busy training in areas I am not strong in such as cruises. There is something about owning your own business. Flexible hours and of course selling what you love. The head office has been very good with their inspiring messages. Love the super-duper system. I can't wait till people can travel freely. All systems are in place to help me make a success of my business.

records.title: Induction
records.text: It was a very inspiring and motivating course.  I didn't quite have all the tools by the end of the week but now have galielio up and working and lots more study to do to make a sucess.

records.title: Travel Counsellors have been fantastic…
records.text: Travel Counsellors have been fantastic with their support and the training provided, when launching my franchise. The information is available and gives me the resources to build my database and work on marking activity. The initial training delivered was superb, a week session, delivered virtually and Dawn was great at explaining everything clearly and keeping us engaged. It would have been great to have had more post launch of my business, be it a weekly call or update on how I am doing and providing additional information on how and who to work with to build a quote. However in saying that, the Travel Counsellors community is so supportive, it hasn't taken me long to build friendships within the community and they are so helpful and supportive! Overall, anyone looking to start their own business, regardless of a pandemic, Travel Counsellors have been fantastic.

records.title: Good and kept updated on the process
records.text: To date the onboarding experience has been good although I am still in the middle of it. I have been communicated with regularly and told what has been going on. Sue Law was great, went through everything and was very responsive to any queries.It took a bit longer than expected to get my laptop and also when I was sent info on my mentor with a video to view I was unable to view the video as I haven't got my full log in details yet. Not a huge issue but maybe send the email and link out once people are on induction and have their full details as opposed to people trying to view it without full access. May also be worth sending the email asking for feedback once the core onboarding process is complete.

description:
As one of the most experienced and respected specialists in the business, you can rely on us to help you manage your people and responsibilities more efficiently and effectively. We are a one-stop shop for expert HR, Health & Safety, Consultancy, Software and information tailored to your organisation, your budget and your challenges. 

Our professionally qualified HR consultants are more than just a mine of legal knowledge; their understanding of your business ensures they are always practical and commercially focused.

records.title: Suki Tank five stars.
records.text: Suki Tank went through everything in great detail, was open with his communication and answered any questions I had. All explanations of employment laws were clear and helped me to understand them better. Furthermore I was put at ease as Suki emphasised he is only a call or email away at rectifying any issues I could potentially struggle with.

records.title: Just what I needed!
records.text: As a small independent company Nick Babington has been amazing, understanding and supportive arranging our company with HR and health and safety regulation. Croner assigned me with our own representee Henry Parsons who is lovely, he is here to assist me. This is very reassuring.So far very impressed with Croner and glad I called them for advise.

records.title: Food Management Visit
records.text: Darren was friendly and we had lots of discussion. He was knowledgeable and made everything very easy.

records.title: Nigel Billing saved the day
records.text: Nigel Billing called to find out how we got on after the Health and Safety visit. We explained to Nigel about the reluctance of the landlord to provide the necessary paperwork. Nigel sent an email that we passed on to the landlord and the landlord quickly provided the required risk assessment documents. We really appreciate the proactiveness of the team and their support so far.

records.title: Great service.
records.text: Rebecca Clarke was very friendly, helpful and thorough with her explanations of changes to our policies. It was a pleasure speaking with her.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Muhammad Abbas helped us through a tricky employment issue. At all times, Muhammad was excellent at providing us with clear guidance and led the negotiations, focused on achieving the best outcome for us. Croner and Muhammad are highly recommended.

records.title: Great so far!
records.text: Great so far!A fast and efficient service from Daniel Jervis and Emmie Newton-Hobbs through the sales process and onboarding.  A huge amount of information was shared by Emmie, and introductory meetings were set up all within hours of the contract being signed.  It feels like a great start, and I look forward to working with you in 2025.

records.title: Great onboarding process
records.text: Sophie was extremely helpful and prompt at getting our onboarding completed especially being the end of year which is a busy time for us as a business.

records.title: Great Review Visit
records.text: I have had a great annual review conducted by Mark Plumb, who was extremely supportive and informative. He has given me very clear directions as to what is required for my setting to be compliant with H&S regulations. I look forward to working with the review points. It was extremely helpful to have been refreshed by Mark on Brightsafe, where documents can be found etc. It’s such a valuable app! Many thanks Mark for your visit which was much needed!

records.title: Annual Health & Safety Review
records.text: Carl Bryan conducted our annual Health and safety (H&S) review with Croner recently. The meeting was held via Teams, which worked efficiently since our employees work from home.Carl provided valuable advice and was very supportive throughout the review. He was particularly complimentary about the systems we have in place, which was encouraging and reassuring for the team.

records.title: Jaspreet Johal
records.text: Have to thank Jaspreet Johal( Documentation) who picked up our job at short notice after a hiatus when someone left. She thought about what I wanted and intelligently organised our employment documentation for us in time for our deadline. She kept in touch re progress and  did a thorough, informed and excellent piece of work.

records.title: Onboarding support
records.text: This feedback relates to the support received by Sophie Lawrence, Onboarding Specialist at Croner. She was most kind and respectful and responded to the issues raised. There were a few issues with communication which I did have with her, but she quickly addressed these concerns and we were able to meet and discuss my experience with Croner so far. I would be happy to recommend Croner to others based on the service received from Sophie.

records.title: Annual Health & Safety Review
records.text: Attended our office for annual health and safety review.  Arrived promptly, was very friendly in approach and talked us through what he would be doing.  We are a small site with a few office type risk assessments which were reviewed and brought up to date for us.  Identified a couple of small areas to improve with regards our landlords and documentation but all very much conversational rather than over the top scaremongering.  Only minor issue was with regards booking the review as numerous attempts to change our named contact went

records.title: Documentation review and correction
records.text: Jaspreet took ownership of the issue with our documentation and was understanding and efficient in resolving the problem, following review.

records.title: Health and Safety Audit
records.text: The Health and Safety Audit today went very well. Julie Newell was friendly, approachable, thorough and guided me through all the audits, risk assessments and relevant paperwork required.Good service.

records.title: New member experience
records.text: So far I have had my onboard session with Molly who was very clear and professional when going over our handbook details.  Molly was able to clarify some details I was not sure off which shows her expertise within her field. It is a lot to take on when 1st getting started and I am still waiting on other parts/meetings to go over the rest of what is offered in our contract.

records.title: Thanks Leah
records.text: I spoke with Leah Griffin today, who was very polite and friendly, whilst dealing with me.  Although she was unable to answer my query, she did provide me information that was useful in getting to the answer and said she would follow up with further information after the call.

records.title: Efficient & professional
records.text: The professional on the phone was great - and the information really comprehensive. The only downside was the lack of flexibility of calls being available 'on the hour' which is awkward if you are a working mum and can't get back to your desk till 9.15.

records.title: Nigel was very helpful during his…
records.text: Nigel was very helpful during his visit. Nigel looked at our previous report and we worked through with him offering advice.

records.title: A recent HR exchange with Croner
records.text: A recent HR exchange with CronerThank you Adam Nutting for your prompt, professional help & advice with the recent HR new employee situation we found ourselves in. This was a totally new experience for us and Adam certainly guided us through it. He was always on the end of a telephone conversation or email exchange.

records.title: Great service, prompt & responsive...
records.text: Great service, prompt & responsive...Reason for not 5* - was let down by a clumsy 'Communcation' issue since resolved.We greatly value Croner's support to resolve our issues. They go the extra mile......

records.title: Health and safety audit by Darren
records.text: Thank you to Darren who completed our annual health and safety review today! Very informative and very pleasant Thank you again!!

records.title: Great Customer Experience so far,,,,
records.text: We have just joined and haven't got to experience the whole service of yet, hence only 4 stars. However the experience we have had so far has been great, quick responses and knowledgable advisors.

records.title: The HR legal helpline has been a…
records.text: The HR legal helpline has been a lifesaver in my small business, the only thing I would highlight is their 6 month notice can be easily missed! That aside, I've found all their team helpful and informative, along with getting all the legal documents I need with ease and speed.

records.title: Health and Safety review
records.text: Really useful H&S review conducted with Connie Ricci.  Helpful and informative with pointers where we need to sort things out.  Very knowledgeable in all areas and a great support to us in getting everything up to speed.

records.title: Update in Employment Law
records.text: Sukdeep was really helpful and supportive in giving advice in the changes in Employment Law and helping me to update my Staff Handbook and T&CsThanks Sukdeep

records.title: Absolutely con of cons!
records.text: Sadie from support has been superb thus far!I had experienced issues although I am aware that croner were under a tight timeline for what I was expecting. However as soon as I had dealt with Sadie she tried her best to come up with  a resolution fast to uphold croner "great customer support service". She has helped to put unnecessary stress to rest!! Thanks again Sadie for proving that croner has better morals than most.Would have been 5 star if maybe I had dealt with Sadie from the beginning!!

records.title: Annual Health & Safety service visit
records.text: Following Nigel Billing's annual Health & Safety service visit:Feel very supported.Nigel is helpful & pleasant & non-judgemental.Any actions required on our part are clearly identified.Our good work recognised.Useful pointers in respect of PAT testing & BrightSafee-learning options.A positive experience, which I can happily report back to trustees & CEO.

records.title: Teams meeting isnt so bad after all.
records.text: I'm not a great lover of "teams" much rather have a real face to face. However Molly made it a much more relaxed discussing than I'm used to via teams. Think we covered everything in the one session. So no need to be hesitant for next year.

records.title: Review Interview with Molly Harris
records.text: I felt my interview with Molly by Teams was clear and the issues I needed to address were clearly and logically addressed. She was pleasant and helpful. I do not particularly like Teams as a medium but eye contact is important as well as checking the information on the screens. It might be helpful to have an idea of the facts  and figures before the meeting so not having to rely to much on checking the screens during the interview. She sent the information she promised over promptly, however she did not give me the details for the Advice Team whom I need to contact. Always good to remember that not everyone knows the organisation as you do when you are working with it all the time. Many Thanks Molly.

records.title: Mixed experience
records.text: Our organisation had a mixed experience with Croner, for that purpose I will break our review down into two parts.I'd like to begin by stating that our Face to Face Consultant did a great job in very difficult circumstances (more about that later!).  He was tasked with dealing with a very challenging set of circumstances and an even more challenging employee.  The F2F Consultant represented the concerns and aims of our organisation well during the meeting and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend/use his services again in the future.  The Consultant was very sensible and offered us good support during a difficult scenario for our organisation.  I would have given the Consultant a 4 star review, if it were not for the issues detailed below, which were out of his control.Unfortunately the support offered by the Croner Advice Team was of a lesser quality, hence the 3 star rating.  There seemed to be a lot of confusion at the Croner end around the nature of our query and this affected the nature and quality of advice we were given.  It ultimately became necessary for us to escalate our concerns in order to reach a semi-satisfactory conclusion (which was aided by the Consultant).  I would therefore be more hesitate to recommend Croner generally.

records.title: Visit from Croner disrupted by software issues.
records.text: We had an issue with the software during an organised visit from our Croner H&S rep. This made the visit almost impossible to conduct in an ifficient manner.Croner discussed the issue and reinstated the visit day back onto our allowance.

records.title: Communication
records.text: Once you get through to an advisor, you receive a good service, but it is frustrating not having a mobile number to contact the advisor directly once you have an ongoing situation.   This means you are often waiting to be put through and then get a different advisor.

records.title: Failure to respond!
records.text: The HR team managers fail to reply and respond within the 24 hour time frame promised.  I have contacted them and they have promised to email a response within hours and still have had no reply weeks later.Following my initial review, I was contacted immediately and in fact was inundated with calls to rectify the issues!Shame it took such a step to receive the service I should have been receiving in the first place.Hopefully, things will continue to be the way promised.

records.title: HR great H&S is poor value for money
records.text: We have been with Croner for a few years now. The HR support is great and I would give that 5 stars. We were contacted to take out the health and safety package which sounded good. It was sold in the way of a free Covid19 review for their clients, but actually, all they did was come to sell the Health and Safety package. We took out this to run alongside the HR package but actually, I wish we hadn't. You get model documents and a call to review, but I really don't think the ROI for a low-risk office offers good value. With hindsight, we would never have taken out and will not be renewing the H&S part. The HR part is very good though.

records.title: Advisors tend always to be busy when I…
records.text: Advisors tend always to be busy when I call, & therefore call backs are requested.  These are often slow in coming &/or don't materialise, however when you do get to speak to someone the advice is usually very good.

records.title: I was meant to have a meeting which…
records.text: I was meant to have a meeting which your team chased me for ages to book. On the day I get a phone call from the lady stating that she has looked at my company docs and all i need is the new legislation added and therefore a face to face meeting would not really be necessary but it was up to me. I am a busy man so can used the pre-booked time for other business matters but I felt it was poor to receive such a call a few hours from the meeting date... I also do not know if my forms were updated, need a follow up, need to get my employees to sign anything ...?

records.title: HR Advice Excellent, Support Service Room for Improvement
records.text: We use two parts of Croner, and I can honestly say that I can not fault their Employment Advice service that we have been using for years with them. We have fluidity with advisors who work bith our business needs, they provide goods avice and supportive documetns which save time and money.However the support services in the background of the service are somewhat lacking. Croner Provide a Document Service, and when you are back and forth the service is good, but if you don't reply quickly to changes then Croner do not get back promptly. We also are looking to transfer from Simplify to Bright-HR, however resolving a data transfer from one service to another is very long and slow. The Bright Hr system is not as inclusive as  the Simplify system, but there are elements it can do that would be better than Simplify in that it is Mobile App friendly, but waiting for a transfer does take ages...and we are still waiting even when liaising with our contact who is trying to get things moving. Would I recomend the service? Yes, for the HR support, absolutely, I don't really use the Health and Safety Support, but when we have spoken to the people who have visited to discuss it I don't find it as useful as other people who specialise in H&S system support.

records.title: my rating would have been higher
records.text: My rating would have been higher - only I received an email from Croner asking me to tell the world how wonderful they are. Gemma Conroy! - you alone would have received 5* but Croner's request reduced it to 3Hi Dan.Thank you for your email about Gemma Conroy – whilst I am very happy to feedback to you directly – I am reluctant to do so on any of the links you included.For me the feedback was about Gemma, not Croner. I wanted whomever Gemma reports to know what a great help she was.I am disappointed with your request, to share my feedback publicly, I only want Gemma, to receive from her employer some acknowledgement, directly and perhaps to her team and colleagues so that her expertise, calm guidance and knowledge, through the minefield that  employment law  can sometimes be is much appreciated.  I want her to feel valued by her employer – not her employer to feel valued by a customer. People comeback because of people.  I will use Croners because of Gemma.  Your email has left a poor impression of Croner’s internal  feedback process, perhaps that’s what I will share on one of those links. I am copying Paul Reid founder of Trickle. (www. trickle.works) an  internal communication app – that is simple and enables employees to communicate great feedback. Might improve Croner's approach to internal engagement and demonstrating employee value.

records.title: Important contract amendments were done…
records.text: Important contract amendments were done incorrectly

records.title: Terrible customer service
records.text: I tried for days to get in touch with someone, and then eventually when I did it took numerous calls to resolve my issue.  The team sent me the wrong information and then didn't seem to understand what they were actually sending me so I had to escalate.  Unfortunately that didn't resolve in getting what I needed.Very disappointed with their customer service (or lack of it) and would not recommend to anyone else as it caused a lot of time and frustration trying to resolve.

records.title: They seem very unorganized behind the…
records.text: They seem very unorganized behind the scenes. I am still waiting for log in details from weeks ago just to get started. Always been a difficult company to deal with.

records.title: Post inpection review
records.text: The booking system and the delay to come out for a visit was a disgrace.The inspector was great.

records.title: I have received numerous emails from…
records.text: I have received numerous emails from various individuals to amend the furlough deduction payment and issue new handbooks.  The furlough deductions have been happening since March, 5 months later, I receive a document for staff to sign accepting the changes along with an updated handbook.  I have not had my terms and conditions review as yet to have an updated handbook. Communication, organisation and timeliness of this is unprofessional.

records.title: Notice period.
records.text: We have now Cancelled our contract with Croner. All I will say is just be aware of the notice period if you want to cancel. The notice period is 6 months ,they do not provide notice of the renewal & they just auto renew your contract for the same length it was before( ours was 3 years)

records.title: I have been using for over 10 years but…
records.text: I have been using for over 10 years but recently Croner has continued to let us down with their extremely poor Health and Safety support service.  Lack of information, lack of communication, constant changes to staff .... this has resulted in numerous mistakes being made and poor advice.  Although there has been some attempt to rectify it, it still continues to increase our workload instead of reducing it and we are at a point where we are looking elsewhere.We have asked for support and even a consideration on the amount of invoicing recently ... zero response.

records.title: Very poor Technical support
records.text: Very poor Technical support.  Staff don't seem to have adequate knowledge of the system.Also in today's day and age why ask customers to dial on an expensive 0844 number?

records.title: Poor Customer Service
records.text: Emailed numerous times to cancel contract. Fell on deaf ears. Then we were interrogated and asked why we were cancelling. Salesman came in and I told him we were cancelling - said he'd tell accounts, he clearly didn't. Just be careful as they'll try to rope you into a long contract and auto-renew without speaking to you first.

records.title: Harassing Cold Callers
records.text: I made an enquiry with this company for my business but decided the service wasn’t correct for my needs.Since then I have received 6-7 unwanted calls including at the weekend and have asked for them to remove my details 3 times VERY firmly.They have promised me that I will now not received any more phone calls but I do not think this should take 3 angry phone calls to resolve.If I receive any more phone calls I will be taking this further as surely this is against GDPR regulations.

description:
Apron was started by a group of people who’d spend years building products for global fintech companies. But there was one big problem no one was solving. Business payments. The kind that buy tomatoes, tools, and till rolls. The kind that keep suppliers happy and business booming. The kind that should be super simple to make and manage, and yet, aren’t. Payments eat up valuable hours every week for both businesses and the accountants and bookkeepers who help them.

This is a problem that’s affecting entrepreneurs. Florists and financial analysts. Brewers and brand strategists. The kind of people who build things, break things, change things. Imagine what they could do with this time instead. What would they come up with? What would they create?

That’s why we built Apron as a payments powerhouse. We flip the payment experience from blocking business to boosting it. Apron pulls all things payments together – weaving into your workflow, collating conversations, turning hours into minutes. So you can put those hours to better use – plan the future, take a walk, call your mum.

The truth is, payments hold power. Get them right, and they’ll keep everything else moving forward.
 
Ready?

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: The customer service and dedication from Sandra Goszcz is second to none. She has been extremely helpful and persistent in making sure the matter was resolved and that I got to enjoy the best of the app.

records.title: So fast, efficient, and accurate
records.text: So fast and efficient. Love the speed, love that the app allows me to input a note, love that it can create an invoice or note from the body of an email.Better extraction accuracy than most of the cheaper versions and a fraction of the price of the next best competitor.

records.title: Awesome supplier payment experience
records.text: Having completed my first big supplier payment run on Apron its was so slick and easy to set up. It had pulled all the supplier bank details from the invoices and checked that the details were a match with their actual bank which is a huge check when minimising the risk of fraud. Flagging any that weren't a match saved so much time! Really impressed with the speed and functionality of this software so far!

records.title: Apron is exactly what we need for…
records.text: Apron is exactly what we need for clients on the capture side and we will soon be exploring the payments side - but at a glance looks great too. Any help we've needed the response time back, either via the live chat or email, has been almost instant and always ensure our query is complete before closing it off. All staff experienced have been polite and very helpful. Thank you Apron.

records.title: Very nice system and fast processing
records.text: Very nice system and fast processing. Was very impressed with the simplicity of the portal and how effective this system is. We can now pay all suppliers and even run roll through a single interface. Enjoy using Apron!

records.title: Very quick and simple to set up and get…
records.text: Very quick and simple to set up and get started. Finding a tool that is not just easy for us to use but also easy for our clients is really important and we so glad we made the move to Apron.The support we've received has been excellent.

records.title: How to get the Payment Process working for the Client
records.text: A payment run for remote Clients is usually by Text, Email, or via the phone.The missing piece is Approval linked to Payment, a connection between the Authoriser and the Bank Payment, one that isn't separated by a separate communication.APRON, cleans up the messy to and fro. The process from Bill selection, Approval and Payment is all managed via this clever software.At last the missing piece, possibly the Best innovation since BACS Pay arrived in the 1990's. A missing link as it were.If you aren't using this, perhaps you should be!

records.title: Receipt capture made easy
records.text: Receipt capture made easy! Apron has made capturing receipts from our clients really simple, and at a much more competitive price than competitors. Every product these guys build has been superb and they listen to feedback to ensure the product keeps developing even more!

records.title: Positive Onboarding Experience with Apron: Responsive Support and User-Friendly Features
records.text: My experience with Apron has been very positive so far! Marek and Sandra’s responsiveness is definitely a great sign. I had a few queries while I was setting up new clients and they got back to me immediately through the chat feature.While payments might not be available in Ireland yet,  the bill uploading feature is working well for us. Apron's features work well and the layout is clear and user friendly. Looking forward to seeing more features roll out in the coming months.

records.title: We started to trial Apron Payments for…
records.text: We started to trial Apron Payments for one of our Clients and have so far found this to be working very well! The Team have been on hand with regards to any issues providing prompt solutions and we've had extremely positive feedback from our Client. We have previously trialled similar solutions which haven't worked as promised so we are very impressed with Apron!

records.title: Apron is transforming our payments process
records.text: We have been using Apron for a few months now for a few clients, and will start rolling it out to more, as we're really happy with the functionality.  It's saving us a lot of time from manually setting up payments, and allows flexibility to get other team members to set up payruns too.  Our clients love it too.  I'm impressed with Apron's customer service, they are very quick to respond to queries or any teething issues, their comms are excellent, and they have them resolved as quickly as possible.  Thank you Apron!

records.title: The supplier payments process is…
records.text: The supplier payments process is 5-star, but there are occasional errors in integration and limited automation with payroll.

records.title: Speedy service resolving issues
records.text: Had some issue with clients accidentally creating duplicate accounts but it was sorted in a jiffy through Apron support. I would however suggest that Apron creates support videos that Practices can send to their clients as clients. So separate tutorials using it as a practice & using it as a client of a practice

records.title: Very Disappointed
records.text: Apron does not pick up dates correctly. Uploads signature pictures as documents. Duplicates loads constantly. However the support team are helpful. Date of experience is constant not one day in particular.

description:
Since 1983 Peninsula has been providing professional services to small businesses across the UK. We started small ourselves, just a few people in a room. So, although we've grown over the years, our values remain the same. We know what small businesses need because we are still a small business at heart. Today our services go beyond employment and HR to cover health and safety management, insurance, employee well-being, and much more besides. Whatever we do, the service is always provided by a handpicked team of experts, so you can be sure you're getting the best. We have expanded to provide these services to small businesses in Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and Canada meaning that more people are protected by Peninsula.
