records.title: I work with Peninsular on a regular…
records.text: I work with Peninsular on a regular basis and my most recent support from one of their ER advisors has been nothing short of exceptional. Thank you Gemma Ogden. A complex case, it has taken its time to come together, but i am extremely happy with the support provided.

records.title: Excellent employment law helpline
records.text: This is an excellent employment law helpline if you employ care staff. Emma Keller was really helpful with my query, and good about taking her time and not rushing me. She also followed it up in writing. Much appreciated.

records.title: Imagine feeling anxious about an…
records.text: Imagine feeling anxious about an employee issue at 3am and you get to speak to a thoroughly calm and professional advisor. Liam T was both knowledge on the subject, but offered advice I’d not thought of. What an absolutely super person.   Well done Liam.   From a 10 year + peninsula customer!

records.title: Anvi Gatlevar - Face2Face Consultant
records.text: We had a situation to manage which Peninsula and Anvi Gatlevar helped us address. The service was excellent and we have once again found Peninsula and Anvi to be a very valuable and professional resource.Thanks Anvi for helping us navigate the treacherous seas of HR.

records.title: I have been working with Anisa for a…
records.text: I have been working with Anisa for a considerble amount of time.  She has been responsive to emails and calls.  She has been a great support in what has been a challenging case for us.  I cannot thank Anisa enough for the help she has provided to our business and also to me personally.

records.title: As a new Peninsula customer
records.text: As a new Peninsula customer, I have been impressed with the efficient and professional onboarding experience. I had the pleasure of meeting Jake K today; he was very polite and helpful as he guided me through the policy documentation process. I'm looking forward to working with the team going forward.

records.title: Hr document meeting
records.text: Had my hr documents meeting with Melanie Taylor last week. Really professional and got things done super fast. Melanie also answered all my questions and was really helpful and polite.Happy with the service would recommend.

records.title: My recent interaction with Peninsula
records.text: My recent interaction with Peninsula, specifically the case worker Russell Prendergast has been nothing short of amazing. So helpful, knowledgeable and the advice/guidance provided was detailed but simple, and easy to follow.  So polite, courteous and explained everything so clearly. An absolute pleasure to deal with, and excellent experience

records.title: Jameala is a great communicator and…
records.text: Jameala is a great communicator and responded quickly to my ongoing enquiry . The follow up email was concise and reinforced what I had already learnt

records.title: Mimi Moghaddam visited us for annual…
records.text: Mimi Moghaddam visited us for annual review, She was extremely knowledgeable and handled the audit professionally, with a great deal of care. Mimi also followed up very promptly with actionable steps, I appreciated the thoroughness

records.title: We used the Face2Face service for a redundancy
records.text: We used the Face2Face service to conduct a redundancy in our company. We were very pleased with the service, it was friendly, reassuring, efficient and our consultant was very knowledgeable. They conducted the process, meeting and gave us template letters to send out. It was good to have the peace of mind that we were proceeding following employment law and good practice.

records.title: Our H&S instructor was very knowledgeable and patient as the class came to terms with new concepts.
records.text: I recently attended a Managing Safely course hosted by Peninsula and found it very useful. The instruction was clear and the content engaging, no question was off limits and the attention to detail was impressive. The course materials were fit for purpose and constructive feedback was always available. Never thought that I would say this but, "as H&S courses go, this one was actually very enjoyable".

records.title: Peninsula Face2Face Service
records.text: Musa Aftab was our Peninsula Face2Face Consultant. He had a very professional approach and was patient and supportive through a difficult grievance/settlement process. His help and guidance was extremely helpful to us as this was a first experience with this type of matter.

records.title: Kevin was very helpful
records.text: Peninsular were providing a long overdue review of the company documentation. Kevin James was assigned to carry out the review.  He was most helpful in providing information to me on the changes that need adding/updating to our contracts/handbook etc and is going to make the changes as discussed.

records.title: Initial welcome call
records.text: A lot of thorough information and followed up on email, although despite being a fast talker myself, and I like to think able to absorb a good amount of information quickly. I did find the call quite rushed this would be my only criticism.

records.title: A great first experience with Peninsula H&S review
records.text: Ranjith Ram explained things clearly and listened to my thoughts/questions.Brought to my attention an app I didn't know we had access to and said he would follow up with training for me and a no. of templates (which I have already received).

records.title: Jake Knox was my advisor
records.text: Jake Knox was my advisor, very knowledgeable took his time to explain all the relevant information and procedures for my HR Documentation.

records.title: Fire Risk Assessment
records.text: We recently had a Fire Risk Assessment, at our practice, conducted by Mark Lethaby of Peninsula. To say I was a little apprehensive was an understatement as I thought we would be 'scolded' for not being compliant in all areas. However Mark made the whole experience enlightening! He worked through all areas with me and 'advised' not 'told' me what we could improve on. Thanks!!

records.title: Great Support from Payroll Services
records.text: Jakub Staromlynski assisted me with an SMP claim. He was thorough, helpful and professional throughout and worked to my timescales. Thank you Jakub.

records.title: IOSH MS Toni Houghton
records.text: Thank you to Toni Houghton for the professional delivery of IOSH MS training. Toni is a very competent and practical instructor with a wealth of industry experience.The course content was good but Toni's delivery excellent, relevant and well paced.

records.title: Anvi Gatlevar
records.text: Anvi was impartial and clearly considered all of the evidence. She has been helpful with every aspect during and after the grievance.

records.title: Melanie Taylor
records.text: Although I had to initiate the contact, not having had one for a few years, which is the reason why I marked the score down, I had a very helpful visit at our office  from Melanie Taylor to review our documents and staff handbook.  She followed this up very promptly.

records.title: Helpful and knowledgeable HR advisor
records.text: Today I had a number of questions regarding policies and contracts of employment.  Not only did Daniel H help with those but from things he picked up in our conversation, he helped with other things I'm working on.  Dan was so incredibly helpful and knowledgeable.

records.title: Issues Resolved - Client Care Team
records.text: I had a great experience with Client Care Advocate Lisa Cox - we had recently onboarded with Peninsula and not had the best start with some of the advisors that we had dealt with. When I raised the concerns I was having, I was given a call by Lisa who did her best to put a solution in place to resolve the issue and arranged for compensation. Lisa has checked in at frequent intervals since to ensure that things are running smoothly and to ensure that we have had no further issues. I felt heard and understood by Lisa, and rather than being given excuses, I was helped to resolve the issue in a timely fashion. Many thanks again Lisa and team.

records.title: CHAS… application
records.text: Our business wanted to apply for CHAS to help our business grow for the future and to do this CHAS would play a massive part of it. I am newly recruited for Health & Safety, and from the start of Peninsula journey, I had received an email from a member of Peninsula called "Jack Taylor". Jack has been so supportive right from the start, and with it being all new to me Jack had gave me his time and effort to help build our application. Jack's response in all my emails have been next to non, so just like to say thank you Jack and I would highly recommend his help and support to to others!

records.title: Consistent support
records.text: A TUPE exercise became a little complicated so we summoned the help of Penninsula who gave us consistent support throughout.  Drafting letters, approving our drafts and calling us when there was a need to do.  Chloe Owens navigated us through the process which had some blips but turned out well.  Very impressed with he support and with Graham who covered during her leave period.  An excellent service

records.title: Ranjith Ram
records.text: Pleasure meeting Ranjith Ram, albeit information overload. However the follow up email is brilliant, summary of what was discussed and attachments to ensure we are up to code. Thank you.

records.title: The Peninsula team were amazing.
records.text: The Peninsula team were amazing with the support they gave us during a tribunal claim from start to finish. I really appreciated having the guidance and support via telephone as well as email whenever necessary. I have given 4 stars as the representative that was initially assigned to support us in court left  2-3 weeks before our hearing was due,  and I only found this out when an email bounced back. Having said that, Anita who was assigned to our case familiarised herself and picked everything up at short notice, and reinstalled the confidence that we had the support we needed. Both Anita and Nicole were excellent. I would highly recommend Peninsula.

records.title: All staff at Peninsula are professional…
records.text: All staff at Peninsula are professional and extremely helpful. No question is a silly question.  I am in a stand alone position and sometimes need to air my thoughts out and know what I am doing is correct. Peninsula support me through this. Thank you

records.title: Patience had its Reward
records.text: Your Victoria Tewelde, kept us on the straight and narrow, dealing with an extremely long and tedious case. It could have cost thousands if we had tried to close this case too early, which we were almost prepared to do.  Her dogmatic and professional manner, saved us from making this costly mistake.  Thank you Victoria.

records.title: Never had so many spam phone calls!
records.text: Never had so many spam phone calls at work before, even telling me I must not care about my staff and how I might be breaking the law. Ironic when you consider despite being told not to contact us again, you continue to do so even going to the trouble of calling from mobile numbers. Why would we ever be a customer of yours?! Peninsula did follow up stating that they couldn't find a record of our number, so we've sent them a call log from their landline to investigate further.Further update: Contacted by Nikki at Peninsula who has escalated a complaint and removed our details from their system. What's better is they are sending our team a hamper as an apology to our team. Gone up from 1 star that's for sure!

records.title: Melanie Taylor was professional in our…
records.text: Melanie Taylor was professional in our documentation meeting. She ensured that I was okay with how the documents were structured.

records.title: Initially the company were very good…
records.text: Initially the company were very good and dealt with our needs accordingly.Cancelling our contract however was very challenging, please make sure you read it thoroughly. We thought we had taken out a yearly contract but if you do not give 6 months notice before renewal you have no option but to carry on with another years contract!!

records.title: Not really suitable for small food…
records.text: Not really suitable for small food operating/manufacturing business. Now stuck in a 5 year contract we can't get out of and do not need as it does not fit the requirements of the business, even after talking with their resolutions team.

records.title: Document review meeting
records.text: Not enough time was allowed for the meeting. The advisor spoke very fast and rushed through. Notwithstanding this the advisor was very knowledgeable.

records.title: Awful at sorting out their own issues
records.text: The positives you would expect from them when paying for an agreed service;Bright HR platform- very happy with it and very easy to use. Not perfect by any means but every clients requirements will always differ so it's an impossible task.Peninsula documentation team- very helpful, very responsive, brilliant service. Peninsula employment law/HR advice team- very helpful, very responsive, brilliant service. The negatives;BrightSafe platform- needs a lot of work and lacks basic features. The support team only seem to know how to run to a script and don't appear to have any expert knowledge on the system when there are queries outside of the scope of the script.Peninsula business development- over promise, under deliver and ignore calls/emails/texts from you when there is an issue.Client resolutions team are absolutely awful. Extremely slow or no response, require a lot of chasing and do not bring any solutions or resolutions.Queries raised at the very beggining of January remain unanswered and 4 weeks in to the current cycle with the resolutions team with no communication back from them and no resolution in sight.I'd avoid Peninsula for anything health & Safety related, currently their H&S capability is in the shadows of their HR & Employment Law services.Updated- Julie from Peninsula has taken over our complaint and put all of the right people in touch with us to help sort the issues out. The assistance, communication and responsiveness she has provided us has been great and mirrors the experience we've had with the HR & Employment law team. It's good to see they do take on the negative feedback and work with you to sort things out. Purely the experience with the business development side has stopped this from going to a 4 or 5 star review

records.title: I typically refrain from composing…
records.text: I typically refrain from composing reviews; however, I feel compelled to share my experience from attending one of their complimentary events in Ipswich on 8/9/22. My primary objective was to foster connections with fellow businesses, and I indeed found the event to be enlightening. Regrettably, despite the informative nature of the event, the scale of my enterprise renders their services unnecessary. Despite my repeated requests over the past two years to be removed from their mailing list, both electronically and via post, we continue to receive unsolicited marketing communications. Notably, their recent email lacks a clear mechanism for unsubscribing from their mailing list.I earnestly hope that someone within the organization will take heed of this communication and expunge all of my details permanently, ceasing any further correspondence from their company.

records.title: I am rating this as a three
records.text: I am rating this as a three, as whilst the service is basically good, I feel that it has been rather  pushy, I have received several emails to make an appointment, then calls to do this, and being told if not booked on the days they are offering it will be miles ahead before you are able to offer any other dates. I just felt rushed

records.title: Conflicting advice
records.text: Spoke to different advisors whose advice slightly contradicted others. The notes made on the system were not entirely accurate linked to the conversations had. Followed the advice that was more pertinent to the case.Not sure the advisors realised the serious nature of the initial incident (not attending a callout - leaves client with a non-working fire alarm system)

records.title: Jasmine Seddon asked all the right…
records.text: Jasmine Seddon asked all the right questions on the phone and was very helpful. I explained that she would need to email the documents as I didn't have access to the portal, yet she uploaded them to the portal anyway. This is frustrating as it was a simple request and held things up my end. I am now waiting for her to send them through in the correct format this morning.

records.title: 3 years with Peninsula
records.text: 3 years with Peninsula, wasn't happy at all for the first 2 years as there was always someone else I as speaking to and everyone had kinda different view and advises, until I spoke to Justyna Pryszczewska who was very direct very professional and always explained everything till the very end- always fell like she's on my site.Since then she's the only one I deal with.

records.title: To date any face-to-face meeting I have…
records.text: To date any face-to-face meeting I have had with any Peninsula representative has been second to none.  However, any of your telephone support services has been to be frank, poor.  It has taken weeks for the problems I have had with BrightHR to be resolved and then the confusion regarding transfer of information from one account to another.

records.title: I have been in contact with Eddie and…
records.text: I have been in contact with Eddie and Wesley recently and in all honesty neither have been particularly helpful.I am still waiting on the documentation I requested and have had no update as to the status as to when I will receive it.There always seems to be some sort on miscommunication when discussing any matter.

records.title: Turnaround for the better.
records.text: What has been an unacceptably poor service has made a turnaround today. Mimi Moghaddam on her first meeting, has instilled a level of trust that had been wholly absent.  Prior to Mimi's visit, Peninsular would have scored 1 star.  I look forward to having an effective, beneficial service from now on.

records.title: Good But Could Be Better
records.text: Peninsula online is a good system. The back up support needs improvement. When requiring information or support answers can be a while in coming. Employee support help line is not what it makes out to be either. Rather than answering questions on emplyment issues, they just offer support

records.title: Overall a Good Service
records.text: Peninsula offer exceptional security when it comes to HR advice and indemnity.  Their advice is always very good and it is backed up by the relevant paperwork which just needs completing saving a great deal of time and worries.  I have not rated this as excellent because despite having nominated advisors these seem to constantly change and there is often a delay on getting my query answered or more specifically followed up on.  However overall I would recommend this service to everyone who does not have a designated HR professional on site or even if they do as a belt and braces service.

records.title: Good but could be much better
records.text: I have used Peninsula a lot and the advice they give is helpful and thorough. The only problems I have found is that you speak to so many different people. Sometimes the questions you have span across different departments and I think that leads to confusion.

records.title: End of Contract incident
records.text: As an organisation, we decided to move away from Peninsula. Unfortunately during the 6 months notice we did not download all of our information with regards to HSE, accident, incident and near miss reporting. I called Peninsula Customer Services and admitted our blunder and asked them to supply our information and send it on to me - I was told that this was not possible and that we had the opportunity to do it during the 6 month notice period. I followed up with an email and was asked why I wanted our information, which I explained again and reminded them that we had been a customer for 14 years and again with 2 other helpdesk operators via email before receiving the information. I have added one more star since receiving an apology over the phone and before that via email for the admission of misinforming me at the beginning of my query.

records.title: Pro's & Con's...........
records.text: Pro's & Cons.....Very professional company & an enthusiastic team on all aspects.Like all things with employment law - I find it very frustrating with the 'back & forth' procedures which differs from the face to face chats/meetings, which then goes higher & over ruled?!I also do not like the fact that when given clear instruction, that I may be able to proceed, but at my risk! Why employ a professional company to take away risk, which then offers it back to you?I can clearly see that I need this service to be robust, but sadly its made me realise just how vulnerable I am as an employer - even with this service!

records.title: General Feedback
records.text: Our allocated Litigation Executive helped us with a recent case; providing advice and assistance all the way to final resolution. He had to deal with our case halfway through when a colleague left Peninsula. I was impressed by the way he picked up the key issues, asking lots of questions and seeking clarity on facts.  The whole process took a long time to resolve, and proactive communication could have been better - for example I didn't know the original litigation executive had left and our case was not being actively dealt with until I rang as a deadline was looming.  I also had to chase for updates/ information but when I did he responded quickly.

records.title: Really sorry to disappoint - Face to Face is an upsell
records.text: Really sorry to disappoint, but i will keep my opinions limited to the fact that selling, upselling face to face is not appropriate from a sales person who is insensitive to what a small business is going through. while i accept alot of other actions and advise from Peninsula is to protect its own insurance cost at the cost of time and disruption, and ultimate caution from Peninsula sometime not what a small business owner needs, or has the capacity to be put through, and this is where many advisors fail to adapt. always assuring me you are there to protect us (over protect at our cost)   Having worked with Peninsula many years i do appreciate their corporate (commercial and profit driven) structure but they should remain as a consultant and advisor and not an upseller. i will be making official complaint

records.title: Spoken to a few in Scottish office
records.text: Spoken to a few in Scottish office. Very loud background noise, with others shouting and laughing. Not very professional nor fair when trying to make out what the person is saying when there are multiple people shouting in the background. Chloe advised breach of contract is not a stand alone claim. Not sure if I misheard or if it’s correct.

records.title: The service/product is good but very…
records.text: The service/product is good but very expensive. For a small employer like us (45 staff) we were pushed into a 5 year contract and regret it tbh. we have tried to cancel but with no luck. Despite some very small HR issues (that we could have sorted ourselves but used Peninsula (because we are paying for such) we only really use Peninsula for Bright HR. Basically paying £500+ a month for a holiday booking system and cloud storage for contracts. One of our other suppliers (roster system) now offers this service for free. We have had a few issues (regarding migrant sponsorship licences) we have needed help on but they don't offer any help with this. We should not have signed a 5 year contract and accept that. We were going through a lengthy HR dispute that we wanted to resolve. Peninsula pushed us to sign up to their service so that they would help resolve the issue. Had we had more time we would have reflected that the cost for the business was not worth it.In short do not rush in to this because it is expensive. If you get what you need from it then it will be worth it. For a small business I doubt that it will be worth such.

records.title: Dreadful service from Peninsula lately
records.text: Dreadful service from Peninsula lately. They used to deliver a 5 star service but they have slipped. Call back times not honoured and promises of timelines that they simply cannot deliver. Used to rave about this company but its becoming draining of late

records.title: An advice line should be just that..
records.text: I called for advice on a Health and Safety issue. Rather than being given any guidance, all I got was "we can do  that for you, it'll cost this much".An advice line should be just that, not a means of drumming up revenue.

records.title: Employment law expertise has declined…
records.text: Employment law expertise has declined over recent years as this company has grown.  We have been using their services for 20+ years with little interaction, but in the past, when we needed advice it was provided with full explanation and reference to employment law.  As our business grows, we are finding the need for advise increasing, but the quality of advise and support is deteriorating to a point where we are constantly questioning the employment law experts recommendations.  When you do question advice, it takes 2-3 weeks for this to be investigated.  Regrettably we have served notice of non-renewal due to the recent downturn in the quality of advice, service and support to enable a full review of other service providers.

records.title: misleading
records.text: I am only with Pennisula from April this year I find it adds more work on to admin and office staff.Their advice is correct and current but they expect the company to pay for their service plus do a lot of work.The service is expensive enough without taking staff from their regular work

records.title: Be very careful dealing with this company
records.text: This company have a terrible attitude to existing customers. They use small print to lock you in even if their service is a bad fit for your business. In my opinion they employ sharp business practice to lock you in.29/10/2019 Update. Dan has worked hard to come up with an acceptable compromise to my issues. I have adjusted the star rating to reflect the activity that has gone on since my first review. We now have 6 months to see whether our businesses are compatible with each other. So far, so good.

records.title: Thank you for the opportunity to…
records.text: Michelle the Supervisor phoned.We had a very constructive and positive conversation.Nothing to fault in what she said.Tony DeaneThank you for the opportunity to comment.Our original contact was with Michelle, she asked for a communications window after receiving emails about the problem. When, the next day we sent timings, there was no response. So we phoned and ended up speaking to Ola.Ola was NOT up to speed on our case, then why should she be.It turns out that Michelle had a day off.I feel we therefore received scripted answers to our particular problem.Ola was charming and thorough, then it is management that put her in a "poor" situation

records.title: Inconsistent Service
records.text: Service can be great, but very inconsistent. It all depends on who you speak to. Some staff are very helpful, offer good advice and others make you feel like they are doing you a favor by taking your call. I recently had to follow up with 3 emails to get a letter template, no apology given. The guy who took over the case ended up being very thorough but still, i don't expect to wait 3 days follow up, then receive no apology. We also had an issue with brighthr, again after following up with  countless emails i have heard nothing. No solution...maybe they just don't know the answer. Anyway i am sure there are more options for different companies offering a better service than this. We have canceled our subscription when it runs out in January.

description:
Crunch takes the stress out of accounting by reducing both cost and time. We provide simple online accounting for contractors, freelancers, sole traders, limited companies, and small businesses.

With over 10,500 clients, we offer a range of fixed-fee packages and bespoke solutions so you can design a service to suit you. We help with accounting, tax reporting, Self Assessments, payroll, expenses, bookkeeping, and much more.

We’re not just another software provider - we offer unlimited support and advice through our client management team and chartered certified accountants.

records.title: Friendly, helpful and clear advice from Nick
records.text: I got some great advice from Nick and even though we were talking about something I really struggle to grasp, he didn't patronise me at all and explained everything in a very clear way that really helped me to understand. We had a lovely chat and a laugh, he's really friendly whilst professional and he was very patient with all my questions - even though I must have said 'just one more question...' about 10 times.

records.title: Highly professional accountancy service
records.text: Crunch are always friendly and helpful.Sean has consistently provided a highly professional accountancy service. He has always been friendly, patient and helpful, I would highly recommend him and his team. Thankyou Sean and team!

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: I have used Crunch for a number of years now. I have always found them to be very helpful when I call. I spoke to Ngozi last week and she went over and above to work with me to get my year end accounts reconciled. Very friendly and patient and happy all is now complete after having some unresolved support previously. Thank you Ngozi

records.title: Crunch made it easy for me to become a sole trader!
records.text: Crunch made it easy for me to transition from full time to being a sole trader. They even were able to handle invoicing in USD, which was essential for me.

records.title: Another fabulous service from Crunch
records.text: Another fabulous service from Crunch. Joss Horne is an absolute lifesaver. Talking to him reduces my tax return anxiety from 10 to 0 in minutes!

records.title: I just wanted to extend my sincere…
records.text: I just wanted to extend my sincere thanks to Ngozi for her patience and support in going through all my accounts with me prior to submitting my tax return. I had gotten myself into a bit of a muddle this year, and her help was truly invaluable.I really appreciate her dedication and assistance! I will definitely continue to use Crunch moving forward.

records.title: Best accounting company out there
records.text: Best accounting company out there. Also using their mortgage brokerage and really happy with the service.

records.title: Helpful and informative
records.text: Have had an easy time using crunch, being able to speak with the wider team has been helpful for myself as I’m a new company with little legal / financial knowledge. Sean V in particular has been quite helpful in highlighting options and the factors at play for a range of tasks / problems

records.title: Helpful
records.text: Crunch is great, I've found their support channels very helpful. They are quick to resolve issues, and happy to answer my in-depth questions so I feel empowered to make the decisions I need to make about my business.Today I've been talking to Sean about my VAT position. He was very helpful and explained clearly what I need to know about the different schemes and how they relate to my company. There was nothing I needed to be worried about, but he was calm and non-judgemental about my concerns. Thanks Sean!

records.title: Outstanding support from the team!
records.text: Outstanding support from the team! I love that they recognise that Finance is not most customers key focus, having businesses to run.Ngozi specifically walked me through completing pre-yearend preparations with the patience of a saint!My sincere thanks to the team for helping me to focus on my business, safe in the knowledge that my accounts are in safe hands.

records.title: Helpful, but not perfect
records.text: Something I've enjoyed about using Crunch is that it gives you a great overview of your accounts and deadlines. The software helps automate some of the processes too, which can save a lot of time. That said, it requires some manual work every now and then. There was definitely a learning curve for me as someone who knows close nothing about accounting, but if you get stuck the support team is usually quite quick to jump in and help.

records.title: Great customer service all round
records.text: Great customer service all round. My assigned accountant was swift to to respond and made sure to clarify things for my self assessment submission

records.title: Crunch - Available, patient and supportive service
records.text: Available, patient and supportiveBusiness taxation is complicated. Having a new business it is rather daunting, but Crunch have been really supportive - still learning loads, but feel there is someone to call on and help you through it.

records.title: Almost Perfect
records.text: Crunch has a team of lovely, and knowledgeable accountants, that really know their stuff. The accounting tools are fast, straightforward, and the guides available make it simple to get up and running straight away.I would give 5 stars, but email communication takes a little long, it would be nice if more stuff could be done just through the phone (adding a new SIC code), as the phone response times are 10/10.

records.title: Been a customer of Crunch for years
records.text: Been a customer of Crunch for years. Always there when I needed them, and their software keeps getting better and better. There are still rooms for improvement, but I always feel like my company finances are in good, responsible, caring hands.

records.title: Generally good
records.text: Generally good. I am a little irritated that we have to pay Crunch £200 a year for payroll (on top of their normal fees of about £1000 a year), even though neither of us are paid enough to need to pay Employee NI, and no Employer NI contributions are due either (thanks to the Employment Allowance).

records.title: My opinion has changed over the years…
records.text: My opinion has changed over the years of working with them. In general, they are great—compare to other two companies that I know. For the future I have only three wishes. 1. Please explain all the details in human not accounting language. 2. The names of the menu items on the website and in the newsletter must match. 3. We need more hints placed directly where are they applicable, not somewhere in the help system.Thanks for your work Crunch, well done!

records.title: Crunch Mortgage and Accounting
records.text: The Crunch Mortgage team has helped me secure a mortgage offer seamlessly. They followed up with the right parties and sorted all matters.The accounting team responds to my requests promptly and with excellent knowledge and rapport.

records.title: Accounting made easier
records.text: Accounting made easierI was drawn to Crunch with the interest of learning a bit of accounting while managing my business.  The UI/UX is very good and fairly easy to pick up.  Customer service is fantastic.  I did have some bad experiences, mostly because the services targets the quantity over the quality of the service.  What I'm saying is, I didn't get the 1-1 relationship with an accountant.  Most, if not all of the communication was async via email and required a lot of manual labour from my part.  I think the service will get better, making it easier and more automated.  But if I were to depend on an accountant again, I would go to a dedicated accountant for the 1-1 relationship.

records.title: Good assistance and support
records.text: Good assistance and supportI am quite happy with the service, every time I need assistance there is always someone helpful at the other end of the line

records.title: Mas who helped me and responded to my…
records.text: Mas who helped me and responded to my queries was very patient and provided me with clear instructions on how to book my rather complex banking transactions originating from a non-GBP account. We been able to resolve the issues I ran into and I will know now how to circumvent similar challenges in the future.

records.title: Account review - professional, swift, precise - ronseal!!
records.text: Joel - was excellent. We moved swiftly through a lot of things!Would have been 5 stars, the fact that it isn't is nothing to do with Joel. The issue was a laggy telephone call. Joel kept his humour and so did I, but it was a bit distracting. It could have been an issue my end, but that hasn't happened before.

records.title: Good on boarding process
records.text: Good on boarding process. Super friendly and well organised staff - personal walk through of software and additional benefits of being a Crunch customer. Just switching over from another accountant - so 4 stars for now as I don't have a full experience of the accountants - looking forward to working with them.

records.title: Great response time
records.text: Great response time, very helpful staff.

records.title: Makes my life much easier
records.text: Makes my life much easier, total convert.

records.title: When you need help, they're there.
records.text: I own a self employed business and deal with Ms. Olivia Beadle & Mr. Lakshan Selvarajah from Crunch Accounting for my issues and questions related to taxes and self assessments They have been helping me out in the best way possible to resolve any queries whatsoever.Mr Lakshan was kind enough to guide me through all the process of filing a self assessment which I submitted myself recently without any hassle.I really hope this remains the same in future.

records.title: Overall great service provided
records.text: Overall great service provided. Always a friendly voice when you phone  for help or a query- and never made to feel that you’re asking a silly question or that you should know the answer. Have been with for years and have always been super helpful  and approachable. Would Recommend :)

records.title: Great software and email support time…
records.text: Great software and email support time turn around. Optimistic future software/support iterations will only improve. Fair value for money.  Only knocked one start due to slightly confused/beaureaucratic sign up process and the odd bit of slightly confused or unhelpful support. Confident these were just minor hiccups on a long road though.

records.title: Quick customer service response
records.text: This is an update to my original review.  I was contacted by Crunch to help solve the problem I had highlighted.  A suggestion was made that I followed and was eventually able to reconcile my accounts.  I was appreciative of the quick response to my problem and the support to solve the issue.  I understand a permanent solution is currently being designed in the software to make refunds and credit notes a breeze just like all the other functions on Crunch.

records.title: SO far I have had very prompt replies…
records.text: SO far I have had very prompt replies from Crunch personnel which is very much appreciated and they alert me when I need to submit. I would give it 5 stars if I received more advice on how to save on tax and my expenses. I think that is the main thing. Of course I cant really evaluate on final outcome of the service.

records.title: Deteriorating service
records.text: I've been a client for a few years now and my initial impressions were fantastic. The software package remains great and indeed steadily improves, but the service overall is declining while the costs steadily escalate. Beyond the initial setup there isn't much support service included, it took six months and a lot of chasing to get the annual accounts completed this year, and responses to my emails, if received at all, are getting slower and slower. Overall, for the money and services offered, Crunch no longer seems great value. I hope the business can get back on track.

records.title: Great online platform (mid-quality over-all service)
records.text: Great online platform, but service beyond that, i.e. when you have to get in touch with an actual accountant, is not great.E.g. emails only partially read / answered or not at all...Feels like Crunch are more and more moving to an online only business with no personal touchpoints. This may be fine for the most basic of accounting needs, but if you need a tiny bit more, it can be quite tedious interacting with Crunch...

records.title: Used to be great, more recently less so...
records.text: Been with Crunch for nearly 10 years now, and was very pleased with the service. Recently however, I'm seeing more and more issues with their online platform (which is in the process of being redeveloped).Where I got detailed clarifications as to issues in the past, more recently I feel I'm getting evasive excuses.Feels like the staff are less knowledgeable, the system more complex and buggy than before...My concern is that I am no longer fully trusting the accuracy of the data in the system.I really hope Crunch can recover this, they are a good company.

records.title: OK accountants, bad upsell on final accounts
records.text: I joined Crunch 3 years ago after being recommended by a friend (Crunch operates a referral bonus scheme). Over the years I've reported a few bugs on their website with one affecting my ability to invoice (bad tax calculation). After deciding to liquidate, I was pressed to pay extra for faster year-end accounting - as a "plus" subscriber I felt that I'd already paid for this service.Edit: Crunch contacted me and my accounts were finalised within 24 hours. I've updated my rating to reflect that Crunch are better than average and my 3 years with have been OK.

records.title: Great online interface but service gets…
records.text: Great online interface but service gets less slick / reliable once you have to speak to an accountant.

records.title: Where do I begin with this
records.text: Where do I begin with this. I've been with Crunch for a few months now and it has to be the clunkiest software I've ever used.1. There is no option to select 5% VAT on invoices. Which means we have to record the invoice elsewhere. Take the full amount and calculate one portion and charge 20% to get our 5% VAT value then the rest of the transaction is shown charged at zero. How ridiculous is that? Surely you are capable of adding a 5% option to the drop down box?2. If you create an invoice wrong you can't delete it. You then have to find a way to have this rectified to which I'm still waiting a response.3. I was told on sign up that my VAT would be switched to quarterly. After a few weeks I checked with HMRC and it hadn't been done. I have to submit a form to HMRC but wasn't told that when I signed up. It's not a big issue but if I didn't stay on top of it I wouldn't know.4. Reverse charge doesn't work correctly on the Beta desktop so you have to put in the companies VAT number which then shows it outside the scope of VAT. This isn't correct, so I then have to switch back to classic to make sure it has registered correctly.5. We pay £49.50 a month and then have to pay extra for a useless app which doesn't even register the receipts properly. It just shows every transaction as 'Entertainment'. Why is there not an option to select the VAT rate and category?7. There is no Stripe integration meaning every transaction through stripe has about 5 additional unnecessary steps. 8. Every time we query something there is some ridiculous workaround as the system can't process some of the most basic needs that a company has.9. It's slow and clunky and the workflow is terrible. I raise an invoice, then I have to go into banking, find the transaction, create a payment, then it takes me back to banking where I have to find the transaction again to match it.Honestly, if I knew it was going to be like this I would have never have signed up. Although the staff are relatively helpful, they are having to provide solutions which are far too time consuming for a small business. This was supposed to make my life easier, not harder. My time needs to be spent on my business, not messing around on this platform.**Edit**Since my original review Sinann has been in touch numerous times to resolve some issues for me. The fact she has been so persistent is the reason I'm bumping the review up a couple of stars. It's clear that they have a support team who are doing their best to help people.There are still issues with the software, the 5% VAT being a big one and no stripe integration also making a simple transaction a long process. I also think there should be a time limit to delete incorrect invoices. I know you have to read through the invoice and submit it before it's final but it's still very easy to input a wrong number and then have to re-do the whole thing. A simple edit or delete within 15 minutes would be a great feature. I do hope the development team take some of my points on board and make the relevant changes over time.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: They cover the most basic needs such as declaring expenses, recording sales, submitting forms to HMRC and giving you generic advice mostly through blog posts.However, should you need any guidance on your individual needs, you're likely to be on your own:- Crunch won't provide any proactive advice to help you. Your business will be suboptimal.- When you find some tax optimisation on your own, their advice is often incomplete.

records.title: Much improved.
records.text: Much improved since my bank account can now be linked to the Crunch accounting app. I’m not an accountant and feel that Crunch lacks some of the personal guidance and advice when it comes to minimising tax. I’ve just come off a call with a very helpful agent called Andrea who gave me some useful advise on using the Crunch system.

records.title: The website makes you think they're chatbots
records.text: The website makes you think they're generally quite modern and user focused, but more often than not, what you get is circular references, jargon, and incredulity at why you can't understand what they're telling you. If you told me their customer service agents had been replaced by chatbots, you wouldn't surprise me.

records.title: communication continuity
records.text: your person to person correspondence is very Good(I have just talked with George and he is very knowledgeable and helpful)The only problem I find, is your poor communication continuity and follow up . everytime I calls, I have to start my problem a new. I have sent document lot's of time and get asked to send again please keep a client correspondence in one folder for ease of reference. I put it in writing on september 2019 on stopping my subscription but the finance departments still send me invoices and demand payments.

records.title: The staff are certainly helpful but I…
records.text: The staff are certainly helpful but I don't find the system very straightforward to use.When I started using Crunch (one year ago) the bank statements from Barclays were automatically uploaded free of charge.  I now have to pay for this on top of my monthly Crunch fee.

records.title: Expensive for businesses starting out.
records.text: Platform is good although, I had some reconciliation issues when using the free version. Would consider using in future but very expensive for a business in the first 12-months of trading when you are trying to establish yourself. Managed to get digital accounting and in-person advice for around 50% less than what it would have cost me with Crunch.It would be better if they offered a 12-month start-up incentive period, and then move to regular pricing once the business has had a chance to grow and when your accounting needs become more complex.Just my view, but if you have deep enough pockets the product stands up and the team appear to be keen to help.

records.title: Software improvements required
records.text: The Crunch team are friendly and straight forward. They're quick to respond to queries and proactive in advising on upcoming events that will require action. Why 3 stars then?I'd like to see a greatly improved IT interface and also an improved banking interface (currently on a few selected banks have a direct interface). Uploading CSV files, adjusting columns, switching the data top to bottom... This is all nil-value-add work and is time consuming and frustrating. Finally, I'd like to see greater involvement with HMRC. Issues around setting up VAT etc. can take a great deal of time. These are things that I would hope the Crunch team would take greater responsibility over (where they can).

records.title: Not satisfied :(
records.text: The service is not that well recently. It takes several emails before you get replied with a solid response when you have a problem. Also it is getting more expensive. I was happier 2 years ago.

records.title: Great software but not proactive in dealing with your accounts
records.text: I can't fault the online software, it does everything you require to run a LTD company efficiently. What I find lacking is the manner in which your account is managed (or not). For example there was no proactive communications to prepare for year end filings, no emails or phone call from an accountant to discuss what was need to ensure accounts were filed on time. Crunch have advised it will take up to 12 weeks to complete a year end report despite the deadline having passed (our fault for not remembering to get the accounts reconsiled in time), consequently the company must pay fines to HMRC for late filing. Seriously considering moving to an accountant who proactively manages our accounts. Improve your communications with clients and provide proactive support and Crunch has the potential to be a 5 star service. Sadly it is not currently.

records.title: I have been with Crunch for years
records.text: I have been with Crunch for years - really since I set my business up in 2015.  What is made me write today, are the hundreds of fake reviews they have paid for on this site - which I find disingenuous, misleading and unprofessional.   So if you are reading these reviews and thinking of joining Crunch - just be careful.  You don't get multiple 5* ratings on a site like this on the same day for your service - all gushing, give me a break!  Crunch have been fine, good for a micro business/freelance, not so great for a growing business like mine - their payroll and pension service is confusing and priced in a completely opaque way.  Also, all of the feedback on here about them being prompt to get back to you (e.g. same-day) is utter BS - they usually take about 3 days for me - when you call them (for me its usually something payroll related), they are usually 'away from their desk'.  I'm sorry Crunch, I like you - but all these fake reviews - give us a break, we know what you are like really!

records.title: Good service overall
records.text: Good service overall, sometimes the accountants are not helpful and they give you as little information as possible even if you have been with them for few years.

records.title: I was a customer for 4+ years
records.text: I was a customer for 4+ years. Crunch started as a really helpful, responsive and personalised service. You were allocated an Account Manager and customer contact was speedy and often by phone with email being used to confirm in writing and give detailed information. As a customer, you felt like you had a relationship and trusted accountant you could get advice and guidance from and that you were in a safe pair of hands.Now, in 2019, the company has grown, the personalised service has dropped off. It is hard to ask questions and receive email responses. The on-the-day/ next day speedy responses have dropped to it often takes more than 2 days to get a response and you have to chase them. Not great when you're trying to deal with HMRC. This has now happened to me several times. Their online tools are amazingly helpful and second to none. Shame about the actual people service that is now terrible. I've closed my account now as a result of the poor customer contact.

records.title: Actual service different to what was sold
records.text: While most of my experiences with Crunch have been good (clean UI, responses from support within a week etc.) there have been so many bugs, problems and contradictions since I signed up.The product that I was offered during the sales call (a tool which can easily cover companies with GBP and EUR account) just hasn't been realised, and I have to resort to very hacky solutions that I figure out myself to get by. Not only this, but the frequent bugs in the UI mean that I'm unable to just set aside 1 hour per week for accounting as I'd like, as I almost always have to reach out to support and retry once they respond a few days later. On top of this, some of the items I had requested support on just hadn't been completed - for example I requested VAT to be set up in May, only to discover myself in December that this hadn't been completed properly. All the while the price has increased twice while I've been a customer to take even more away from the value.Overall I think this could be a great product/service, I'm just disappointed in the difference between what I was sold and how the tool can work for my business in practice.

records.title: Limited Company Customer
records.text: The service provided by Crunch is okay, but as a client I can only email a generic support line (though granted you can also call in) and often my queries get passed around from one individual to another which can be frustrating. It can sometimes take a while to get a response and I have to chase people up. The service and advice seems somewhat inconsistent in quality - occasionally I've spoken to people that have been extremely helpful, whilst other-times I've been given vague or confusing information. This makes me feel like I'm not really a priority, but this is probably because they are focused on bigger clients and put less resource into smaller clients. For example, it took months for them to set up a payroll for me and I wasted quite a lot of unnecessary time talking to HMRC in the process. The software mostly works well, but occasionally can be glitchy unless you clear cookies/caches. It could also be a little more user-friendly - there are parts of the software that seem to no longer be in use but haven't been removed yet. Overall I'm rating the experience with Crunch as average.

records.title: Declining service.
records.text: I have been a Crunch client for a long time. In the old days, the service was outstanding. Now, when I call the client line, it's never answered, and when I press '1' for a callback, the callback never comes. This has been going on for the last year or so, and it's not good enough. Sharpen up, or I will go elsewhere.

records.title: Very disappointing, recommend considering alternatives
records.text: The crunch platform itself is ok in that it lets you do what you need to but the back-office support is very disappointing. Three things recently have caused me to attempt to cancel. The first was with my annual return. It was 5 months after my year end when I contacted crunch about them helping. I mistakenly believed it was part of my package but found out it would be over £300 for them to help because apparently my period was before I subscribed to crunch. Disappointment number 1 as this is not mentioned anywhere when you sign up.I also say "attempt" to cancel as I have been waiting well over a week for someone to contact me to cancel. The fact you cannot cancel on your own is bad enough, but then when people don't contact you after saying they would it becomes worse. I'm approaching another billing date so will probably get invoiced again. Maybe that's the tactic?I've also found out my account is in arrears after a threatening email from the credit control team. There is no mention of this in my account as there are seemingly no account notifications in platform. And in any case there is also no place I can find to actually update my payment details. Paying £50 odd a month I'm not expecting someone to do it for me, but apparently having access to a customer success manager, you'd think they would be in touch to help before credit control come steaming in with threats to suspend my account.If you need a basic accounting software package crunch might be ok, but if you need any kind of help using it, or managing your accounts I would urge you to consider alternatives as I am very very disappointed.

records.title: Their mistakes have caused a lot of grief
records.text: They have a pretty good day to day system but in the end completely messed up my companies affairs. The case gets passed around between any number of accountants and unqualified staff who seemingly take no notice of history and confidently give wrong advice.They have never apologised for or addressed any of their mistakes which have been expensive to me with time, money and stress when I relied on them to help close my company after moving to Australia.

records.title: Unfortunately the quality of their…
records.text: Unfortunately the quality of their services have been highly reduced. Even when dealing with urgent matters it takes ages to get problems addressed. I don't want to ruin the reputation of Crunch, but I need things done, so I will edit this review as soon they have my issues addressed.

records.title: Great accounting app but not much other support given.
records.text: I have been with Crunch just over a year but unfortunately will be leaving.  I pay over £100 per month and all I feel I get is the use of their app.The app is great but doesn't deal very well with my one foreign transaction per month - something I was upfront about before signing on and I was told it would be fine.  I really feel the accounting support and advice is lacking - I was sent reminders to sign-off my year end accounts but no one told me I could take a dividend.  Now I'm told they will have to refile my accounts which will incur a fee of £100! Very disappointing so I am going to try my luck with another provider for half the price.

records.title: Poor, poor service
records.text: Such a poor, poor service.  It seems unless you complain and jump up and down about the quality of their service you are left to your own devices and expected to deal with things yourself.  I'm not impressed at all with my service.  I have invested a lot of money in Crunch and am constantly toing and froing between different agents and receiving conflicting answers and reports.

records.title: Been using Crunch for 10 years. Frustrating.
records.text: Been using Crunch for 10 years, been progesively getting worse and worse.  Have real problems with there app, it doesn't work and more often or not ends up in a needless phone call and a work around.  The attitude of the advisors (not all) is rude when you have a problem. My bank account still doesn't sync with there system after repeated calls.  I'm done with Crunch time to find a new accountant. 2 stars as they weren't always this bad.

records.title: Absolutely not recommended
records.text: - advisors have mismanaged my (fairly straightforward) situation- a *lot* of time was spent on my side trying to make sense of it. If it wasn't for my efforts, they would have submitted a wrong self assessment, resulting in fines from HMRC- fairly clunky process and effort required on the users' side for 'reconciling' transactions (meaning you'll have to edit CSVs in a very manual , tedious way)- several advisors have often been dismissive, condescending, and provided unclear or wrong advice- not followed up to emails, or took several days (if not weeks) to solve very basic issues- in my experience, the website itself has not been particularly reliable, nor the most user friendly

records.title: Unreliable and disappointing
records.text: I'm giving them 2 stars because the system is fairly easy to use and the accountants are good, however unfortunately I feel let down by Crunch in a number of ways.Pros: Easy to get set up with if you're just starting out and the accountants are knowledgeable.Cons: Asked them to to do my company accounts, was told an 8 week turnaround time was the best they could do which I paid extra for, they delivered this late and I had to push to get any answers and get the accounts. I also told them my deadline for filing which they ignored. This caused me a lot of stress and I had to push to get any kind of refund as they did not meet their terms of service - even after explaining all this they then only offered me £50 as an apology (I cancelled my subscription after this).Zero onboarding help given, felt they just wanted to sell me the subscription and after that I was on my own. Everything goes through the account managers who repeatedly gave me wrong information - they're friendly but they don't seem to know anything about the service. The accountants are knowledgeable but good luck actually getting to speak to one.I've also just found out they've been charging me monthly since I cancelled my subscription. Nowhere in the termination instructions did it mention I needed to cancel the direct debit and I'm still waiting on my refund :/Summary: Avoid - unreliable, disorganised and disappointing service overall

records.title: I have been using Crunch for 10 years…
records.text: I have been using Crunch for 10 years and it is getting worse and worse.  I think their accounting team is becoming more unreliable by the day or just not interested in dealing with our queries. My self-assessment was done by Crunch and their calculations showed that I had overpaid and will be refunded a good amount. However, HMRC informed me that I have due tax with me. I asked for more details and asked for help with Crunch team. But I have been working with them for over a month and it is still going on. Unless you write some harsh email they don't response at all.

description:
Atheneum is a leading global insights platform servicing various clients including distinguished strategy consulting firms,  renowned investment houses and well known global corporations. 

Our mission is to provide faster insights to empower our clients’ decision making. Through our AI capabilities we accelerate the decision-making of our clients by connecting them to the world's top professionals and industry leaders. 

Atheneum is growing rapidly, with 600+ professionals in 11 offices across the US, South America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia.

records.title: Effective and Balanced Communication
records.text: The team at Atheneum knew how to reach out to me effectively. They were courteous and communicated very clearly. They struck a good balance between official channels (e.g., LinkedIn) and unofficial ones (e.g., WhatsApp).

records.title: A very simple process A+
records.text: It is a very simple process and easy people to work with that are friendly and informative and follow up.   I got paid, had fun doing the calls, and am looking forward to doing more.

records.title: Perfect!
records.text: I can recommend Atheneum and their way to work with experts and advisory roles. Brilliant scheduling and uncomplicated invoicing services. Well done!

records.title: A top-notch consulting services!
records.text: I have had a very positive experience. The team is highly professional, and their approaches are clear and well-structured. I am extremely satisfied with their services and would highly recommend them to anyone seeking top-notch consulting services.

records.title: Great professionalism with clear terms…
records.text: Great professionalism with clear terms of agreement spelled out. Interview conducted in blinded manner which reduce biases and unnecessary doubts. Fast reply.

records.title: This experience was disappointing

records.text: The payment needs to come much faster, waiting 3-4 weeks is too long when your competitors are doing it within a couple of days.

records.title: Poor communication of the day and time…
records.text: Poor communication of the day and time of the meeting.  The email arrived while i was asleep 2am (your agent did not recognize the time difference). records.title: Confusing call objectives
records.text: The stated subject of the client call kept switching back and forth between two very different businesses.  A quick google search by the client could have most of what I was first asked and as soon as the second subject was discussed the call ended.  Given the amount of prep work I did for the call I was sorely disappointed on how short it was.  The people with whom I dealt at Atheneum were professional and I was paid promptly.

records.title: Painful and unfocused
records.text: While Atheneum is probably the best in its kind of crowd-consulting firms, the experience with them has dropped as they have grown. I am now repeatedly contacted for opportunities that have nothing to do with my experience. So much so, that I mostly hesitate to even read their emails - as mostly it’s a waste of time. Often different people are chasing the same engagement- so you can have multiple people chasing you for the same engagement. Also payment - while it’s always done - takes a lot of time too.

records.title: Over promise but slow on back side
records.text: Heavy, sell and push upfront with a lot of demands and time limits and then slow processing with an inaccurate information on the payment process. One representative not know what the other one was promising. Payment did finally come through at the maximum a processing time, not clear at the initial promise.

records.title: Nice people to deal with

records.title: Use your expertise for free
records.text: Had a consulting call once that went well and got paid as agreed. But for over a year now - they send out requests with “qualifying questions” and NEVER return with a paid consulting call. They basically extract all the essential knowledge for the assignment out of these qualifying questions for free.

records.title: Pokémon
records.text: This company bombards you with emails for the same opportunity on a daily basis. Then when you respond submitting your capabilities you rarely hear anything back. When you do, they dramatically reduce your day rate and then try to pay you pro-rata per minute rather than per hour. When you insist on being paid per hour suddenly the consulting opportunity is cancelled. I think the staff are paid to collate experts and when they find the one they need they don’t care about the rest.

records.title: Please beware
records.text: They keep writing from different email addresses. However, previous conversations are not followed up, and people pretend this is not something they should take care of. I wonder if that is a kind of scam or something similar. Or probably it is a recruitment company (which it claims as untrue, apparently) building a database of experts. Who knows.

records.title: Getting too many irrelevant requests.
records.text: Getting too many consultation requests that are in no way relevant to my area of expertise. Its obvious the personnel contacting me are not reading or understanding my biography.

records.title: On clarity regarding topics of consultations
records.text: In general, I do not have interest in consultations for the honoraria but in order to share my expertise if I consider the topic of the consultation important &/or if I can myself learn from the experience. Thus the topic is key to my decision whether or not to take a consultation. While I appreciate that it may not be possible to provide this information in precise detail before I commit, the description for this consultation was very misleading: there is a happy medium. I can provide more detailed information if necessary.

records.title: Reasons of discrepancy of the meeting
records.text: If I could mention the reasons at your side, there might be two. One is that I thought your company doesn’t understand my business experience well. I had been with foreign capital companies for 29 years, but it was corporate management, marketing and sales, not system nor IT. Other reason was content of introductory email of certain session. It was quite vague and lack of concrete issues. I hope we can keep better relationship continuously.Thanks,Kanji

description:
We are it’seeze, a creative web design company offering clients throughout the UK and Ireland professionally designed, easy to edit, and affordable websites with ongoing local support.

Our expert website consultants are based nationwide, and we pride ourselves on the personalised service we are able to provide our clients with as a result. Working with small to medium sized businesses from every industry, we design brilliant, one of a kind websites that really make a difference.

Fine to pay the design fee in advance but to then take the service charge for a service that is not usable does not seem fair or good practice.  What has been provided so far does seem quite good [edit] in terms of quality, however it is not great value for money as you pay for the design fee upfront and also the service charges from the outset. records.title: perhaps a bridge too far ...?
records.text: it'seeze created a basic website for me in 2017. As a basic site it worked well. 5 months ago we started work on opening one 'hidden' shop page, and adding another shop page (in order to serve both trade and retail customers) - we are still no further forward with the launch of the new site and frustration is increasing daily. Covid has of course intervened, but the developer has been working from home and in regular contact. Last week I was promised immediate progress and as of today (Wednesday)  progress is an 'as soon as possible' response. How soon will that be? I don't like leaving negative feedback but if a task is beyond the capabilities of the people offering a service, it would have been far better to have known that fact 5 months ago. I have left positive feedback for it'seeze before, and will do again if and once this problem has been resolved to my satisfaction. I am losing business opportunities daily.

records.title: I wouldn’t recommend
records.text: Based on my own experience I wouldn’t recommend it’seeze. It’s been quite a stressful experience overall. I don’t know whether I had a junior designer to do my website but there were a lot of inconsistencies and back and forths to fix basic things that one would expect to be done right in the first place. records.title: Immediate payment without SMS or smartphone

It allows me to shop without SMS or smartphone App. Finally a payment provider that I can use to shop internationally without transfer fees from a European bank account and without using SMS or smartphone app. A telephone number is only required for registration. (Technically, a landline number will work, I tested it, but is not recommended because of the risk of losing access when moving.) Afterwards you can define and use a secret PIN (6 digits) in combination to email (similar to when withdrawing from an ATM).Skrill belongs to the Paysafe group. It offers Rapid Transfer service to transfer money from a bank Account with a TAN and bank details. Head quarters seem to be located in Ireland, which is EU. I tried the service and I can pay and transfer money to my Skrill account immediately. I was able to buy GOG games directly. I am also testing the direct wire transfer method. The money should arrive in two days but the wire transfer was really the most unusable way to handle it, requiring me to find additional information about Skrill in the Internet (maybe because of my bank).If you want to store and use 500€ or more, you need to verify yourself with a ID card photo and your address. This is fine. They try to prevent money laundering. They say they encrypt the photo. I only need small payments for shopping anyways.I also tested PaysafeCards successfully in the past. (They require SMS when you surpass 50 or 100€ in transfers in a month.)I have not tested the support. They are explicitly using the laws and court of Ireland. After all, a 4.5 stars rating from me.

records.text: I took the opportunity to buy cryptocurrency that skrill app offers. After buying, I placed a limit order to sell. records.title: my bank account was double charged issue was resolved but it took a lot of time
records.text: my bank account was double charged by skrill while making an int'l transfer which i noticed in my monthly bank statement. i immediately contacted skrill through the chat option in the app and was assured someone would get back to me within 48 hours. this wasn't true as if took 4 or 5 days for them to contact me on my email after which i had to explain everything in detail to them with attached proofs. they told me they would respond within 24 hours which again wasn't true. they replied after 7 days saying indeed there was a mistake on their end and that my account would be refunded in a few days. i got back money eventually which is great work by them but the response time is atrocious to say the least.

records.title: Exchange rate somehow exploitative
records.text: I like the instant withdraw of funds. Easy verification. Also, they should not stay with someone's money after blocking them - there should be a way to allow the client withdraw their funds. As such, their exchange rate is exploitative, which makes their business somehow unethical.

records.title: Poor Response Time for Skrill Transfer Issue
records.text: I would like to share my experience regarding the support I have received for my Skrill money transfer issue.The case was opened on October 6th, 2024, and despite my repeated follow-ups, there has been no resolution or response from the support team. My payment has still not been credited, even though it’s already been 4 days since the transaction was deducted from my account.Here’s a timeline of events from my side:October 6th, 2024: Case opened with a complaint that the deposit was not received, even though the transaction was completed from my side.October 8th, 2024: Followed up, but no update or progress.October 10th, 2024: I reached out again as I have not received any response.This lack of communication and delay in resolving the issue is very frustrating. Usually, transfers are quick and resolved within an hour, but this case has taken much longer than expected.2 Star as It used to be good before scaming.

records.title: Extremely high fees!
records.text: I have only been using Skrill for a short time, so haven't encountered problems yet, but their fees are just huge! Paying with the card in a different currency meant losing 4.5% as commission; this is the highest I have ever seen. Not even paypal charges that much, and they are like the golden standard in unlimited greed.Unfortunately their competition, even though has better prices, is less reliable; I hope some new players will enter this market soon to make it more competitive.

records.text: Lets start with the good. The customer service is good, they are patient when you are setting up and always happy to help but from the very beginning I realised the Eposnow system is clunky and definitely not smooth. You find yourself working out quick routes to these issues because you just do. One issue in particular being the label printer. It never worked properly but when you are naive you just assume its a one off. Constantly eats through reels of labels without printing the correct text, doesnt connect with the till, requiring to recollaborate/turning off and on. Until eventually we were told it needed to be sent back and as it was a third party product we would have to pay £50 for its repair. We had it 3 months. and it was still in warranty. Well at this point I had decided we had wasted way too much energy on this and brought a Phomemo printer on Amazon for £37. Its perfect. Once the contract finishes we will Eposnow we will most definitly look elsewhere or just do everything on an app as I think these Epos systems are overkill for what we require and cost way too much.
