records.text: I have had quite a traumatic experience with Eposnow when I tried to open a second till system with them. It was quite a problem getting a second KDS stuck onto my account, for unknown reasons. Eventually I got through to a guy called Keir, and he was no way 2nd tier the way he handled the situation and sorted my problem out within 15mins after I had a stressful full 10 days just trying to get the second KDS stuck on. After this experience always remember, the sales staff are not interested in you once they have got you over the line and big companies like this do not have the personal touch. Very robotic and sticking to their instructed work parameters.

records.title: Its a mystory
records.text: Despite checking with someone else my query was not resolved and the reason given was incorrect. Our till showed as being opened at 9.53 when i 100% guarantee it was opened before 9am and was correctly closed the previous day. The sales were recorded in the back office but not included in the EOD printout. Also the till wasnt touched in or around 9.53. I would be interested if any off your boffins can explain this, i personally have a fairly good knowledge of the till system now and could not come up with an answer, hence checking the camera to insure no EOD had been done thus having to open the till again

records.title: STAY AWAY FROM CAREPLAN
records.text: The system isn't too bad. Its able to do pretty much whatever you'll need it for. Make sure to stay away from the 17 euro insurance on the hardware. I have been with eops now for three years and I've had an issue with the monitor.It turns out your warranty will only be valid for one year but they will keep taking the 17 euro out of your account every month regardless of the hardware being out of warranty so they have taking an extra 400 euro on me over the months. Then when you cancel it they will try say it is necessary for you to keep paying it even though they wont cover ANYTHING

records.title: Our Initial training call
records.text: Our Initial training call was disconnected after less than 15 minutes and Taliah failed to call us back! it then took us quiet a while to get through to reconnect with her only to be told she was on another call.  However Callum Guy who had answer our call was very helpful and assisted us with getting logged in and getting the system ready to import data.

records.title: Not for me.
records.text: Medium service given, faulty till due to lack of updates which no one seems to manage or maintain even though we pay service fee and other made up fees added on, we never hear from this company. I think I have called them twice in 2 years and all I recieve is numerous emails asking to rate my experience to this day. Not a good business relationship so i would not recommend to others.Account number 0376977479

records.title: While EuraDell is more than friendly it…
records.text: While EuraDell is more than friendly it took us several weeks to finally achieve what we wanted.  This was not any fault of hers as it didn't relate to her specific job duties, but she was my only point of contact and nothing she tried until today worked.  By that I mean, no one she tried placing me in contact with would return m call or email.  Thank you EuraDell for being persistent!

records.title: I thought things were going well
records.text: I thought things were going well, but now have started to have second thoughts. They are charging me more than the price I agreed, and the training has been painful to say the least. Almost 2 weeks later I am still not in a position to take payments. I am sorry I cannot recommend Epos NowAccount 0377296267

records.title: Very friendly & helpful
records.text: Very friendly & helpful, resolved my issues in good time and confirmed I was happy. However, the backgroud noise of others chatting is horrific. It made it difficult to have a clear conversation while having to keep asking the lady to repeat herself. Service great 5* Background noise not so much 2*

records.title: Will they answer the phone???
records.text: Don't know if Epos will answer the phone or not. This time they actually did. Have had a hard time getting in touch with customer service for several months. I got through fairly quickly this time. However, the company they recommended for our credit card service (EVO payments) was having an outage and they weren't answering phone calls either. It took a couple of hours before we were able to take credit cards. This is tough these days, when most of our transactions are with credit/debit cards.

records.title: Product adding Training sessions
records.text: So far going well with the training. With this EPOS system, good and quality trainers matters a lot. Otherwise we will lost completely.Currently I am doing training from Sharaz! He is very professional and explain topics in details. I recommend him for the training.

records.title: Slow and glitchy
records.text: Slow and glitchy. Often it just doesn't work, but when it does, it's OK. So many times you are trying to get on with business and complete a task, and you are stuck there wasting time watching the waiting-wheel spin round, and often you get the message that 'something went wrong', and your work is lost. It's not great. It's Ok, but not great.

records.title: We have had EPOS Now for over 2 years…
records.text: We have had EPOS Now for over 2 years and while it has a lot of neat features and the monthly costs are quite reasonable, we find the system a source of frequent aggravation because it is entirely internet / cloud based and everything we do locally has to be synced with the cloud for the changes to show up on our till. Furthermore, there is no offline option for inventory management, which can be a real pain when the internet is down. Keep this in mind if your business is located in an area where internet reliability can be an issue. The quality of support used to be terrible but it has improved a lot over the past year, so that is a plus.

records.title: Good service but lengthy escalation process and lots of re-explaining
records.text: The process took a long time to complete and there were a number of delays along the way, but once Euradell took over the case things went great! Overall the escalation process takes too long but the service providers after that are great

records.title: Poor Communications About Stock
records.text: Training not attended by Epos Now after booking it with me. Several emails sent to the trainer no response. Till drawers arrived but no tills. Logged a ticket. No response. Called and the operator couldn’t contact despatch. Promised a call back in 10 minutes. Still waiting 3 hours later. Tried calling and nobody available. Requested a call back via the options. Really poor.***Amended to 3 star. I finally got through to a phone agent who was brilliant. He arranged delivery of an older version till in the interim, whilst awaiting my till delivery which was out of stock(this was the first person to tell me it was out of stock). Also training have stepped up their contact, however now being live it is a little difficult to attend. It's a shame I wasn't just told earlier the tills were out of stock and a substitute could be sent. I would have given 5 stars for coming to me with a solution. Good turnaround though.

records.title: We had a failure Saturday so no card…
records.text: We had a failure Saturday so no card machine and no till. No one to help either side both blamed the other was absolutely useless. Busy Saturday no help was told no one available not enough staff. Monday morning this morning the guy at Epos could not be more helpful sorted it all out and we up and running. If we had spoken to guy that was on this morning would have been 5 star.

records.title: Phone support needs to go back to how it was
records.text: Cant contact anyone on the phone, sends you to automated webchat. nowhere to raise a ticket.The remainder of my complaint has been dealt with regarding billing and tills kicking  me outI have been a long standing customer for 4 years now and think the only downside is they have removed phone support pretty much. It need sto go back to the old way

records.title: What went wrong twice in less than six months.
records.text: What went wrong? The same thing as last time. The POS stops talking to the cc reader. So far, this has happened twice in the less than six months we have owned them.  I know I need stronger internet but I have what is available to to me at this time. And I don't understand why it works just fine and then at the 2 mo. mark it stops. I was put through to several technicians, who tried to help. But there were long dead silences at the other end. So were they concentrating or simply sitting there watching the clock go round until they felt it was reasonable to say I don't know what's going on but I tried. Needless to say I'm not impressed with the system so far. Still haven't figured out the backside. either.

records.title: Integration with Xero failing
records.text: Continuing problems with EposNow integrating with Xero. It either doesn't work at all, or requires a manual resync.EposNow keep promising to resolve the problem but seem unable to do so. Hugely frustrating and disappointing that such a basic requirement seems impossible to achieve.

records.title: No Support - Steer clear
records.text: Overall our experience has been pretty terrible.  They are incredibly difficult to get a hold of.  We have been misled with our contract terms and fees.  We cant even get responses on our cancellation queries.  Very poorly managed in Australia.Update -they requested more information, still no response.  Will be going to the Ombudsman/ACCC now, ive been given no choice.UPDATE - 21/10Have sent my 4th email with no response.  No response to this feedback either.

records.title: Thus far unimpressed!!
records.text: I was promised training and a better service than our previous till company, so far one week in I’m wholly unimpressed. Trying to contact someone takes in excess of 30 minutes on hold. Asked for a callback from a manager and, despite promises of a call in 30 minutes etc.. still no call nearly an hour later. Training has been non existent, after a week we have learnt next to nothing and had to figure stuff out for ourselves. Till system still not live and in use over a week later. Not what I was expecting at all.

records.title: We had printer issue with our EPOS…
records.text: We had printer issue with our EPOS system. It wouldn't print after the transactions was paid for. So if someone wanted a receipt after they paid we couldn't give them one. It took 5 months to be resolved.  We would go several weeks with no updates. Calls and emails would not be returned. Very frustrating since we have a very busy seasonal business.  We finally are up and running properly. But it was a very stressful summer trying to run a business without a POS system that worked correctly.

records.title: No resolve payment provided for difference in payouts vs our sales
records.text: We had sent the detailed excel sheet about difference in payouts vs our sales.However no resolve / solution to this critical matter had been provided.To the contrary we received email stating that ticket is closed?? while we were not informed about any resolve and no information provided whether we will receive the difference in the payout vs our sales and when we will receive it??

records.title: Gave a month's notice to close our…
records.text: Gave a month's notice to close our account as required, account not closed for another 2 months and took 3 phone calls after the date of promised refund to receive the refund. Everyone was really polite and helpful on the phone but always waiting g on someone higher up for approval

records.title: Long term problem with reporting
records.text: We have used EPOS now for many years without complaint but this year an essential report (stock changes) failed and despite many calls to support and promises to escalate to critical, the report is still not working.Finally today a very helpful assistant informed us that it was a known major issue which was being being worked on, but this is after months of awareness of the system failure

records.title: No communication
records.text: Constantly sending me emails that I have a failed payment , I have 3 accounts and there are no other issues with those . Epos have admitted they have an issue with HSBC but still send emails .Spoken to 6 different people all say they will contact me, still waiting!!  I can’t take a risk of them stopping my back office because of their error Looking at other alternatives.Until November 23 they were Ok . Communication seems to be an issue and don’t understand customers

records.title: The terminal in one shop worked
records.text: The terminal in one shop worked. But the terminal in the other shop didn't. It looks like these 2 terminals are attached or in sync with each other that one breaks down and the other works, or vice versa. If the card terminal doesn't work in the other shop, the other card terminal works in another.  Right now, my whole terminal is not working. it is saying check the internet connection, but I do have my internet working, otherwise, I wouldn't be able to send this message.

description:
Xero is a global small business platform with 3.95 million subscribers which includes core accounting, payroll, workforce management, expenses and projects. Xero also has an extensive ecosystem of connected apps and connections to banks and other financial institutions, helping small businesses access a range of solutions from within its open platform to help them run their business and manage their finances. Xero is a FIFA Women’s Football partner.
About Xero accounting software 
Xero provides small business owners, accountants and bookkeepers with powerful online accounting software and access to up-to-date financial data. It’s designed to make life better for small businesses, their advisors and communities around the world. It connects businesses with their bank, their advisor, accounting tools, payment services and third-party apps, so everything is securely available at any time, on any device.Benefits for small businesses
Xero’s beautiful, easy-to-use small business accounting software automates and streamlines many day-to-day tasks, including bank reconciliation, quoting, invoicing, making and collecting payments, tax, managing employees, expenses, projects and payroll. Businesses can view  up-to-date numbers on the Xero dashboard, in reports, and in analytics. It’s easy for businesses to see how they’re tracking, stay in control of cash flow and make informed decisions.

records.title: Was online and got good prompt response…
records.text: Was online and got good prompt response at Xero Support.  Hopefully David was a real person and not an AI bot but who knows.

records.title: I just want to say a massive thank you…

records.title: My experience with Billy was absolutely…
records.text: My experience with Billy was absolutely fantastic. He was able to resolve the issue in minutes

records.title: Reliable, easy to use, good connectivity and support
records.text: We have been using Xero since 2018 and found it to be a fantastic tool in invoicing customers, keeping track of our bills and filing our VAT returns. It's also easy to use and has a number of ready made reports that you can edit if required. Be good to see a report builder added.  The online forums are very helpful and the Xero team will get back to you promptly if you have any problems that you can't find the answer for on the forums. We have added the Payroll function to our subscription and would like to see the inventory module added for the UK customers to be able to manage our stock also. All round a great product.

records.title: We contacted Xero Support to seek advice of reducing our sales inovice template to 1 page
records.text: We contacted Xero Support to seek advice on how to improve our sales invoice.Robyn from Xero came up with 2 great suggestions . We proceeded with one of the suggestions which invoice re-format the template (i.e removing unnecessary wording and spacesDara was so helpful in helping us create the new template so quickly and uploading it ,

records.title: 5star support
records.text: 5star support, I had two tickets open for two different team and the persons I spoke with were extremely knowledgeable and helpful.Got my issues sorted, both of them. Thank you for the super support.

records.title: Xero needs to work on Xero Workpapers
records.text: Xero needs to work on Xero Workpapers.  I would like to see workpapers rather than just places to attach documents.

records.title: Xero invoice emails vs fraudulent email…
records.text: Xero invoice emails vs fraudulent email contentXero has ensured that its invoices come from a single email address and they've supported that with Domain Keys Identified Mail (DKIM). This means they've protected the MEDIUM of the invoice, not the invoice itself.Xero cannot protect us from fraudulent invoices. This is impossible for Xero or any other similar service. A bad actor can set up an account and create fraudulent invoices, and have Xero distribute them.Unfortunately, we, the invoice recipients, cannot blacklist the Xero invoice email address without also blocking the good invoices.I don't have a solution.

records.title: Reasonably timely response to original…
records.text: Reasonably timely response to original query. The People were kind and courteous but ultimately the fix was bigger than we could achieve quickly so there was no 'solve' I decided to work around the problem rather than let Xero fix it.

records.title: Expense Claims Reconciliation
records.text: I received a phone call from Xero as he felt it would easier to explain verbally than writing it down. The phone call came relatively quickly. While his accent took me a little while to get used to, he was patient and knew his subject. So I appreciated that.

records.title: Once I received a direct call from xero…
records.text: Once I received a direct call from xero support the help was awesome

records.title: First class service with our billing issue…
records.text: First class service with our account manager who dealt with our issue in the background and the agent that then dealt with our billing issue. Some hiccups prior to an one on one meeting but once listened to. Xero were fully appreciative of our issue and resolved it. Sometimes it is better to ask for a one on one meeting or call as I did than sending many emails via Xero central. Remember everyone deserves respect and emails can get misconstrued.

records.title: Good but not perfect
records.text: Xero is pretty good, but it’s not perfect. My company has been using Xero for over 10 years. It does pretty much everything we need but the ways I feel it needs to be improved are:1. The user permissions need more granular customisation. I have been forced to grant an employee full admin access in order to provide the functions that this employee needs, but there are a number of full admin features that I do not wish to give out to employees. That’s a big flaw.2. It sometimes feels very difficult to find certain features. Usually features we don’t need to use every week, more occasional features. I’m usually left scratching my head struggling to find the thing I’m looking for. So I feel navigation and user experience could be improved significantly if Xero invested in this and perhaps had some independent third party testing done.3. There are features in the desktop version that do not exist in the mobile app. This can be very frustrating at times.4. Adding receipts manually is slow. I bet with a bit of effort Xero could develop a tool that allows a user to upload a batch of receipts and have Ai connect them to the relevant transactions. That would be smart.So it’s good but it could be better, in my opinion.

records.title: Support was prompt
records.text: Support was prompt, but I had to submit the request online then wait for 3 hours to receive a reply, which was helpful. Obviously it would be better if there was a number you could call to get instantaneous support, like Aussie Broadband for example, but nevertheless it was still good enough.

records.title: The issue was successfully resolved…
records.text: The issue was successfully resolved with the assistance from support. However the customer statement function needs to be modified so that the report can be viewed and filtered on screen.

records.title: I had a problem with a pay run not…
records.text: I had a problem with a pay run not finalising because of a bank issue - turns out it was a quick fix as the bank account had disappeared in the settings.  Very quick response.  However, I am not happy with the new version of invoicing.  I do the books for a caravan park and have to create an invoice for each day for the eftpos total.  I enter each receipt and keep an eye on the total to ensure I am balancing. It is difficult in the new system because the screen is too large and I need to move the screen to see the total.  It just seems like it has gone backwards with the invoicing, very disappointing.

records.title: easier too use once you get your head around having to do less.
records.text: The system is different to off-line systems for example the ‘Split’ method of part paying bills or invoices.  This takes a little working out but once you get your head around it it is not too bad.The reconciliation system is also easy once you find your way around.The ability to let your accountant look at the figures is also good.

records.title: Good invoicing system but pricey
records.text: + Easy to synch with bank accounts+ Accountant can access+ Simple to invoice and track payments- Not intuitive to use or access data - often have to ask accountant for advice on how to do/find things- Very little support available except through users’ forum - Very pricey compared to other providers with frequent increases and extra charges for everything e.g.billing in USD

records.title: Xero has had an unbelievably positive…
records.text: Xero has had an unbelievably positive affect on our business. Right now we only have 2 of the 4 accounts we want added to the profile. My 2 Co-operative accounts have not been easy to add as if probably uploaded a document 3 or 4 times and there has been absolutely no progress. This definitely hurts the experience as it just adds more work for us to do as the days go on that it isnt added.

records.title: Stripe payment duplicating invoices
records.text: An issue arose where the payments received via Stripe for VAT cash accounting created a duplicate invoice.  As far as I know, no warning has been given by Xero about this.  Once the issue had been identified, the email exchange failed to remedy the situation.  We then went on to the telephone support segment, which ultimately resolved the issue, but only after guidance from us, as initially the suggested remedies would have created more problems.

records.title: Incredibly helpful Advisor
records.text: I was having issues with our Xero Hubdoc User connections.  I requested a call back and received one from a lady called Grace.  She was amazing, she listened and 'got it' easily resolving the problem with Hubdoc.  The only reason I gave 4 stars is because I then had two less helpful calls from Xero who didn't get it at all!

records.title: Help for a non-smartphone user
records.text: Not having a smart phone I experienced some difficulty in logging on to my account without one - but a Xero lady agent talked me through the process of obtaining entry to the site. So I can recommend their telephone service for taking the pains to help me, an elderly user. Overall a good experience and our business relies on them for managing our staff payments. Thank you, Xero!

records.title: Eventually, was excellent...
records.text: The telephone assistance was brilliant - thank you Matt - once we got to that point. But I did have a battle getting there, as the messages over previous days made me feel incompetent and I don't think my messages were read.  That being said, Matt had clearly reviewed all the problems I had experienced before he rang and was able to take everything on board. Excellent service, thankyou Matt. More of that standard, please!

records.title: Xero Central Help
records.text: Xero have a system of raising a query with them and waiting for someone to get back to you which works very well indeed.  The staff have all been polite, very knowledgeable, patient and friendly. The only thing that could be better would be to have a dedicated telephone helpline.

records.title: The depth the Trainer went into of the…
records.text: The depth the Trainer went into of the package was good, however I am still awaiting the recording of the session which took place Tuesday / Wednesday last week - Xero Setup for your Business.  You do not appear to have a Live Chat and the confirmation comes via a "noreply" e mail address

records.title: Sunny was really helpful so 5/5 for him…
records.text: Sunny was really helpful so 5/5 for him which prompted this review.The reason I left off a star is because xero has recently changed the layout of pages without any choice in defaulting back. From discussions and threads I've read customers are becoming frustrated with these changes as am I.  So as with any accounting system be aware that at any time things can change and ultimately we have no control over how our information is laid out to us.

records.title: I still prefer the old style invoice
records.text: I still prefer the old style invoice.   In the new style If I enter a product, and then have edit and search for another size or colour, it does not show the list of products in that product code, it only shows the one currently on the invoice then lists other products with different codes underneath.  I have to delete and add again to search the list for the correct product.   This is a real pain.

records.title: Arun was a great help and managed to…
records.text: Arun was a great help and managed to resolve my issue over the phone. However, it took too long for my liking to get to this point. Getting support directly should be made much easier. In as much as there are  a lot of sign posting FAQs, sometimes misunderstanding one instruction can get you going round in circles and when you want expert intervention you want it immediately because of busy schedules and the need to resolve issues immediately. Sometimes we just don't have time to be reading through an entire article and even after reading some FAQs one still fails to resolve the problem. Hence I'm not happy with the time it took to resolve the problem, however it was resolved eventually.

records.title: I don't like the fact my price has gone…
records.text: I don't like the fact my price has gone from £4 to £36! Customer service is awful if I'm honest and I will be looking at different accounting apps moving forward

records.title: If thinking of signing up, be very wary of their incoming invoicing system
records.text: Difficult to know exactly how to score Xero at present. My company has been using Xero for around 6 or 7 years and have always been very happy with it. I would have given it 5 stars as it has always perfectly met our needs. However, currently they are introducing a new invoicing system that seems absolutely terrible. I have been trying to use it for months (you currently have the choice) and I honestly cannot find one redeeming feature with the new system. It more than doubles my daily invoicing time! I am now choosing to use the old system again but when that choice goes in February, I will be considering changing to another software provider and will be changing this review to a one. Very sad and totally unnecessary change to a wonderful product which smacks of someone justifying their position in their development dept by pushing through a big and terrible change.

records.title: I have been Xero customer for a long…
records.text: I have been Xero customer for a long time and like the software but they just keep increasing the monthly fee way beyond what I feel is reasonable.   Increases started out small but they just keep getting bigger and bigger.   I feel like customers don’t matter.   I am looking to move to another accounting package.

records.title: It's decent accounting software and…
records.text: It's decent accounting software and from a functionality point of view I have no complaints. However, they've been increasing the price pretty steadily since I've started using it and it's almost double what it was originally.

records.title: Great product but endless above inflation price increases ...
records.text: Endless price increases... We are a small business and have been affected by a drastic series of Xero subscription price increases since we signed up back in 2020 £5 a month to £16 of today with at least 2 price increases in the last year or so. These increases are over and above inflation and have a big impact on small companies like us. It does make us feel vulnerable as we are committed to them because of our relationship with our accountancy firm. Whilst there are many genuine price inflations which businesses must pass onto their customers, there are others who I feel are not being really fair to their customers. I have resulted to submitting this review as there was nothing coming up under "complaint process" in Xero. I have been in touch with our accountant (who also struggles to get any feedback from Xero) since to look at other options we can consider if future increases become unsustainable.

records.title: Non Reliable - Outages
records.text: The amount of times Xero has had outages, usually at the most important lodgments dates. Whether it be full or partial. My business works solely on xero therefore where its down it is a cost to the business as my staff are unable to work and are paid to sit and wait, or log in on days off or after hours to get work down by date dates. Very costly and inconvenient.   Improvement where not required are causing too many issues

records.title: Just been forced to use the new Invoice…
records.text: Just been forced to use the new Invoice layout. What a load of utter rubbish, designed by a developer no less, the old one was clean, simple and clear. This one is badly designed, clunky, overtly complicated, pointless functionality (now two click to select and invoice date) and general a step back, gave 3 stars as the rest is a good package but this aspect is appalling, I am glad in our business we do very few invoices.I am posting this with over 40 years in IT and software design so I do know a bit!

records.title: I still don't find it completely easy…
records.text: I still don't find it completely easy to use as a non-accountant (my accountant loves it but he understands all the terms, etc.). It's definitely easier to use than manual data entry, which is huge, and many of the automation features do save time.However, I really, really wish it was easier to create categories for expenditure and revenue - this was originally on my dashboard but then this disappeared and I don't understand why. If I want to truly see the detail of what my business is doing well selling then this is quite important. I literally spend ages trying to find how to create a new category sometimes and then have to give up because it's so difficult to find it. Surely something like this, that can be so unique to each business, should be easier to edit? It's very frustrating.

records.title: its okay
records.text: its okay - if you need to manage stock/inventory in any details then this isnt the system for you.

records.title: More price increases
records.text: More price increases, shrouded under the auspices of a 'new plan and special discount price'.  A 10.5% increase for no additional functionality.  I thought inflation had dropped to around 2%.  How can a 10%+ increase be justified, and to call it a 'special discount' is insulting and patronising.  Come on Xero how do you expect to maintain a good reputation with decisions like this?

records.title: Not suitable for Tax or Companies House filing
records.text: I can only really comment from the tax point of view. If you are getting Xero to help with corporation tax or Companies House filing...dont bother. They dont produce tax documents or help. What they offer is a specialist who you will have to pay on top of the subscription charge.

records.title: Xero do not listen to their users
records.text: I am a big fan of Xero, but this new invoicing layout that is forced on us is not acceptable. Thousands of users are complaining that this is making their work more and it is time consuming, but Xero do not listen.

records.title: Listen to your customers Xero!
records.text: Xero has gone from a 5 star product to a 3 star product in recent years and I feel I'm being generous with a 3! Really unhappy with the new sales invoicing which is not fit for purpose.  Xero are replacing a good product with inferior with promises that it will improve.  It should not be put forward on the platform until it is indeed an improved version of what we already had.  There have been various 'improvements' made to justify frequent price increases and I am yet to see any benefit from these so called improvements.  Very disappointing that Xero are not listening to their customers who I expect will vote with their feet.

records.title: Increasingly Unreliable
records.text: Despite price increases with promises for a better product, Xero has not delivered!  Xero has never been so unreliable as it has been the last 6 months with regular outages and all around slow performance.  The introduction of the new invoicing is the icing on the cake to look for an alternative Cloud Accounting platform for some of our cleints.  Xero are intent to ignore customer feedback.

records.title: Not bad but invoicing set up is awful
records.text: Xero use to be incredibly easy to use, but the new invoicing set up is awful. It makes it 10 times harder to use. Really wish they would revert back to the old style. Other than that, it’s relatively user friendly, and has all the functions you would expect/need out of an accounting programme.

records.title: Not what was expected.
records.text: I was not provided with an acceptable answer having raised the query originally nearly 4 months ago. the issue is a major one to us as a user.

records.title: Difficult to make contact, great once you do!
records.text: My generation did not grow up with computers and so I found it very frustrating not being able to either phone or email for help. When I finally worked out how to make contact I got a message saying I was not permitted to invite Xero to help! That being said I ploughed on and managed to open a case and received very clear and helpful advice that helped me resolve the issue. I have only given 3 stars because of the difficulty making contact, the actual help I would have given 5 stars

records.title: Credits are not easy
records.text: I have used Sage for years. Our accountants suggested moving to Xero as it would make my daily accounting life easier/quicker. There are some very good aspects in Xero software, but the main stumbling block for me is credit notes and rebates. A credit note has to be allocated to an invoice, even if an invoice does'nt exist.I process over 50 supplier credit notes a month,  some with no original invoice. Had I known this, I would not have left Sage.

records.title: Useless system to pay supplliers
records.text: I have used this to pay supplliers invoices with mixed results, after eventually paying an invoice about a year ago, I was invited to join which I did only to then be advised I didnt have the relevant permissions to view the invoice. A new supplier recently sent me a couple of invoices using this company, the first went through fine but the second one requested sending validations to our directors phone or email, preventing me making the payment. We dont have time to mess around with companies like this. I will direct our suppliers that we will pay by alternative means only.

records.title: A shadow of their former selves
records.text: We have been Xero partners for almost 10 years. Over this time the company has grown from an exciting new software provider to, as many larger companies become, simply a commodity. Where in the past we would have account managers who would be in touch throughout the year and with top level support from the team, we no longer hear from our account manager unless there is something they wish to sell and the "support" is non existent, particularly if the case is not a standard question which can be answered with the pre-prepared scripted answer. This is despite the subscription cost increasing by over 300% over this time with no discernible increase in the product.On the whole the product works fine as it should in most cases, but where there are issues the support is not fit for purpose.

records.title: Do NOT recommend
records.text: I have been a client of Xero for almost 15 years. I am not a trained bookkeeper but have, until 2024, been able to effectively use the system for bookkeeping, accounting and contact management. With the changes Xero has made to invoicing and the other 'improvements', it is now taking me twice as long to enter info than it did a year ago. The system is so glitchy and slow that it is now a time waster and also creating invoices that are incorrect and confusing to my customers. Xero - stop adding useless features that create difficulty for your users. Ask the users what they really want and need without forcing this nonsense on us. The human users are more important than AI and all the fluff Apps that you want to add. Stay simple and efficient.

records.title: No Interest In Small Businesses
records.text: I have been with Xero for over 8 years, and whilst it had its quirks it worked pretty well for what I needed. However in recent years it just isn't suitable for running a small business with a few staff. Whilst the costs keep increasing, the features continue to decrease (reminds me when Freddos were 10pence). You now can't even enter a bill in USD without paying over £100 per month - just ridiculous. And the integrated HubDoc for bill input is the worst I have used out of 4 different ones.I will be moving over the Christmas period when I have time. No not get trapped.

records.title: You have taken away reasonably priced…
records.text: You have taken away reasonably priced packages for small companies who don't want payroll but need to invoice more than 20 small invoices or input more than 5 bills per month

records.title: New invoicing very slow & glitchy
records.text: we have been using Xero for about 12 years, and we previously found the invoicing feature to be excellent. However, the new system is extremely disappointing. It is very slow, has glitches, and no longer displays stock levels for SKU numbers as the previous version did. It now takes much longer to enter invoices, so, unfortunately, we will be looking for a different system.

records.title: New Invoicing Platform Awful
records.text: as per my post in the Xero Community, the new invoicing platform is awful. Please bring back the simple 'drag & drop' function (like it still is in Bills). The new platform should never have been rolled out in its current state. It was not ready to be unleashed on users. The Xero Community is furious, but Xero do not appear to be listening.

records.title: Won't send invoices
records.text: I've been using Xero for a few years and generally I've been pretty happy. Since the roll out of new invoicing it has been one problem after another. If the issues aren't fixed before they end the use of classic invoicing I'll forced to move elsewhere. Accounting software that can't send invoices isn't very helpful!

records.title: Expensive trash filled with glitches and lack of support
records.text: Xero is one of the most expensive accounting programs yet almost completely lacks support and is riddled with glitches. Yet they have the audacity to constantly increase the price.We run an online organisation that relies on repeating invoices. However due to Xero frequently not saving information in contacts and invoices, quite often errors occur. This happens so often that we have had to pay our accountant more to double check everything we do and even he is having the issue. We  have had to create a process to factor in "Xero Errors" because the software is unreliable.Secondly, their email invoice system is terrible. We regularly get errors back saying the email cannot be delivered to regular customers. These are to emails that we have no issues contacting by our usual server emails.Thirdly, trying to get hold of support for Xero is next to impossible. They force you down a route of useless topics and articles before getting a chance to raise a ticket. Their support has been proven to be so poor that they now have a community of other users using the software all pitching in to help each other out.If you are considering accounting software, DO NOT  use Xero. Choose Myob or one of the modern business accounts that have similar feature built into the business account.

records.title: This is the experience our Office of 6 are having with Xero.
records.text: 14 Days to go till Xero turns off Classic Invoicing. They have made little progress in bringing "New Invoicing" up to speed. It remains, inadequte, time consuming, prone to glitching, easy to make unforced errors in and shambolic in layout. I cannot understand why a Company leading in it's field would willingly SELF DOWNGRADE it's products, ignore longterm users and keep jacking up pricing for an inferior product when compared to the Program we left other Accounting Platforms for all those years ago. When a comapny treats it's loyal Customers with contempt .......they leave.......there will be an exodus no matter what the Xero Bean Counters are telling the elites within.

description: Interface NRM is a UKAS and ASI Accredited Certification Body. We specialise in providing fast, efficient and effective customer-focused Certification. We offer UKAS ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, FSC® and PEFC Certification Services.

records.title: 9001 & 14001 accreditation.
records.text: This is the first time that our company has gone through the accreditation process. Interface carried out the Stage 1 audit remotely and this was so easy. Stage 2 was carried out in-house and they were really helpful and pleasant to work with. We have just received our certification and we would be more than happy to recommend Interface to anyone.

records.title: ISO 45001 audit review
records.text: This is the first time that our company has gone through the accreditation process and Interface were excellent at supporting us and talking through the process, from the initial stage 1 audit to the stage 2 and certificate award. Richard Pickles was our auditor and we couldn't have had a more supportive and friendly auditor! He made the audit process as smooth and painless as possible, and was interested in all of our labs and the processes we have in place. We just received our certificate (an early Christmas present!) and couldn't be happier with Interface. Would happily recommend!

records.title: Interface NRM
records.text: I have never had any previous experience with Interface NRM nor had I any prior participation in the ISO 9001 accreditation scheme. I was pleasantly surprised, having been quite anxious about the process. John Nutchey explained the process and put me at ease. I managed to provide the necessary information and was given ample opportunity to do so. The external audit was efficiently completed and the report returned in a timely fashion.

records.title: A great audit experience
records.text: Experience was great with Interface, team where very helpful and friendly. Audit carried out, very friendly auditor. Would highly recommend

records.title: Excellent service and audit process…
records.text: Excellent service and audit process from Interface, we highly recommend them.

records.title: Great service from Interface
records.text: Interface gave us plenty of notice of the upcoming audit so that we could send appropriate documents prior to it.After the audit and prior to re-certification, they were very helpful in sorting out a couple of issues that arose.We would highly recommend Interface NRM.

records.title: Professional
records.text: They arrive on time and carry out their job in a professional manner but are friendly at the same time. They put you at ease and also provide you with helpful advice and suggestions. Would reccommend.

records.title: Lovely friendly team to work with
records.text: Lovely friendly team to work with, wish we could use company for all our ISO certificates.

records.title: Helpful and responsive
records.text: Personable team who will always help, if they can't they refer you to a colleague who endeavours to assist.

records.title: Professional Company
records.text: From initial contact Interface NRM have been helpful and professional. Able to assist us with our questions when called upon. John was thorough with our audits and made the whole process easy. Highly recommended.

records.title: audit experience…
records.text: Any audit is always a trying experience but the interviewer was clear and precise in the requirements to meet the standard

records.title: FSC Surveillance audit
records.text: We had our first FSC Surveillance audit completed earlier this year. I am new to my organisation and to the FSC standard. Having been on a steep learning curve in advance of the audit I was a little nervous. The planning and audit were not quite as daunting as I had expected. The audit was completed in a very personal, pragmatic and informative way. This helped put us at ease and supported our continued education and learning of the standard.

records.title: ISO 14001 Surveillance Audit
records.text: Our auditor, David Smith was not only very knowledgeable but also very helpful throughout the process. It was easy to engage with David and discuss what we do and how we do it, and how that relates to and works within the scope of the ISO standards. David provided very useful and insightful feedback and also suggestions outside the immediate scope of requirements, which add value to the entire standard and way we interact with it.

records.title: Interface NRM for ISO 14001
records.text: We have used Interface NRM for our ISO 14001 application. Im pleased to announce that Lawcris Panel Products has met the requirements and is now certified to the standard. The process with Interface NRM was clear, well organised and very professionally delivered. Should we decide to pursue other accreditations in the future we would be happy to work with them again.

records.title: FSC audit
records.text: Any audit is a chore, but Interface helped where possible to guide us through the process. I do find some of the policies we are required to have for FSC are out of date, especially being within the UK but I guess they need to be able to cover the globe..

records.title: Friendly service
records.text: Friendly service and delivered well by staff who understood their products and how different businesses interact with the policies. Was refreshing to have an auditor who could carry out all aspects of the chain of custody schemes without having to seek outside council

records.title: Aramark Offshore
records.text: Our recent round of audits were well organised and completed professionally despite there being logistical hurdles to get over.The final written report could perhaps have been sent to us earlier as we started in March and have just received the report. Having said that the interim reports were very useful.

records.title: An enjoyable experience!!
records.text: It was refreshing to work with a company who are always on hand to listen to our requirements and flexible to adapt to our company needs. This is our first year with Interface after moving away from a competitor and certainly wont be the last, enjoyed the auditors approach who demonstrated a clear understanding our our company requirements against the three standards we have in place. Only comment to make was the time delay in producing our audit report from the completion of the audit!Great 4 day audit with good interaction from the Interface audit team.

records.title: Auditor was very good and…
records.text: Auditor was very good and knowledgeable. The report was slow to be received though

records.title: 1st Class Communication
records.text: After a bit of a rocky start, their communication and wiling shone through. They were easy to deal with, always available and reviewed the Audit Reports swiftly to ensure that we obtained our certificate in an acceptable timeframe.

records.title: Great Team
records.text: The team are very helpful and also responsive which is refreshing. We've been with Interface for 3 years now and they remain our first choice for systems audits.

records.title: Great experience
records.text: All communications with Interface were excellent; clear, timely and helpful.  Any questions asked by our company were answered quickly and concisely.

records.title: Response times
records.text: Interface staff very helpful, professional in their manner and explained things clearly.  The only reason for a 4 as opposed to a 5 star rating was slight improvement on response times.

records.title: ISO Surveillance Audit
records.text: Our auditor Paul Franks made the process very smooth and stress free. I felt that the audit report took quite a long time to get sent across from Interface as I know Paul sent it out very quickly after the audit

records.title: Angloco Ltd
records.text: The audit went very well, the auditors carried out a good audit, he was clear on the requirements and provided good feedback on his findings.

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: A good experience all the way through from enquiry to certification. The auditor was helpful and fair and made staff interviewed feel at ease. Good all 'round customer service.

records.title: ISO Audit
records.text: John from Interface made the auditing experience easy and I was put at ease for an aspect of the business that is usually stressful. Communication with Interface was very good, I was always updated of anything changes if they occurred.

records.title: The auditor was informed and able to…
records.text: The auditor was informed and able to clearly explain what information was needed. The process ran smoothly and was straightforward and simple to navigate.

records.title: Good all around experience
records.text: The auditor was punctual, thorough, and helpful. Interactions with our staff were good, which helped lead to a smooth audit experience.

records.title: Staff change due to delays but both…
records.text: Staff change due to delays but both personable and easy and interesting to deal with. Not easy process as i did not expect it to be. Thorough and goals achieved in the end

records.title: Variable but on balance they are knowledgable and collaborative
records.text: The transfer to InterfaceNRM was well organised and well managed.Timing was correct and the transition was a positive experience. The sales management, operations management, scheme management from Interface was, and continues to be, excellent.Clear, concise, cooperative and easy to understand.However when the time came to audit I was less than positively impressed. My principal concern was that when asked a question during the audit, I frequently couldn't finish/complete my answer due to continuous interruptions or statements from the auditor. At one point the InterfaceNRM auditor asked why they hadn't received a particular document/report. My answer was simply that they hadn't asked for it.In another example I was asked/told that I should collate approx 70 specific spreadsheet reports. I disagreed. I was then pointedly asked......"why not?" My reply was that it wasn't a requirement of the standard. The auditor's loss of words that followed.....anyway we eventually struggled through.The subsequent audit report arrived around 9 weeks later and was quite vague in parts.

records.title: Professional service from initial call through to audit completion.
records.text: In the most part the service received was good and the auditor very professional.Only issue as documented elsewhere was the point of the invoicing and subsequent error in the mail process resulting in a delay in the certification being awarded.

records.title: Great initial impression but...
records.text: Great initial impression, quick to respond, competitive quote and a professional audit. A bit slow to respond to a (fairly basic) query though - several weeks to respond after a couple of prompts. Bit disappointed by that.

description: Pioneer of simple to use cloud based bookkeeping and accounts software for UK freelancers and Small Businesses. Free for small to medium sized accounts.

records.title: Amazing tool to create & track your invoices
records.text: I moved to Quickfile from another free invoicing software tool. The difference is huge! It's much easier to use. I can quickly generate and download my invoices. I didn't use other features because I don't need them at the moment but it has plenty of them.

records.title: I set up quick files because I had a new business to set up
records.text: I set up quick files because I had a small consultancy business I wanted to start up. I needed an efficient way to track my invoices. The system is easy and intuitive to work and works very well for my business needs.

records.title: This is one of the best accounting…
records.text: This is one of the best accounting programming software I have used. Being a live in Carer it has made it so easy to populate my invoice with all the different aspects needed to be paid, and email it directly to my Clients. It also makes it so easy at the end of the tax year to know exactly what I have earned and be able to submit this to HMRC as a self assessment tax payer.

records.title: Quick file is a really good app
records.text: Quick file is a really good app, which makes bookkeeping very straightforward and tax returns are pretty easy to do as well.

records.title: Good software, would recommend
records.text: The interface is easy to use and intuitive, with all the features I need for a small business. The cost is also very reasonable.

records.title: It's so easy
records.text: It's so easy. Well presented with exceptional layout menus and a direct link to GOV. What possibly more would you want.

records.title: Easy to use
records.text: I am new to useing Quickfile for my small business but I am finding it an easy way to send invoices and keep track of everything for when I fill in myself assessment form. So far so good, I'm very happy with the service.Many thanks

records.title: Robust and versatile accounting system for our small businesses
records.text: We have been using Quickfile for various businesses for over 12 years now, after switching over from QuickBooks, which had become too cumbersome and expensive for us at the time. We like the way Quickfile automates recurring tasks, which reduces the time we have to spend on running our books. The automated bank feeds and the integration of document management are especially of value, as we can store all receipts etc. in one place and connect them to the relevant business transactions. Quickfile has an active user community, which we have joined as well. If we don't know how to best handle a new business transaction, chances are somebody else has already experienced the same and found a solution. Would certainly recommend Quickfile to new users, even though there might be a bit of a learning curve.

records.title: Superb software at a market leading…
records.text: Superb software at a market leading price. Very intuitive and once all set up for you it saves you hours of accounting time

records.title: Great software: easy to set up and maintain financial records
records.text: I run a very small bicycle repair & maintenance business.  I used to keep my financial records on several spreadsheets.  QuickFile has enabled me to bring all my purchases & sales into one place; issuing invoices is very easy.  Income tax preparation is also so much simpler because I can generate an up to date P&L at any time.Set up was very simple, you definitely don’t need to be an accountant to run the software!

records.title: Small business it makes my life easier
records.text: I found this easy to use and I love that it has an app. I feel quite professional when my clients can click a link and see the latest invoices and what’s outstanding. It makes my life so much easier. Thanks

records.title: Reasonable accounting system
records.text: Reasonable accounting system, free so nice to be able to try it out. Interface is ok and reports are ok.

records.title: Still getting used to the system
records.text: Still getting used to the system, but quickly mastered the basics in order to keep accurate records. So far I'm quite impressed, although to be fair I think I have only mastered 20% potential. But! You only get out what you put in. Overall a very useful tool for an amateur !!

records.title: Easy to use for us and our accountant
records.text: Easy to use and enabled our accountant to prepare end of year accounts with minimal additional info.

records.title: Easy and Affordable Accounting Solution for Small Businesses
records.text: I've been using QuickFile for a few months, and it’s been a great solution for my small business. The user-friendly interface makes it easy to manage invoices and expenses even without a strong accounting background. Bank integration is a huge time-saver, allowing me to reconcile accounts quickly.Some advanced features took a bit to figure out, but the community support has been really helpful. Overall, QuickFile is practical, affordable, and well-suited for UK-based small businesses.

records.title: Great platform for managing finances
records.text: Very easy to use functionality and essentially free. Can't imagine why you'd pay to use one of the competitors frankly!

records.title: I like the simplicity of the software
records.text: I like the simplicity of the software. By this i mean both the design of the interface and the functionality. it makes accounting much simpler for people who do not particularly enjoy the process of bookkeeping.In some ways though, its simplicity makes it difficult to compare to regular accounting layouts. For instance, I had trouble with stock because the opening stock would go into the profit and loss whereas the rest of the went into stock asset. I am not sure if this is simply my lack of understanding of if it was an error (I doubt) but it may be useful to consider providing your users with an annotation or explanation, under an "i" icon, for why certain transactions have been placed where they are placed. it can consider the double entry principle and simple reasoning for why the best place for the transaction in where the software has put it. That way you provide educative value as well as the value of simplicity.

records.title: Switched to QuickFile from Clearbooks…
records.text: Switched to QuickFile from Clearbooks after their latest price hike and haven't looked back. Learning curve was relatively shallow and the community and support network are great.

records.title: Very simple and effective system
records.text: Very simple and effective system. Easy to maintain bank ledger. Good import facility. I use it for my Family Investment Company For simple requirements  really works.Wish list - multicurrency work is a bit complicated.

records.title: Good accounting software for small or…
records.text: Good accounting software for small or medium business. Missing option to setup multiply banking feed for stripe account. I saw 2 years ago people asked for this feature and nothing was done until now.

records.title: Well worth trying
records.text: Well thought out. Simple to use and a variety of useful reports. It does most things that a small company might need it to do. There is room for improvement but mainly in areas that may not impact every company. For example there is no hierarchical structure in the chart of accounts. Also, if you want to analyse financials e.g. into projects or groups of interest the only way is to raise invoices and use the project tagging facility. You can’t just record a non invoiced transaction and associate it with a project. This can be time consuming and a little frustrating. Other than that it’s hard to fault. Great job!

records.title: QuickFile is easy to use for those not…
records.text: QuickFile is easy to use for those not up to certified accountant level. We ended paying upgrading in order to have the Stripe feed so all of accounts are sync’d daily and we are on top of our finances in almost real time.

records.title: Non-profit Rescue Approved!
records.text: As a newbie to accounts and bookkeeping, it all seemed rather daunting, but I wanted to get it right for my small non-profit animal rescue. Thankfully a family member set me up with QuickFile and it has been pretty smooth going! The interface is user-friendly and it's fairly customisable too. Also great that the free version is so accessible and should be enough for our wee setup.

records.title: Nice Free Software
records.text: I’ve been using QuickFile since we were forced to change the VAT submission process due to the HMRC’s ‘Making Tax Digital (MTD)” initiative.  We’re a small business, so I picked a free system, though I do pay for bank feeds which are handy. I find the system fairly intuitive and easy to use, and automated VAT submissions work well. If the help guides were better, especially for a non-accountant, I would give it 5 stars.

records.title: Great system for small organisation
records.text: Pretty good system for our small organisation. We use it mostly for invoicing. It unfortunately doesn't link up with our bank (Co-Op) so we are unable to use all features on it.

records.title: Very easy to use program
records.text: Very easy to use program.  You can download statements into the system reducing the amount of keyboard entry and then a couple of clicks and they are entered and categorised. Easy to keep track of Clients invoices and payments, with a link direct to clients enabling them to access their account too. Credit notes or account adjustments could be made easier, but all in all a very good product with great reports and easy input.

records.title: Much better than spreadsheets, not as intuitive to use as freeagent.
records.text: Works fine as bookkeeping software for a small sole trader business. I use Xero and freeagent too and prefer those for their more intuitive features but QuickFile is simple, free and does the essentials. The invoicing system is great and easy to customise. Overall it’s 4* for me because cash accounting is an optional paid add-on and the UI is old fashioned compared to the others.

records.title: This is an affordable basic accounting program
records.text: This is an affordable basic accounting program, but is good enough for a small business. It is the perfect first step for a new business to use free / cheap accounting software before they are big enough to start paying for industry leaders. The receipts hub is good enough to rival Xero/Quickbooks receipt AI.

records.title: Can't believe this is free
records.text: Using the free version for a small business. The UI isn't as pretty at other accounting software but it does the job excellently. Everything you need for your small business and it makes filing your taxes easy.Upgrading would make it even more powerful but the free version is serving my needs at the moment. Can't believe that it's free...

records.title: The things I can do with quickfile are…
records.text: The things I can do with quickfile are really nice. I love all the features it has. I just think the user experience needs to be improved. The panel interface and the logic of operation should be modern. Sometimes I can get lost among the pages. Other than these, it's really nice and easy to use. I can comfortably perform all my transactions.

records.title: No support for overseas companies registered in the UK
records.text: The service shows some signs of age, and can definitely be upgraded! For example, the registration process involved a fair amount of manual copy-pasting, as opposed to other services that simply connect to HMRC in one click and pull all data quickly and error-free. In addition, the platform does not support foreign establishments, for an unclear reason. There is no chat module on the website, either, which has long been a stantard in the 2020's.When I asked their customer support, by email, how to register to their website with my non-UK address, they replied very quickly, but were convinced that I reached out to them by mistake, and did not ask further. They seemed unaware that the HMRC mandates foreign sole proprietors (who sell in the UK) to register for VAT. I find it odd for a company whose sole purpose is compliance with HMRC's regulations.

records.title: On the whole I really like QuickFile
records.text: On the whole I really like QuickFile. It is simple and clear to use. Only a couple of frustrating points:  - Once i have completed an invoice and am ready to send it to a client and then print it, the invoice layout changes the order it has been written. - I appear to be unable to input information on an invoice unless it has a value above 00.1.

records.title: It works well for basic business needs
records.text: It works well for basic business needs. Could use more customization, like client specific language support (for invoices & emails).

records.title: Overall easy to use… but glitchy
records.text: Quickfile is overall easy to use and easy to manoeuvre round, however some parts of the system have glitches that never seem to get fixed.For example - typing in figures on a credit note when allocating it against a purchase, you can't start typing with a negative sign, you need to type a number then go back and add the minus sign to keep it as a credit. Or, when you want to run the aged debtor report - you can't actually see the total amount for say all of one month eg June, you can only see 30 days from the day you run the report or 15 days or total for all of the invoices, so if you run the report and pay your bills on say the 20th of each month, you are never actually seeing the correct amount to pay for the full previous months bills? I asked about this one in the help desk and no one could understand the issue? It's just stupid little things that really will annoy you if you use this system 40+ hours a week to run a fairy large organisation. If you have a small business I'm sure it will suit you fine. Drag and drop for purchase invoices is fantastic, and uploading bulk invoices in CSV works really well too!

records.title: You should be able to customise your…
records.text: You should be able to customise your own categories and also VAT amounts which vary depending on which country you go to. Also why can’t most frequent payment methods be remembered say at the top of the list instead of having to scroll down all the time?

records.title: Reasonably intuitive
records.text: Reasonably intuitive, easy to get started.Was not aware that after the first year I would be charged, I was looking for free software as have been forced to use by HMRC for VAT. Feel like I'm being overcharged too as I back dated my accounts and put more records in than I normally would for the year.Not too expensive though, so decided to stay and see what happens next year.

records.title: Struggling to use QuickFile to prepare self assessment reports
records.text: I am using this to submit VAT returns, having changed from excel spreadsheets.Now that I have to collate data from Quickfile reports to do my income tax self assessment, I am struggling.My quarterly VAT periods do not correspond with the tax year, so I am having to create spreadsheets from Quickfile entries to split the relevant VAT periods.Such a pain to do the entries all over again.Is there a better way?

records.title: Ease of use
records.text: What I liked was the ease with which I could raise and invoice & email it to the client. What I think needs tweeking is certain fields get filled in automatically with the wrong data and have to be overwritten while others are left blank and data has to be entered again eg when creating a new client, the client name does not automatically appear on the new client record but the mobile number field is filled with my number not the clients????

records.title: Not Used For Business
records.text: Only using nominal transactions for my personal accounts and only using M size. Batch entered transactions for 7 previous years so not a true test yet as to whether the size is adequate for a normal year.Will persevere for another year to give it a true test.

records.title: I Started Quickfile to allow digital…
records.text: I Started Quickfile to allow digital VAT submissions.Now I have to do my accounts twice. Once for the business and again for VAT. I was hoping for some streamlining, but the opposite has happened.

records.title: Easy to use
records.text: Easy to use, clear accounting software for all abilities. Flexible to meet our general needs.

records.title: Its quite easy to use although cannot…
records.text: Its quite easy to use although cannot upload invoices!!
