records.text: Comprehensive and Impressive for a free software service. However, I found bank integration difficult to navigate with reconciliation. Book keepers and accountants also found it difficult and could not support me with it

records.title: Could be easier to use
records.text: It has taken a while but have gradually learnt how to use it on a basic level.

records.title: I'm only using the free VAT return…
records.text: I'm only using the free VAT return submission feature at the moment. I've made a couple of successful submissions and one accidentally blank one - for which I had to submit a VAT error correction form and has caused me some pain - hence the 3 stars. I filled in the numbers, the initial submission failed, I resubmitted it and it worked - however it had cleared the form after the first failure!

records.title: I have been using them for about 8…
records.text: I have been using them for about 8 years now, good interface but nothing quick about the customer service. if there is a issue, it cannot be sorted quickly over the phone. its days of emails. they do not have a phone number and will not call you back either. you will not be able to speak to a human. in some circumstances what would take 20 mins will eat up an entire day, Welcome to the new robo business model

records.title: The help and forum are not easy to use I'm afraid to say
records.text: It would be nice to have some sort of direct email support rather than just forums, although I understand that 'their team' is on hand to contribute answers. Otherwise good.I tried to just 'drop us a line on the forum' but it's not at all easy. They want you to trawl through previous answers which don't relate to my query.

records.title: Overall a great tool for business
records.text: We feel it is a very useful tool for running a business.Obviously nothing is perfect and improvements could be made.We have experienced problems with the system not updating bank feeds and sometimes duplicating expenses and transactions but I am sure this is being looked into.An app for the phone might also be a great addition to the overall service.

records.title: Not for me but will suit others.
records.text: This is definitely geared towards a trading company rather than a small charity where funds primarily are from members fees,  donations and fund raising activities requiring only the occasional invoiceI have not found it easy to amend or delete items not needed or the format of reports to meet my needs but have persevered for almost 2 years.  Next year I will be changing to a basic spreadsheet, but others may well find that this app is just what they need.

records.title: I've given 3* as although easy to set…
records.text: I've given 3* as although easy to set up and do simple invoicing as a non accounts person undoing mistakes and trying to close accounts and cancel direct debits to go cardless has been tricky - to access help/community pages requires a different login (which I forget) would be great to have a helpdesk to phone so you could speak directly to someone.

records.title: Not a fan!
records.text: I was quite happy using an old accounts package for my small business until HMRC forced us all to "Make Tax Digital" amd I had to pay to be able to file a VAT return.  Not a fan.  I have found it impossible to find how I break income and expenses into quarterly sets.  Hence I found it impossible to do my VAT returns using this system.  I won't be renewing next year.

records.title: Unintuitive interface
records.text: Unintuitive interface. Poor help/guidance.

records.title: There is several people that access…
records.text: There is several people that access Quick file I manage fine on a laptop but the other users only have smart phones and really would like there to be a app

records.title: Clearly isn’t free be careful of loaded charges
records.text: I really enjoyed using this software until I first received a bill for £15 plus VAT to take my bank account feed. I paid that and carried on using the software to run my small tutoring business. I then received a bill for £45 plus VAT because we had used 1000 transactions. That equates to less than 100 a month so any small business that sells three things a day is never going to make use of this software without paying for it. Which is fine but it’s advertised everywhere as a free solution. And it isn’t it’s also very difficult to get hold of anyone via email or on the phone there is no contact us email in any of the correspondence I sent to you it all comes from a no reply email. So just be careful if you sign up that you’re not going to get a free service that it will cost you money and then just compare it on the basis of those costs with others and see if it suitsAs it’s My review I’ll reply to your response Glenn. Perhaps you can read my email I sent you?I’m entitled to my view. You do advertise as free and I am not a massive company. We are a two person agency and have had zero support. Every email you send it from a no reply email. A community forum is not private and I don’t expect paid support to be done publicly. Also from your pricing page L and XL are the same. So what’s the point?  As I say to anyone looking for a system to keep track of payments be earned. You’ll pay £54 a year plus £18 foe the bank feed. £72 a year isn’t cheap.

records.title: Clunky to use
records.text: Clunky to use, in no way intuitive.

records.title: To hard for beginers
records.text: Date of experience: 21 December 2020

records.title: EVERYTHING went wrong
records.text: EVERYTHING went wrong, your "activation" e mail link DOES NOT WORK for the forum. You advertise that the briding software is FREE, but its not, I have only ever done ZERO returns, as the club we run is dormant SO WHERE DO YOU GET I NEED A POWER SUBSCRIPTION... ITS A CON! YOU ARE A CON

records.title: Hidden Charges
records.text: At first I was completely blown away by the 'free' software, but after a couple of months use I was held to ransom to pay charges I had no idea had been accruing the in background. An email appeared advising that all my data would be removed within a week if I didn't pay up. No intermediate emails advising of the unknown charges being levied. I couldn't even access my data without paying the minimum charge of £15.00. Suddenly the promises of a free online database were pretty empty. There were compound fees, which has left a very bad taste in my mouth.  This is such a shame, as for a free piece of software it was pretty good. As a paid-for software it is not in the same league as Quickbooks, Xero, or Sage.

records.title: How to make a simple task more complicated
records.text: Yet again the supposedly simple task of filing a VAT return is made unnecessarily complicated by an MTD service that doesn't do what it says on the tin. It won't accept an Excel spreadsheet to be uploaded even though it is based on the template they provide. Please don't reply to me to try and help, I've moved to a different supplier.

records.title: Quickfile is not good for small business, incomplete software
records.text: Not good for small businesses. You can't submit annual return direct to HMRC without paying a good money to their listed accounting companies. I didn't know how this company work; I have wasted my time filling all data and at the end just before filing annual Accounts i have seen on the website that i have to pay their accountants to review my all information and those company will submit my annual return. If this is the case then this is incomplete accounting software and waste of time. Now-a-days HMRC made everything very easy for small businesses so I would suggest Quickfile to stop wasting our time and clearly mention on the first page all of your hidden charges. Thanks

description: We're here to help - from using Microsoft Excel for informed financial decisions, presentation skills for a winning sales pitch, to leadership & development programmes.

records.title: An excellent trainer who explained…
records.text: An excellent trainer who explained thing clearly and concisely at a good pace.  There were also lots of opportunities to practise using the new skills and content during the course.

records.title: Great training.
records.text: Great training.It was well organised, all the info during the training been clear, the tutor explained everything into details.

records.title: I have hearing difficulties and the…
records.text: I have hearing difficulties and the Trainer was very patient while I set everything up and very patient when I needed things repeated and typing in the chat when it became overwhelming.

records.title: Great Presentation Skills training with Tony
records.text: Great presentation skills training course with Tony. He was open, approachable and professional giving solid tools and knowledge for presenting that was tailored to our needs. He also kept the whole thing engaging through continued interaction and giving us a space to practice presenting live in the session while keeping it fun. Found it very useful - thank you!

records.title: the tutor was excellent
records.text: the tutor was excellent. expained things in an easy to understand manner and terms. the presentation was clear and could be seen well. the content of the course fulfilled my needsthe room was comfortable and we had tea,coffee and biscuits at all times.

records.title: STL Project Management Course
records.text: The STL Project Management course was excellent and i'd recommend this to others. My knowledge of project management before this course was minimal and its really helped me. The course provided a detailed breakdown of project management and the theory behind it. The instructor Karen was very knowledgeable and helpful. The exercise provided to put the knowledge to use helped solidify the training and allowed you the opportunity to put everything into practice. Thanks STL

records.title: What a great course!
records.text: Jens was so passionate about Excel! Never met a man who loves Excel so much and it made the course so much more fun and easy to follow! His passion definitely rubbed off on me and I found it way easier to take in and understand the course with him. The course was so helpful and I came away with so much extra knowledge that I can't wait to use in my working life.

records.title: Interesting training in Microsoft Copilot
records.text: the training was very interesting with excellent delivery by the extremely knowledgeable trainer

records.title: Our trainer was easy to understand and…
records.text: Our trainer was easy to understand and worked at a comfortable pace.  He explained each step well so all levels of ability were able to understand.

records.title: I booked my colleague onto a virtual MS…
records.text: I booked my colleague onto a virtual MS Excel course. The communication from STL was great throughout the process and her feedback from the session has been nothing but positive.

records.title: The trainer was friendly and…
records.text: The trainer was friendly and informative, it really helped improve my confidence.

records.title: Martin was very friendly and explained…
records.text: Martin was very friendly and explained things clearly. If anything I would have liked to explore more on Power Query in the time we had, but it was only a day course so I appreciate time is limited

records.title: Thank you for a fantastic training…
records.text: Thank you for a fantastic training session! We're excited to put our new skills to use. Special thanks to the trainer Samer for their expertise and engaging delivery.

records.title: The course itself was fab
records.text: The course itself was fab, great instructor and content. The content shared afterwards did not match the content shared during the course though, and some bits were missing.

records.title: Great day of training thanks to Tony
records.text: It was a nice day of training thanks to Tony Blue, he was energetic and adhered to the needs of the group which I thought was helpful. The way he described real-life examples made it easy to understand, and it would have been nice to get more time on the group tasks. I enjoyed the storytelling that came with the facts/data he shared about deaf people and the videos used in the course. Overall, would recommend anyone willing to learn more about themselves and others to join this course!

records.title: Tony Top Trainer at STL
records.text: Knowledgeable trainer who bought to life what could possibly be quite a dry subject if not handled correctly.Tony was very welcoming and interested in what myself and the other attendee did in our roles and was really quick to pick up on what would benefit us knowledge wise.Also excellent lunch in a local restaurant!I ended up with many takeaways from the training that I can implement in my role.

records.title: My Excel Introduction views
records.text: Although set out like a classroom, it was a relaxed environment. Only 4 of us in the session, plus the trainer, so there was plenty of opportunities to ask questions and go back on things if needed. I would certainly recommend it to anyone who wants/needs a good solid base in the essentials of Excel

records.title: Team
records.text: I learned new things and some good use of keyboard

records.title: great time management course
records.text: This was a full-day online training on Time Management.  Karen, the trainer, was very experienced as a project manager and writer, and   tailored the course to the specific issues faced by participants.  She presented a good range of techniques, tips and online tools for the participants.  She paced the material well and there were suitable breaks to be able to reflect and absorb new ideas.  The short 'check-ins' on how would you use the techniques encouraged participants to apply the training to their own jobs.

records.title: Great to learn how to use formulas
records.text: Great to learn how to use formulas - yet there are many more to learn. The intermediate training was very well organised, with ready-to-use examples and exercises. The tutor was clear in his explanations and quite savvy in Excel. The formulas taught were great, yet other important ones remain unexplored. Maybe the content could be more tailored to the trainee's needs, although I think there is plenty of material available online

records.title: Great course, but too long
records.text: I really enjoyed Excel Intermediate course at STL. Atlas was great at explaining things. The course is long and full. Perhaps it could be better to divide it into two shorter parts.

records.title: Excel Intermediate
records.text: Good content covered by Marius and well explained.A good hands on session via Microsoft Teams, good to see what he was showing us from his screen much easier to follow and for us to replicate the task requirements.

records.title: Excel intermediate
records.text: Excel intermediate,  I was hoping the course would cover the VLOOKUP formula's which it didn't so a bit disappointed. On the whole it was good . It would be good know before selecting the course that what it covers exactly and whether it would be useful in the future.

records.title: Great Experience with STL
records.text: I needed a reminder of Time Management skills - This course was well delivered at a good pace and interactive.  I learnt of some new tools that are now out there to assist me which I will put into practice.I had a call before the course to ensure all was OK and a follow up call to make sure that it was what I needed.  Great customer service!

records.title: Knowledgeable Trainer - 'Just-Right' Pace
records.text: A good level of learning achieved as an outcome of this learning course. The pace was just-right, and the trainer delivering the training had a great level of experience in the course content and the tool that we were being trained on.I expected that I will be getting more out of the training material, but that was okay!

records.title: Easy to access STL
records.text: Easy to access STL - in a good location.  They offer such a range of courses and all the tutors have lots of knowledge in delivering their topic.

records.title: I find the training is useful
records.text: I find the training is useful. Easy to understand. A trainer (Karen) she is using a fun and active way during the training session. I am really enjoying it. I have learned some useful skill such as communicate technic.

records.title: I didn't attend the training
records.text: I didn't attend the training, I just booked it on behalf of my colleagues. They seemed happy and enjoyed the course but the constant contact from our account manager was a bit overkill.Other than that it was good hence the 4 out of 5 stars.

records.title: Excel - introduction training course
records.text: The courses where informative and the content was accurate. I do wish the content was more condensed and more of Excels features were explained. The tutor is amazing and patient and made sure all students were involved during training

records.title: Managing Teams Remotely…
records.text: I attended a virtual course on Managing a team remotely with Tony Gravestock.I found the content very useful and drew attention to possible areas of the normal day to day managing a team which do not work quite so well with remote staff.

records.title: I think the course would have been…
records.text: I think the course would have been better had it been delivered in person.  It was difficult online if you were struggling to follow what the trainer was doing.  I also think the pace of the course was a bit fast.  It would have been better if we could have spent more time on each item to cement the learning better.

records.title: Good content but lack of participants
records.text: My colleague attended the course and whilst the course content was very useful and they did learn techniques around time management, the lack of other participants was an issue.  We had decided to use an in-person course as thought it would lead to idea sharing with other participants but unfortunately there was only one other participant with my colleague.  Whilst I understand STL cannot force organisations to sign up for their courses I would have welcomed a heads up at the limited number of attendees, my colleague found the situation uncomfortable at times.  However in general they enjoyed the course and learned some useful techniques.

records.title: Reasonably entertaining course on using…
records.text: Reasonably entertaining course on using Desktop Power BI. would been nice if we had course material beforehand even while listening to the trainer, so we can put our notes. But it was not so.

records.title: Management training
records.text: The course was well delivered and the lecturer was knowledgeable in his field. I would have appreciated more real life scenarios on how to deal with staff in various situations , this was sadly lacking from the course and something i would have found very useful.

records.title: Virtual classroom
records.text: Virtual classroom, was slightly distracting having 9 faces all looking into their screens. Would suit better after the introduction to turn camera off whilst learning. That's my opinion.

records.title: It was not too bad but my objective was…
records.text: It was not too bad but my objective was not achieved. The training was different from what I expected.

records.title: I was not the candidate
records.text: I was not the candidate, rather the person responsible for finding the course and matching its contents with the requirements of what we wanted our colleague to get out of the course. The feedback I got from my colleague that attended the course was very positive. The content was very well received and our employee although initially was reluctant about attending the course did find it beneficial and learnt from the course and will bring in what he learnt in to his daily work. Primarily the manner in which he communicates with his colleagues. The person leading the course delivery was very good and relayed the content in a meaningful and realistic manner.One negative I would have, was finding the course and the ease in which you could book, and the availability of dates was excellent. However this has been overshadowed by the fact that prior to the course and subsequently I am now being contacted by STL about further courses, this has been via phone, email, and LinkedIn. Which personally I find frustrating. I would use STL again but as and when required.

records.title: Very basic training
records.text: Very basic training, not really directed to our business issues. Trainer was 1/2 hour late.

records.title: This was a basic course and I already…
records.text: This was a basic course and I already knew all that was being shown, not for me so a bit disappointed

records.title: Sales Training with Karen
records.text: I enjoyed the workshop I attended and the opportunities that Karen facilitated for reflection on my daily work. But I wish there had been more people in attendance in order to share more experience and knowledge between different industries. I think that would have offered a more dynamic and interesting experience.

records.title: Hits all the basics - but room for improvement
records.text: I thought a lot of good basics were covered in STL's Introduction to Management training: helping your line reports to set goals, understanding team psychology, giving feedback and having difficult conversations, knowing when you actually need to organise a meeting - all really useful. I would have preferred if the course had also included some training on the pastoral side of management - including mental health - as this was lacking and I think is a really important part of management. I also found some of the techniques advised to deal with performance issues were not ways I'd personally want to speak to anyone I managed as I thought they had the potential to land badly with some individuals.

records.title: It was useful experience and the…
records.text: It was useful experience and the trainer added a lot with her examples

records.title: simple and good quality teaching of course syllabus
records.text: STL courses are exactly as they list them - in less than a day you can learn the syllabus.  The courses are centrally located and generally classes have been small, enabling the course to be covered and allow time for questions.  There was the option to tailor the course to specific needs within your job/life.

records.title: More time learning and less for lunch & breaks would be more beneficial.
records.text: I found the trainer sped through the sections, without making sure that everyone was at the same stage. I asked him to go back a few times to make sure I understood. I think it unnecessary to go out to a restaurant for lunch (although it was very nice). In my opinion it would be better to have a sandwich on the premises and spend more time training as it is only a 1 day course. It was be a good idea to be given some exercises to practice what we had learnt, to ensure that everything had be absorbed and taken on board.

records.title: The course was superbly run and the …
records.text: The course was superbly run and the support from the sales assistance team beforehand excellent. The tutor was very good and the exercises during the day helpful. However, the materials we left with have left me feeling inadequately equipped to repeat any of the exercises in my own work situation. There is no, or very little code in the course notes and I did not take my own in sufficient detail to make use of without the example sheets used during the course. I left the day feeling very positive, but two weeks later found myself feeling out of depth without the necessary tools to apply what was covered on the day.

records.title: Introduction to Excel
records.text: I really liked Marcus, the trainer, and he was very thorough.However, I think it would be better to do these courses over 2 days rather than all in one go as by the afternoon session I had stopped retaining the information he had shared.

records.title: Bit rushed in some parts
records.text: Unfortunately some of the content of the training was rushed through. Practical excercises were the best part. Some areas of the content should have been explored in more details and with some context

records.title: Enthusiatic tutors present good ideas that you can explore later, but fail to actually teach.
records.text: Recently attended my second Excel course which confirmed my concerns from the first. The teaching method is not good, as it's too easy to just copy what is typed into cells by copying what the tutor does, without actually understanding what you are doing! This maybe the result of trying to pack too much into the day. Having a predetermined result all ready set out that will be created by the end of the day, promotes the technique of just copying formulae to create the prescribed result, rather than facilitating the thinking and planning process behind deciding on the functions and display needed.  The same teaching style all day is not good either, as it gets monotonous just trying to keep pace with copying cell formulae.

records.title: Maybe I was expecting too much but I…
records.text: Maybe I was expecting too much but I came away from the course with no additional knowledge of Excel and I would have zero interest in the Intermediate course.

records.title: Interesting, not what I expected
records.text: Was expecting more practical elements or case studies to work on. You do leave the class with the basic tools, how you apply that depends on you.

records.title: The trainer did not like audience…
records.text: The trainer did not like audience input, in fact towards the end of the course, he became positively rude.I have now been asked why I gave full scores for the course. That is because the content and the trainer's knowledge was good.  But I did not appreciate some of the comments he made to me during the course of the day and the final comment he made about "black balling" anyone coming on the course who knew me was the final straw. I had tried to give positive information as I have many years of experience, which is why my manager put me on the course, so that I could give them help on the course.  However, I felt that I was annoying the trainer and another comment he made to me when we had gone into a group session was "oh I knew it would be you talking when I came into the group".  In fact, I was not the first person to speak in the group, he just happened to join when I was participating in the group, which is what I thought we were meant to do.  I have done many courses in the past and never felt the way he made me feel.  I hope my fuller explanation helps.STL have now dealt with my feedback in a very positive way and I am wholly satisfied with the outcome.  I would not hesitate to recommend any of their courses.

records.title: Did not meet my expectations
records.text: I've attended the Advanced Course in Excel (with Dennis) and I was disappointed with what has been delivered. The Syllabus was very interesting and this was the main reason for choosing the course, but unfortunately a good number of the points were not covered at all and the materials received (on their own) will not support individual learning after the course. There is however a forum (free for 2 years) that might prove useful along the line, but overall, in my opinion the day of training did not deliver what was advertised. Even for the topics that were covered, the pace was too fast to follow on the main screen, to replicate on my individual station and also to take notes. I also found that the examples/exercises were rather superficial.Of the 7 hours of participation, only 5 were used for learning. The rest were spend in breaks (including 1 hour lunch) and "house keeping" time. Not efficient, in my opinion. After this course, I can't say that I'm more confident in using what was taught to improve the quality of my work. This training did not meet my expectations.On the other side, the location and the setup were very good.

records.title: Negotiation Skills Training
records.text: Although our trainer Alison was experienced and professional, the content of the training was poor and the delivery not always good. The organization and preparation of the training was also disappointing and confusing. My team and I are quite disappointed with this experience.

records.text: the training did not meet our expectations

records.title: Cameron is the MAN!
records.text: Cameron is the man! Couldn’t have had a better experience with Searchability. Offered out of hour communications to help work around my schedule with my current employement.

records.title: I was recently placed as a Software…
records.text: I was recently placed as a Software Developer at a firm in Lincoln after spending most of my career working freelance. Although a daunting move, Dan Massey was nothing short of superb in his guidance, support and attention to detail… even fielding my concerns whilst on his holiday! He made me feel confident that the company I was being placed at was right for me, and I felt a high level of support from application right through to walking through the door of my new job on the first day.

records.title: James Roberts is the best EVER
records.text: Where to begin? James first reached out to me out of the blue regarding a potential opportunity, which I had seen a little late. Once I responded, he immediately asked me if I was available for a call; if not, when would be a good time?With no more time wasted, we got into a call, we got to know each other, and he told me about the role. He went into the call clearly knowing what a Combat Designer does, and what the studio was looking for. took him very little time to understand that I was a truly potential fit for the role.Fast-forward, James BLITZED through the whole process, got me 3 interviews in the span of a week (because I had just been laid off; my schedule was wide open) - all while being incredibly transparent & also helped a TON with the preparation. Not only that, he was able to really help me manage my imposter's syndrome; especially considering the fact that I was competing with people of many, many more years of experience than myself.I was never left hanging and even when there weren't any news, he told me there weren't. Whenever he said he'd get a follow-up at x time, he did. The level of professionalism, efficiency, quality of preparation, and support I've received from Mr. Roberts has been nothing short of EXCEPTIONAL.I'm not just saying this because he got me a job... I say this because he's literally my first true positive experience with a recruiter. I'm used to being ghosted. But not James: James goes the extra mile, keeps his clients updated, helps us get prepared, vouches for us, and really does what a recruiter should be doing and beyond, with a major S+ level of quality. I wholeheartedly would suggest anyone who considers doing business with Searchability to go ahead and do so if my experience with James Roberts is anything to go by.Simply exceptional. Marvelous service. Perfect recruitment process. 20/10, would go through it again!

records.title: They helped me get the job. Sneaky beginning.
records.text: They helped me get the job.The communications were good and I got frequent updates. The first call was a bit weird, though. They asked me what companies I already interviewed for, so he can find other companies. Then, they asked me not to disclose the name of those companies to other recruiters. So why did they ask if disclosing this is bad? They told me “it was a test” 🤔 I wasn't sure I could trust a person who’s not being upfront. They said other recruiters may have other candidates so if I tell them the name of the companies it works against me. But they could be doing the same.

records.title: Loads of quality resumes!
records.text: We have gotten substantially more and higher quality resumes while using their services. We were able to fill an Art Director position very quickly that has been notoriously difficult for us to find qualified candidates, let alone ones that fit.

records.title: 6 days from application to accepting job
records.text: Positives:-Response from recruiter within 1 hour-Communication was conducted over call, emails and WhatsApp-Advice and Guidance was received from the recruiter before each interview-Recruiter wished me good luck before each interview and made sure I could get connected-Recruiter checked up on me after each interview before speaking to the employer-Recruiter was transparent about how many people he submitted for the job role alreadyNegatives:-The advertised salary by the recruiter was £10,000 higher than what was being offered by the business.-The advertised job description by the recruiter was a heavily shortened version of the 5 pages from the employer, fortunately, on this occasion I was given 5 days to prepare with the new job description.

records.title: They landed me a job
records.text: Regular communications and useful feedback.Most importantly, they helped me find my new job.

records.title: Great understanding of our needs
records.text: Luke was very attentive to what we needed and very quickly understood what it was we needed for our recruitment. He was able to get good quality CVs over to us quickly and we progressed interviews through quickly to an offer. We will definitely be going to Searchability again for future recruitment.

records.title: Great Recruitment Agency
records.text: Great agency, I was kept up to date with everything and they prepared me well for all stages of the recruitment process. Would highly recommend.

records.title: great service
records.text: great service. kept me up to date and in the loop. clear communication and motivated to find placement

records.title: Great agency to work with
records.text: Great agency to work with, didn’t like working with the umbrella company they recommend

records.title: Can be good or bad, depending on who you're working with
records.text: The process to find companies I would be interested in and arranging interview was really good. Cameron was always available and communicative throughout my journey to find a new job.Too bad I can't say the same for the process after I get the verbal job offer. After it changed from Cameron's hand, it was slow and unorganized, were it could take a week to get responses. They ask for previous jobs references, and a week after I sent it to them, they asked again saying I haven't sent. And after I send them again, they only contacted them a week later, after I wrote them a follow up email asking why they haven't been contacted yet.In summary, the experience can vary a lot depending on who you're interacting with. Cameron was 10 out of 10, but the others (I won't mention names here) were subpar.

records.title: Did not look professional at all!
records.text: When giving prospective job seekers at a QA bootcamp a presentation about employability, the Searchability representative looked scruffy, wearing a T-shirt! How can you show others how to be professional when you turn up looking like your about to go down the pub?! (Don't you dare try to tell me that QA ordered you to look scruffy)

records.title: Never sure if you are going to get paid
records.text: Problems with sending money at scheduled time each week. Unsure if payment will come through and often have to chase to get this done. Also they don't fully explain the payments and what deductions are made, resulting in lower salary than originally advertised and explained in the role.

records.title: Avoid like the plague
records.text: "Unreliable with poor communication, constantly changes expectations—best avoided."

records.title: Never get back.
records.text: Was called by a Tom Fulton about a position for Ex forces called Hirecracker.Avoid these disrespectful people.Save your time and energy. Have tried contacting over 10 times in the period of a week and same old story in a meeting.

records.title: Useless
records.text: Useless, husband left details about a so called 'position' that was available. Heard nothing from them. Followed up still nothing. Best avoided

records.title: I will never use searchability again.
records.text: I will never use searchability again.First possible position for a job your own recruiter ghosted me when I asked for an update on the job.Several months later same recruiter calls me about another position go through the entire process, tell you my minimum pay, you managed to talk me under it, told I would get brought up higher after a year, guess what that was a lie.  screw you guys.Edit: So I was a bit upset when I wrote that review and it does lack some professionalism, however, after reading your reply and the blatant lies in it. Then talking to your employee who continued to gaslight me on the phone, and make excuses for his previous lies. I firmly stand by my previous review.  A company that will gaslight candidates, lie, ghost, and not take responsibilities for their actions is not a company I will ever have future dealings with. As stated in the title, I will never use your services again, and I will navigate my colleagues away from your services, may not be a major hit to you, but it will make me feel better knowing I may have saved someone, anyone, from being a victim from your horrible practice.

records.title: Spam messages
records.text: LinkedIn messages sent, wrong technical stack, wrong location, wrong seniority level.  Waste of time.

records.title: I’d give 0 stars if I could
records.text: I’d give 0 stars if I could. Didn’t contact me when they said they would. Not great for those with severe anxiety and mental health issues. Last email was simply ignored. Not had a reply since June. This is in regards to Gabbi Trotter.

records.title: irregular payment and lies
records.text: Been employed on site with a large high street retailer.I am currently a full two weeks worth of invoices behind payment (all authorised and signed off) but searchability tell me that it's their policy to only pay one week at a time. They got angry and told me it's in their written payment schedule - but this makes no sense. So if my line manager is on holiday and I become 3 or 4 weeks in arrears, they'll still only pay me one week at a time? They are lying used car salesmen and I am about to walk off site to look for another job.Ollie in particular kept making a point that in his 8 years as a recruiter, this is completely standard practise. Utter codswallop.Do NOT trust these people

records.title: As bad as the car sellers of the nineties
records.text: Not even sure they knew what job they were recruiting for. No idea how many interview stages there were, been told there will be two, then at the second interview found out it will be another, The job description changed fundamentally between the second and the third interview from a technical BA to a technical writer. They pushed me to reschedule an interview for the day I said I can't be available. They did not returned my calls after the last job (what job???) interview. I don't think I dislike anyone enough to recommend Searchability to them.Disregard for the candidate and unprofessional."The location you wanted to be interviewed at" - I applied for a job in High Wycombe, the third interview was either in London or Theale,  I made the effort to be flexible and go to one of the two locations ,which was a bit pointless if the position was already filled.I contacted Searchability after reading the reply, the feedback was useless - "The two jobs were very similar but, you were a better match for the job that was already filled" ?????? I can't make sense of this statement.The job has been re-posted a day later with exactly the same ambiguous description.

description: Here at USB2U we offer top quality promotional tech gifts including branded USB sticks, branded power banks, headphones, cables, speakers and packaging, all printed or engraved with your company logo. We offer a 24hr express service allowing for a speedy turnaround on many of our products.

records.title: Great communication
records.text: From the initial enquiry to delivery of the product the service was fantastic. Great communication and friendly people to deal with. End product is brilliant too. Thank you

records.title: Fantastic prices, speedy delivery and great service!
records.text: First order with USB2U went really well and I was very impressed. Dealing with the team with queries was easy, they responded quickly, and were very helpful (shoutout to Karen D). Once ordered, delivery was very fast and on inspection on delivery, the USBs looked great. Overall, I've been very happy with my experience and will definitely use USB2U again.

records.title: Fast efficient and helpful service
records.text: Fast efficient service.  We were advised of the progress of our order every step of the way.  I had a contact name who has been most helpful in sending mock samples of the product we purchased which are staff Christmas Gift.  All the Team who I dealt with were very professional and prompt in their replies!  We would definitely order from USB2U again.

records.title: Absolutely Amazing Experience!
records.text: Absolutely amazing customer service! I was looking to get some branded merch for an event, Tristan was my account manager he was extremely helpful and understanding (as I changed up my order a few times to get it perfect). My order was processed extremely quickly and efficient. I am extremely happy with my finished product, they are great quality and exactly what I was hoping for. Amazing experience!

records.title: Fantastic Company
records.text: USB2U were absolutely amazing to order with, extremely friendly and quick to get the order processed. I spoke with Karen D for my order and she was fantastic, extremely helpful and very friendly. My order was delivered quickly and as described.

records.title: Fantastic service, top quality product!
records.text: I was thoroughly impressed with the team at USB2U. Tristan was extremely friendly, helpful and accommodating. We needed a fast turnaround and they delivered a high quality product super quickly. Nothing was a problem! The thing that impressed me the most was the teams attention to detail. I made an error by not including one of the audio files on the track listing, but they picked up on it straight away and gave me the opportunity to rectify the issue before printing. Such a great service that I will no doubt use time and time again. Highly recommended!!

records.title: Amazing work, always on time!
records.text: Over the past 5 years we have order various kinds of powerbaks, everytime better and better! Amazing work, always on time!

records.title: Thank you USB2U
records.text: I would just like to thank USB2U, and specifically Karen, for pulling hats out of the bag and assisting me in my project to get some USB pen drives in ultra quick time.  She was professional, efficient and highly effective!  After having to change my plans at the last minute, Karen went out of her way to assist quicky and kindly.  Her communications were always immediate and everything went extremely smoothly.  I will have no hesitation in using USB2U again and will recommend the company to anyone I know who wants some USB pen drives with an ultra quick turnaround at a great price.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service from start to completion of my orders.Super helpful, understanding and a genuine team. We've worked with them for years and will continue to do so.Thank you, Big Jam Productions / Party Pop Star

records.title: Lovetarantulas.com switches from DVD's to Twizzler-Dual USB sticks.
records.text: Lovetarantulas.com is a natural history documentary film company - and recently we made the decision to switch the contents of our Collectors Boxsets - from DVD's to TWIZZLER-Dual USB sticks. This has been a big step, made much, much easier by Tristan at USB2U - who went the extra mile to make this transition work smoothly.

records.title: Great Service, Excellent communication.
records.text: Tristan was extremely attentive to all requests for information, and after the initial necessary amendment to our design - all e-paper work and payment went through swiftly.Product is great and such a cool welcome gift to our company members.(The only reason it didn't get 5 stars is I had to chase for an update on production.)

records.title: Good Customer Service!
records.text: We had an urgent need ahead of a last minute decision to exhibit our company and products at the NEC and needed branded merchandise. USB2U came through for us, all within our tight budget and provided excellent info and support. Many thanks again Tristan.

records.title: Exceptional Customer Service
records.text: The process of choosing the product and uploading the image was very straightforward, the communication was very quick and efficient. We wanted to see the design in a couple of different ways and this was not issue for the them to sort out, Tristan was vert helpful managing the order from visual design to product preview. Even with our request to make changes the delivery date was still meet and the product looks perfect.

records.title: Would definitely use USB2U again
records.text: Prompt responses, friendly, and helpful. The USB sticks we ordered were of good quality and delivered swiftly. Overall great experience and I would use them again. The recipients of our branded USB sticks were happy and even asked where they could get their own.

records.title: Lovely USB’s and boxes
records.text: Lovely USB’s and boxes. Very pleased with the product. However, I found the ordering and payment procedure quite lengthy and frustrating. You can’t just get a fixed price direct from the website, you have to wait for a quotation to arrive. You then have to approve a sample (3 times in my case) and then do a bank transfer. I tried to call the office to pay by credit card but no one answers the phone. In all, it took me about 3 days in total, emailing back and forth before I could get the order placed.

records.title: Prompt delivery when promised
records.text: Prompt delivery when promisedThe only reason I haven't given a 5 star review is the cost. USBs are an expensive marketing option if not bought on large quantities.

records.title: Very good, will be back 100%
records.text: Very good, product was good, staff were very pleasant. Stuggled with orientation but got there in the end. Layout document and dimensions didn't quite match but I can live with it.

records.title: Efficient Service
records.text: The usual efficient and professional service from USB2U. Slight hiccup with receiving payment but this was soon resolved. Happy to reccomend them.

records.title: Karen was really helpful and quick to…
records.text: Karen was really helpful and quick to respond. Slight mistake in the initial proofs but they have arrived and look great, just what we wanted.

records.title: Great product & service
records.text: Lots of choice of product and good price. Customised to suit our needs. Communication followed up promptly.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, Would recommend and use it again.

records.title: Delivered quickly
records.text: Delivered quickly and helped tweak my company logo to be best displayed on USB

records.title: Really good helpful company
records.text: Really good helpful company. Delivered promptly.

records.title: Good quality of product and fast turn…
records.text: Good quality of product and fast turn around of order

records.title: Great lead time
records.text: Great lead time. Order delivered within days and great communication.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, good quality product.

records.title: Delivered as promised on time and to…
records.text: Delivered as promised on time and to spec

records.title: Purple Swivel USBs for Wedding Videos
records.text: I worked with Tristan to obtain a quote for 6 personalised 8GB USB swivel sticks. He was open, honest, and attentive and this continued throughout the customer service experience.  The work of the design team was good and they were patient and open to adjustments. On receipt of the USBs 3/6 were faulty but these were replaced once I spoke with Tristan.  This was good customer service and despite this I would recommend and use the service again - very professional.

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: Star update…My issues with USB2U has now been resolved. I have now been refunded. I maintain that the service received by Karen is always top notch.  I have to say on a positive that Karen is a good spot but please UBS2U, I need my refund as I am a very tiny business who need to deliver work to clients.

records.title: Excellent quality and friendly customer service.
records.text: Although I have had a couple of minor problems with orders in the past, due to quality control issues, USB2U customer services have always been super helpful with sorting things out for me asap. More recent orders have been spot on and excellent quality. I would highly recommend using USB2U, their products are beautiful :)

records.title: Bit disappointed this time
records.text: Bit disappointed this time, as the art work was lost and the communication was a bit slow informing me of this. however well packaged and a speedy delivery

records.title: Not really rushing to order again
records.text: Had a not bad first experience with them the first time. Unfortunately, the second time was not the best. I paid for some wedding boxes, they took quite long to send me a sample and I just had to keep chasing up and ring because I hadn't heard anything. Liz Edwards was quite good as I understand it was not her fault, just the production team took their time. Oh well, I have the boxes now even though the "I" in video barely printed in comparison to the rest of the text.

records.title: Nice memory sticks but way too much packaging
records.text: The USB sticks printed with my company details are good but the process was a bit tedious - lots of chasing by email and they didn't noticed I'd paid the invoice so didn't send the sticks out for ages. PLUS when they came they were each really overpacked in an unnecessary plastic/card sleeve thing that appears to be designed to look like an audio cassette (why??) but is a waste of materials as well as too tacky to give to a client.

records.title: The end result is much better than the process
records.text: I am very pleased with the end result, but the process getting there was fairly dire. This was a small simple order but it involved over 30 emails, with several errors on the the way. Once the order was placed it went well, with speed of delivery exceeding expectation. Good value for money.Would I use them again? Doubtful

records.title: Product good, communication could have been much better
records.text: Product good, but communication from the team wasn't great.  Being that we needed to place our order last minute and with such a tight deadline, I really needed more prompt communication and confirmation on the status of our order.  I didn't really feel as though the urgency and our deadline was taken seriously which was a shame as it all felt a little impersonal. That said the product was delivered in time and is of good quality, so we're pleased to be offering them to our prospective clients at our upcoming trade show.

records.title: Frustration with Account Manager
records.text: In the past, I didn't have any issues with USB2U, but this time I did. My account manager didn't read my emails thoroughly, so I would have to repeat things 3 times. This slowed down the ordering process because we are located in the U.S. If I go through USB2U again, I will request a different account manager to avoid the frustration.  On a positive note: The product is exactly what we wanted.

records.title: Dropped the ball this year!
records.text: This is the 3rd year i have used the usually superb USB2U, i have had no problems in the past but this year there was a severe lack of communication between me and them. Emails left unanswered, delayed delivery due to miscommunication within their office which led to delays between myself and clients. The product is as good as ever but i really felt let down by the the staff on this occasion.

records.title: Webkey Issue
records.text: Clients comments: My only feedback would be that nowhere on the actual key does it tell people what to do with it! It should perhaps say on the back ‘insert this into the usb port of your computer and it will take you directly to our website’ or something similar. Also the order was delivered to us when it should have been delivered direct to the client and when checking them we noticed USB2U had put a leaflet in with there details on.

records.title: No great
records.text: This is the second order we have placed with USB2U. Our first one went without a hitch, with speedy delivery and no problems. However, this time, we experienced a hiccup. Not exactly sure what the problem was, but it took three weeks to receive our order. Odd, as it was a simple re-order.However, this is not enough to put us off using USB3U again - everyone has glitches...

records.title: Difficult arrival but great product
records.text: We had some issues with the delivery of the product and didn't actually receive it until almost 2 and a half months after we actually ordered them which unfortunately was too late for the event we wanted them for. That being said, the USB sticks now they have finally arrived look great - very professional and Jeremy who I dealt with was very helpful. I would use the company again, despite the initial issues and have no problems with the actual products.

records.title: Late delivery but communication was clear and product was good
records.text: Our order was held at customs in Hong Kong - nobody's fault - which delayed our order arriving when we'd hoped (and been promised).We were contacted and kept aware of it's status. Once the order was in the UK it was dispatched in quick time and arrived when it was going to. It was frustrating to have to alter our plans to wait for the delivery but we were glad when it arrived.The product quality was good and we were happy with them in the end.

records.title: Few rough corners
records.text: Generally the products on USB2U are good; however, the attention to details is not the best. A lot of emails to correct small mistakes and lack of good communication did not make the most out of a process that could have been better, speedier and with less problems. On the pro side, the products looks great and the choice is amazing. Everyone at USB2U worked hard to make things work in the end, which is a very positive ending.

records.title: Great Product-Dept Liaison Required
records.text: Despite being a previous purchaser I was given arrival dates for my purchases. They didn't arrive on time then when I chased them I got an email to say that payment was required before dispatch. Sales contact very good and Finance team doing their job but contact between the 2 is required so that the customer receives what he has been told and when he has been told. Notwithstanding that the product is excellent

records.title: Happy with the presentation boxes but underwhelmed by the USB's
records.text: The service received was excellent with very helpful staff, however the actual product once received was not as exciting as I had hoped it would be.  Whilst it was everything they promised, the presentation boxes looked nice but the carving on the woodland sticks was not as clear and stand out as I had hoped so, all in all we are happy with the product but underwhelmed.

records.title: Average
records.text: Some of the info is unclear as to what you are going to get.The process of choice, pricing and delivery/ordering is not as linear as i would have liked.The final product is good quality and well priced but a little too much of a project to create a simple order.I would like a single form order using online choices to make a purchase with pricing structures and options given online.

records.title: Number on a spreadsheet
records.text: Initial prototype was printed with the incorrect logo, with no apology for the error or time wasted. Despite this, the received product was of satisfactory quality, even though the logo was supposed to be printed on both sides but was not (fortunately this was not a necessity). Time from order to delivery was quite long (1 month), however I was informed of the longer delivery time before processing my order. All in all, I received an average service. I would have liked more attention to detail and customer support; I felt a bit like a number on a spreadsheet.

records.title: Was a little disappointed that my order…
records.text: Was a little disappointed that my order wasn't followed up with a phone call to say it was ready. I was told they had sent me several emails prior to me contacting them but I didn't actually get the emails. Product itself is very good.

records.title: Did not meet our expectations
records.text: Although staff were friendly and helpful on the phone I had to chase up the order which was delivered the day after we had originally agreed.The quality of the printed logo on some of the USB sticks did not meet the standard as displayed on the mock-ups. Some were not suitable to pass on to clients including one that had black paint splashes on the back.Overall, a friendly service but a little disappointed in the final result.

records.title: Good product and service but a bit of a mix up
records.text: The product and service we received were overall really good and quite good value. We got a dedicated contact to deal with our order and received mock ups and proofs quite quickly. My only issue was that we paid £15 for carriage only for them to be shipped to the wrong address (billing instead of shipping) despite specifying the shipping address was different to the billing. We then arranged shipping from our billing address to shipping address at our own cost as we needed them quickly.

records.title: Staff are helpful, maybe an easier ordering system.
records.text: Hi, I found the website a little unstructured, i had only used the site for the first time, and didn't understand why i couldn't buy online but had to call to place an order. I didn't mind having to call- but it wasn't clear on the website; i clicked on the product i wanted and couldn't go any further or change the type of logo i wanted (wanted plain).  Staff were helpful on the phone, but it just seemed strange i couldn't order online.

records.title: Having sent the bulk of my order of…
records.text: Having sent the bulk of my order of USBs out to customers, I am having a steady trickle of complaints as the USB keep becoming corrupted meaning that my customers cannot access their photos. This is completely unacceptable and an embarrassment for me as a supplier.

records.title: Slow!
records.text: Slow! I placed a simple re-order for Twister memory sticks 5 weeks ago, with a request that it be completed as soon as possible. The order was confirmed on 21st September, and debited to my account on 25th September. I am still waiting on 26th October.I hope this does not have to become a " 1* " review shortly.

records.title: The confusing progress degrading the brilliant product.
records.text: The process of ordering the USB's took an incredibly long amount of time - especially on their rush service. I asked for a mock up which was completed incorrectly several times until I had to phone up and reiterate what I asked plainly on an email in the beginning.  The final product was brilliant. It was just such a shame that the ordering process was so muddled and confused which caused greater stressed on the already stressful 'Rush service' deal.

records.title: Not the smothest
records.text: Once the order was taken, communication from USB2U became a lot slower and all information wasn't conveyed. I wasn't made aware for example that my USBs were going to be manufactured/printed in China and that i could only see photo proofs - this made the proofing process very tricky and rushed and i still wasn't sure of how the final product would look. Delivery times were also a bit sketchy when i needed the USBs for a specific event date. However they were delivered on time.

records.title: Not all bad
records.text: THe interaction with staff was pleasant and businesslike.I selected this company as it is located geographically nearby.... the order was delayed due to a hold-up at HM Customs.... which wasn't helpful, and negated my intention of supportinmg local business.Four of the 35 memory sticks were not useable.

records.title: Requested delivery date not achieved- no updates
records.text: Although the product is good, a delivery date was requested. This date was not achieved, and no update was given that the requested date would not be achieved until the tracking confirmation was sent out on the date that the order was due for delivery.

records.title: Just poor
records.text: Ordered some USB's from USB2U.  It seems to take such a long time to get them ordered and printed and for them to be delivered.  I had to actually chase the order the day after they were promised to be delivered.  The could not supply the ones I wanted so had to compromise on another colour due to "supplier" problems.  Then when they came I was promised that the colour of the twister mono would match the colour of my logo.  Well err NO!  I asked if it would be pantone matched and assured it would.  Err NO.  Anyway, won't be ordering again.....

records.title: A simple order took over a month to…
records.text: A simple order took over a month to arrive. I was advised the order would arrive mid-late Feb, 3-4 weeks after ordering due to issues with Chinese new year. At this stage I had already gone through the design, ordering and payment process so decided to go ahead anyway. There was no communication when they were expected to arrive later than this until I chased, to which I was offered an apology but no real explanation about why I hadn't been contacted about this. The product is average but the print isn't of the highest quality, so overall not impressed with the service and have had better elsewhere.

records.title: Poor printing quality and no invoice
records.text: I can see the dots easily, your DPI needs to be substantially increased. I will not be using you again unless you change that. Also, shouldn't invoices be automatically sent? They weren't and I requested one 2 days ago and still haven't heard back.

records.title: The company was disorganised and difficult to contact
records.text: I found that the company was very good at sending the mock USBs but terrible at communicating what was in stock and how long the order would take.  Email communication was extremely poor and the only way to get any answer was to call and speak with someone.

records.title: Problem Free Reliable Wire Service

records.title: Good olan md I is the best condition I…

records.title: I'm happy that my transaction. to my…

records.title: Generally Favorable, some issues which were resolved
records.text: I successfully did a few transactions from my Israeli bank account to Uganda. Then I did two consecutive transactions, minutes apart, one day and the first one went through but not the second. The money from the second was refunded but, despite numerous emails and pleas, customer support never adequately explained why the transaction was cancelled. Furthermore, when I tried to do another transaction a couple of weeks later, my ability to transfer from my Israel account was blocked without prior notice. I wrote to find out why but still have not heard back. In the earlier exchange I was handed off from one agent to another - none of whom seemed to have read my questions and comments properly. In short, I see Paysend as an unreliable service.UPDATE: Apparently in response to my above review, Paysend *finally* replied to my original question and reinstated the option of transferring funds from my Israel bank account. I believe they are trying to do the right thing and when the service works it works well. Hopefully future transactions will go smoothly and I can up grade them to a full 5 stars.

records.text: We’ve had a few issues with our take payments machine. We’re on our 3rd one in 5 weeks due to them being faulty, it’s been a very frustrating process. However, we have managed to get it sorted (for now 🤞🏼) the help of Andrew Marchington was very beneficial. He made sure we had everything we needed moving forward and was really helpful. records.title: Beware the samll print for B2B
records.text: I thought I needed a service such as provided by Takepayments or Worldpay etc. The individual who came around was very good, explained the service and suggested what we needed (as a business we were struggling to have one particular client pay through the usual means).However ... a number of documents are then sent by email in that meeting which you are asked to sign - for an 18 month contract. That is relatively high pressure. Having signed, training was organised, and a first invoice was raised and had to be paid. But by that time the issue with the bank had been sorted, so I tried to cancel. Unfortunately, 14 day cooling off periods do not apply B2B. You are also stuck with not only a monthly payment fee for Takepayments, but also for the provider, Elavon.All in all, an expensive mistake and so much paperwork for the privilege.

description:
We are company formation agents and address service operators authorised by Companies House to submit company formation applications online. Our team has been supplying these services since 2011.


OUR ADDRESS SERVICE is provided from an address in the heart of London's business and professional services district. We were the first formation agent to offer all our address users a free document scanning service. Furthermore, we are the only address service provider to offer an online document storage system allowing clients to access all the post we have scanned for them as and when they need to. This saves our clients a lot of time searching through their emails to find their post.

Our TRANSPARENT PRICING lets clients predict how much we will charge for ongoing services. 

In addition to company formations, we have developed expertise in two other services, namely;

COMMUNITY INTEREST COMPANIES (CIC): We register hundreds of Community Interest Companies every year and have been doing so for many years. We know the registration system inside out and can complete the process quickly and efficiently. Our charges for this service are lower than the fees typically charged by accountants and solicitors. In fact, many of our CIC orders come from professionals.

ADMINISTRATIVE COMPANY RESTORATIONS: We have developed expertise in restoring companies struck off by Companies House. We act quickly and efficiently and keep clients informed at all process stages. Our fees are modest and transparent. We process several hundred restorations annually and frequently do so on behalf of accountants and solicitors.

SOCIAL ENTERPRISES AND CHARITIES: We have several options for companies limited by guarantees. The possibilities range from companies that clubs and associations can use to company structures suitable for future use as charities. We also have a close association with a small accountancy practice that specialises in charity accounting and, because of their experience as trustees to several charities, can advise on the creation of a Charitable Incorporated Organisation (CIO)


NON-UK RESIDENT CLIENTS: Our scanning and document storage and filing system makes our service particularly useful to non-UK resident clients. No charge for getting post; it's all included in the subscription. Consequently, many of our clients are not based in the UK. :

LIMITED LIABILITY PARTNERSHIPS (LLPs): Our pricing makes our service particularly attractive to LLPs.

records.text: In general the service worked well.However, the list of ID documents required for mail services clearly indicates that a birth certificate is an acceptable form of ID but in fact it isn't accepted.  The company insisted that "Original birth certificate (UK birth certificate issued within 12 months of the date of birth in full form including those issued by UK authorities overseas such as Embassies High Commissions and HM Forces)"The document supplied was issued 2 days after my birth which is clearly within the 12 months from date of birth requirement.All in all then, sensitive data is being collected when it is not appropriate to the service application which is worrying in terms of potential identity theft.

records.title: Waste of time and money! Total failure!
records.text: I have applied to a New Company Registration for Non-UK Residents at November 18, 2024. It's been a total failure! Waste of time & money! I have received an email from their support team after my application, they have requested ID Proof (which I provided by passport copy) and an address proof. And that's where the story begins, I have got a family summer house in Turkey where I live mostly and I have applied to the company registration with that address. I have also shared my Water Bill on that address to the 1st Choice Formations due to their exact request. Support team refused the acknowledge of this Water Bill because it was not a formal document and it was not in English. I didn't know a strictly formal address proof documentation is necessary on the company application; my formal address in Turkey is at my Winter house, it's a different address. Then I forwarded this formal proof of address at my winter house and asked them to update everything. Mentioned document was downloaded from the Turkish government website. However, support team indicated that it's also unacceptable because it's not in English. They emailed that the document should be with a translator signature, stamp and notarized by a solicitor!! Which I also did today on 23 December, 2024; with spending an extra 100 Euros to the translator and to the notarized solicitor! Now I received this total nonsense that they have '' updated '' my address now. However, payment gateway was done with the other address and they still need to see a valid proof of residence over there. Nothing but a total waste of time and efforts! I have just sent them an email to cancel my order, I will be waiting for their refund and we will see how this would go..

records.title: Been with them for 3 years and over.
records.text: Been with them for 3 years and over.Their service has gone from reasonable to poor and finally unbearable.You pay them for the service(I bought all in for £150/year appx) so I get my mail and any other important document on time via an email but they (operating from some thousands of miles from India perhaps) have to be chased when bailiffs attending from HMRC, councils recovery orders for penalty tickets, dvla notices and the list goes on are at the doorstep to recover dues which have gone unnoticed due to their incompetence.If for whatever reasons they end up doing what they are supposed to do thn you have a technical glitch in their system which will hold up your posts, again you’ll be required to chase them only to get someone to call you back when it suits them and will release all your hundreds of email at once!I wish trust pilot had a 0 star option which I would have opted in for. Oh yes, you also have to comply with MLO (Money Laundering) regulations and if you’ve for whatever reason forgotten to upload any required documents they again bar the service without a courtesy call/email or anything.All the above’ I have experienced myself and it’s with a heavy heart I’ll have to put this up here so others intending to join may and should find a better and a more appropriate alternative.Lastly I won’t be surprised that a response be pasted here using chatGPT which’s quite in reach and very handy to the incompetents which’ll be a true representation of what 1stChoice Formations is all about.A User!

records.title: Well-intentioned, poorly executed
records.text: Everything started off so well with Sapphire - initial conversations with Loui and Gareth were great - both very knowledgeable. It’s an employee-owned company so I was keen to support them. Problems started after the first few instances of delayed or incorrect pay; I was understanding - human errors happen even to the best of us. However when it continued it was difficult to keep forgiving the mistakes when I am paying for a service which is essentially to provide on-time and accurate pay.My experience with Sapphire ended up being stressful: constantly having to chase up on pay day, saying they’ll call back but they never did. No one seemed to know what the cause of the issues was. Lack of accountability - blame always shifted onto the recruitment agency who actually weren’t at fault at all. I give 2 stars as Gareth (Head of CX) I think is great and was always apologetic and did try his best to fix the issues but it felt like one person was carrying the whole weight of payroll. My main feedback would be to provide more thorough training for call centre and payroll staff. Many of my interactions were unfortunately poor over phone, email and WhatsApp. Invoices weren't sent on time to the recruitment agency. Incorrect number of days invoiced resulting in an underpayment which I had to follow up on. I was told I would be called back on so many occasions and no one ever did. Friendliness and niceties are lovely but they can’t make up for mistakes and late pay - I’ve lost count of the number of errors made. Second piece of advice would be to re-assess your end-to-end payroll processes to find the steps where errors and delays are being made (likely manual steps in the process). Even HMRC were asking me why Sapphire’s reporting was erratic - sometimes 3 weeks, 4 weeks, then 5 weeks - I really didn’t know what to say to them. I wish Sapphire all the best, but it is with a heavy and honest heart that based on my experience I cannot recommend Sapphire as an umbrella company.

records.text: **update 30/10/24** ClearPay took another look at my case and this time agreed that I was entitle to a refund as House of Fraser had not provided the goods, wasn't easy but got there in the end. I made a purchase with House of Fraser via Clearpay, a total of £271.99.  House of Fraser then cancelled the order (item out of stock) however I have not been refunded.  I have contacted Clearpay for their assistance providing the email confirmation from the retailer that the order was cancelled by them, however the email didn't contain certain information Clearpay wanted and said I need to speak to House of Fraser, unfortunately HOF have no customer service contact details for customers, which I have explained to ClearPay so I cannot get the additional information they want. Clearpay have failed to take this onboard repeatedly and have now closed my dispute siding with the retailer who is clearly using underhand tactics to hold on to customers money. I am beside myself with stress and worry over this thanks to House of Fraser and Clearpay its been a really horrible experience, I am £271.99 out of pocket which I cannot afford to be.

records.title: Not sure what to make now of clearpay
records.text: Not sure what to make now of clearpay. I have a great credit amount with them and have been there customer for about a year. I have used clearpay on both eBay and amazon platforms with no issues. However, in the last week I have not been able to use clearpay in any of the above platforms. Was asked to reinstall ebay and clearpay. Which I did. Then I was asked to make sure my OS on my mobile is up to date which it is. Then I was asked to turn mobile on and off. Still clearpay is not working properly.  Told them that when it comes to checking out that the clearpay isn't automatically uploading the card details of the virtual card. To this day this problem has not been resolved. I had this issue a year or so ago with laybuy to find they had suspended my account for no reason. Im beginning to wonder if clearpay has done the same to me for no reason as I pay on time and sometimes pay for my goods in advance before payment is due. It is sad to say that clearpay who I have always given a 5 star rating to, that now I'm having to write this review with only a 3 star rating due to there customer service being unhelpful and not resolving this issue to a loyal customer. It is sad to say that if this matter isn't resolved then I'm going to have to close down my clearpay account.

I'm guessing they want to force buyers to go to different pages or some other reason. It's just annoying that you can't rely on the amount they are offering to you, it's too controlling for no valid reason.

records.title: Why charge way to much
records.text: I find clearpay very helpful in spreading cost of larger purchase from Amazon. However I do not like the way they charge you way over the actual invoice amount then take the extra of the last payment. This means the last payment can be less than half what it was. If you are going to over charge and then refund it it should be spread over the remaining three payments.UpdateFollowing on from Clearpay useless generic reply I contacted CS. Only to receive the usual cut and paste style reply which didn't resolve anything. In one instance claiming it waz to cover sales tax, we are not in the USA the price on the item is what we pay.I queried why my last purchase was still showing at the amount they charged to the card and not the actual cost a difference of some £15.Surprise surprise they had no record of the actual price and despite me sending them screen shots of the payment screen and an emailed invoice from the seller this is still outstanding. records.text: They aren't very thorough with the details. While we were being polite in trying to resolve an issue, a team member got argumentative and hostile. While they got the job done, and the issue was eventually resolved when other team members stepped in, being treated like that while we were paying good money wasn't a nice experience.

records.title: Very poor customer service from Admin staffs
records.text: James Cargo can do the job, they delivered my dog to me in 6 hours after he had arrived at Heathrow.  Nonetheless, it has been a painful experience to communicate with the administrative staff.  Enquiry experience is like talking to robots that could only give standard pre-set answers.  If anyone decides to use their service, be prepared to be blamed (that I was) when errors happen on their side.  My experience was they gave me a sum of payment for clearance of my dog that I settled within an hour.  A week later, they found out that their quoted payment didn't cover all their costs.  Instead of looking into the case and expressing their regret, the staff threatened me by passing my file to a debt collector if I didn't settle the balance quickly.  For worst, the balance they requested was not the same as the original quote.  I have to dig out all the emails exchanged and request an adjustment to reflect the situation.  I wish I had chosen another company for this job as the customer service provided is not professional enough.

records.title: Didn’t have a great experience trying…
