You’re best off going with Airpets, had a detailed quote by the end of the day and they answered every question I had. :)

records.title: Ultimatum 20 min before the flight!
records.text: I would strongly recommend using a competitor. We were essentially blackmailed by JCS Livestock 20 min before our flight. The ultimatum was, 'pay an additional £540 pounds otherwise the dog doesn't travel'. With thousands of pounds and months of planning, I had no choice but to accept. When I disputed this with management I was told directors would be informed and get back to me. Four months later, I feel no one is going to get back to me. I reported the company to Trading Standards.

records.title: They overcharged me £69 for pre-check…
records.text: They overcharged me £69 for pre-check fees, even though I have an explicit communication 12 days before my dog's arrival.When I shared the thread with the manager, they acknowledged their mistake and said to either pay or we won't clear your dog.They also tell you that they will keep you updated, which it didn't happen. I kept calling them to check the status.it was a very stressful day for me, between last-minute charges and not being updated.bottom line, if you would go with them, don't rely on their advice; do your homework, and they will ship your pet as you ship a bag (which you will receive at the end.

records.title: Terrible transport service from…
records.text: Terrible transport service from Heathrow. We live an hour away and my dogs arrived twelve hours after the flight landed. Driver took another dog into central London first - I had no idea this was happening. I will NEVER use them again

records.title: Inconsistent!
records.text: I wish I could say good things about this company but they have been so unhelpful and constantly dismissive of me. I am so understanding of the hardships during COVID but they keeps not answering my calls or telling me the people weren’t there and they’d call back. It has been a week of me calling twice a day with no avail, I had to give up as it was getting too close to my flight and things I needed to do. There was a lack of communication across the team and I was played around. I do not recommend them at all, maybe after COVID they’ll be more organised but right now it’s been not good.

records.title: dont trust them
records.text: When you send you a quotation, it seems to be cheaper than other companies; once you are hooked they start adding costs, and at this point, you are at their mercy especially if your pet is already on the way. i had 2 added costs one on the day of arrival and the other the day before.update: 1.can you please share where i opted out in precheck??2. i have spoke to you several times regarding this, and i said you would be able to convy my message to the manager so i f=dont have to repeat myself, and i said you have my number and ill be looking forward for his call.3. i said i would share my experience online as you cant get away with last minutes charges.

records.title: GETWORK should be renamed to GETNOWORK
records.text: GETWORK should be renamed to GETNOWORK. I spoke to Natasha and told her I was only interested in larger projects such as extensions and new builds but in one month and £250+vat later I didn't get one of those projects to quote on. I was told there was plenty of this type of work being required and that some of her clients were having to turn work down because they got so busy ( typical sales patter ). What RUBBISH! the largest project I got to quote on was a conservatory base and that came to nothing, the other leads were for small 1 day jobs like build a step outside my front door or remove a wooden lintel from my garage the type of jobs I turn down on a daily basis because they are not worth the trouble. The other leads were not leads at all they were people who thought I was a builders merchants requiring ballast and decking timber, what was all that about? The platform page they give you is just one big load of FAKE information and does not represent your company at all. For starters they didn't get my company name correct, they also put the wrong trading standards approved business logo on which I had to get them to change because of copy write infringement, there was a picture of some bloke stood next to a van holding a battery drill. who is this man? it wasn't me. There was a photo of a finished extensions which I never built, who built it ? no idea, and the literature was comical. Family run business, they must have been talking about someone else because I don't run a family business. The services I provide section was every service you can think of under the sun which is not true as I only do brickwork and plastering. The funniest service they said I provide is "everything else". What does that mean? Does that mean literally everything like hair dressing or dog walking I don't know you tell me?I think this is one of the many reasons people found this page confusing because it really confused me. In the past I have used Mybuilder, Myjobquote, Bark and others and in my honest opinion GETWORK is on par with all these useless lead companies only more expensive. In fact after 3 weeks when I told GETWORK I was not going to subscribe anymore they closed my account so I got absolutely nothing for the last week that I paid for. In my opinion stay away from GETWORK in fact stay away from all these lead companies because they don't work at least not for bona fide companies and all they really want is your MONEY! My advise is get a decent website, get an SEO company to put your website organically on page 1 of google and then reap the rewards instead of wasting your time and money on this lot. Good luck!

records.title: Writing this here as there is nowhere…
records.text: Writing this here as there is nowhere within Ember to provide feedback.The Positives: the software is great. It makes tracking your tax easier.The Negatives: the accountant help needs a lot of work. Often on the chat, an accountant will answer one question then leave you hanging for hours or days as they chat to other clients. Not having a single point of contact is inefficient and removes accountability (pardon the pun) from any one accountant taking responsibility for actioning things. I've been trying for weeks to get my accounts transferred to Ember, to get VAT registered, to add a company director and salary. It's all FAR harder than it was with my previous accountant, for whom I'm feeling nostalgic. I feel bad knocking this young company as I think they have a great concept and they are still figuring out how to deliver it. But their argument that Ember replaces a conventional accountant is not, in my experience after a month with them, the case.Improvements they need to make: -a commitment to response times. For example I have an open chat with a question I asked 6 days ago, still unanswered. -checking with you that they have answered all your questions on the chat before disappearing. -accountability: if you ask an accountant for help with something, that accountant should see the job through to completion-proactivity: its frustrating to keep having to chase to see if things have been done.Hopefully if they can improve the interpersonal side of their business, Ember will be great. For the time being Im sticking with them to see.

records.title: The worst thing that can happen to a business -Ember accounting

Ember has costed my busines dearly in wastign outr time and accounting mistakes. Honestly there was not one thing that ran smoothlly. records.title: Horrendous avoid at all costs!
records.text: Probably great if you’re really experienced in managing your accounts absolutely terrible if you are starting your first business. Firstly I’m immensely shocked and surprised that the customer support team at Ember think it’s appropriate or ok to shame customers for struggling with understanding the accounts filing process and making mistakes. Their response towards me literally moved me to tears. It was my company’s first year in business and I made a lot more money than I expected, this is an achievement I’m extremely proud of and managing the accounts side of things has been a difficult learning curve that Ember and the staff were supposed to be helping me with. I’ve struggled using the tool and the support has been demoralising in more ways than one. To get judgement and shame for making mistakes is abhorrent and unacceptable in my opinion. I have since found an accountant who has been a great help. When I expressed concerns about my experience to someone I was told that I shouldn’t be doing this if I don’t even know certain accounting jargon phrases. I was astonished that this was the response instead of empowering me to get better at managing my accounts I was discouraged so violently. I doubt this even matters to the team as no one at Ember seems receptive to improving but it’s worth a try if I can warn other start up founders and new business owners. They will make you feel small, diminish your efforts, use confusing jargon and intimidate you to try and get you to use their accounting service which I used and still ended up with £9k extra added to my tax bill. They put this down to me filling out the questionnaire wrong which I can take responsibility for however if they aren’t supporting me in catching mistakes I’m better off not working with them, that’s why I would want to use their service. Overall, horrendous experience I deeply regret working with Ember and giving them my hard earned money. The violent disrespect and attitude from customer service genuinely shocked me, HMRC is intimidating enough I need someone on my side and Ember are defo not on your side. Again a bit of compassion and genuine support goes an awful long way as going into business for yourself is a scary and extremely difficult experience and is a path littered with hardship and pitfalls. Judging, shaming and looking down on the customers who may be struggling but ultimately drive your business forward doesn’t seem like an awfully effective business plan to me. I can’t imagine speaking to my customers the way the Ember staff spoke to me.

If you do not ask for an invoice, it does not give an invoice. Since the invoice they give you does not show the VAT they have taken from you, you cannot get your VAT back. If you have paid, demand a refund of the VAT amount. I did this and they refunded the VAT amount.

records.title: Poor product quality, impossible to return product
records.text: Bought a milling cross slide table from Vevor. Product is not fit for purpose as delivered due to very poor manufacturing. Contacted Vevor customer service and asked to return the table. They gave me the runaround, dragged their feet, suggested I should sell the faulty item on ebay, and eventually gave me a partial refund to keep it. I invested considerable time in repairing the table, bought new thrust bearings and finally got it into good shape. You could argue that it was a decent deal as you get a lot of material for little money. However, the idea was not to buy something broken as a challenge for DIY repair work. Be aware that Vevor is a trading company. They flog products from various Chinese manufacturers. Some may be great deals, others may be dodgy. Regardless, Vevor doesn't take any ownership/responsibility for the products they sell. If you're lucky you might get a great deal. Otherwise you're stuck and Vevor will fob you off. Be warned, understand the risk you take when ordering with them.Edit (22 Nov): Vevor sent the usual "oh we're so sorry we want to look into this, please send details" fake response. You'll see the same template with many reviews. Problem is, I was in touch with Vevor client service way BEFORE writing this review. They got all details, they got images and a video showing the deficiencies and poor manufacturing quality of their product. This review was written BECAUSE they failed, because they refused to take back the product and brought up all possible arguments to avoid accepting a return (such as "oh, it may get damaged in transport if you return it"). I ended up investing considerable time and money to repair their faulty product. Why would I now even consider returning the product? My key messages are and remain: 1. Vevor does not care about the quality of products they sell. 2. Contrary to what they claim online, Vevor is reluctant to accept returns and will do everything to avoid taking products back. My impression is that they actually have no, or barely any, corporate real presence in the UK. Vevor Ltd, the only firm with this name in the UK, got dissolved in 2020 by compulsory strike-off. Their UK website shows no correspondence or returns address at all. Email is your only option to get in touch. Imagine you buy an expensive, heavy machine from them that may need some spare or replacement parts. Good luck chasing them. If they want to cut you off, you are stuck without any legal recourse to them.My advice remains: either entirely avoid this firm or use them as a "cheap risky gamble" outlet where you buy things only if you take a bet and are ready to accept faulty goods and throw them away or repair them on your own.

records.title: Thinking of buying from Vevor, read this first.
records.text: So at the time of writing I still haven't had delivery of the CNC machine I bought on the 2nd October 2022. The delivery was quoted as 2 to 4 business working days. To be honest I wasn't expecting the delivery this quickly and was expecting there to be issues, however, there is a major problem with the way Vevor work and if you want to buy from them please read this below so you can make an informed decision whether you want to or not.Basically all the 1 star reviews are correct, it makes you wonder when you first come to this page that Trustpilot say there have been a number of fake reviews which have now been removed. I was also offered money from Vevor - not to give a review but to compensate, fair enough you may say, but this was the first time I contacted them so clearly they know this is going to be an issue. So this is what they do, they say everything is in stock, one of their agents on chat also said that they only ship from a UK warehouse, but it probably isn't, I'm sure some of the reviews here are fine as those people probably ordered something which was in stock in the UK and got lucky. But I feel that what I ordered (a CNC machine) was not in stock, so they wait until they get a consignment from China and will ship it out when they get it - hence why people wait ages with no response from Vevor.But this is the rub, Vevor state stagith way it's been shipped, so when you look in the order status it says shipped - then they will respond with a load of emails and customer contact saying 'please be patient, it is with our logistic company'. The trouble is that you can ONLY get a refund if it hasn't been shipped, the only way to get a refund once it is shipped is to return it and probably by that time you're happy you've got it and can't be bothered to go through all the hassle of returning it and then the long winded process of getting a refund.So basically they lie to you, they say it has been shipped when it hasn't, this is actually a con and I may even talk to trading standards about this, my CNC is now in limbo between Evri who say they're expecting it when I use the tracking number, and Vevor who say it's been shipped and 'with their logistic' company. But think about it, who is their logistic company? It is just to keep you waiting and so they can keep your money for as long as possible and hopefully until you get the goods and are finally happy, sure you probably won't use them again and when you complain you get nothing and when you leave a bad review you get the standard message from them making other people think that they're sorting it out - trust me they're not.I want this to be an unbiased review, I'm not saying don't buy from them, just be aware if you do what you're letting yourself in for, there are plenty of other companies out there to get your inexpensive Chinese goods from ;)I would like to add an update to this:Since I put this review up Vevor actually refunded me out of the blue, it is a shame it took a bad review for this to happen, however, to be fair to Vevor, they did give a 100% refund and finally acted swiftly so credit where credit due. So I'm going to change it to 2 stars!

records.title: Cards arrived in good time
records.text: Cards arrived in good time, shipping seems high but at least they arrive (unlike some online competitors) Cheaper postage would be great especially when sending several cards to the same address!

records.title: Prompt service and good communications
records.text: Prompt service and good communications. Always send out cards on time. Good selection of cards for Joe Public but very little in the way of alternative cards for LGBT people and those who want blank or artistic cards to use their own words. Basically they are the same as Moonpig and Funky Pigeon but should be striving to stand out more.

records.title: Ticks all the boxes for Quality, Cost and Delivery!
records.text: Super card - impressed that I could tweak both cover and insert, and the paper insert made it seem a bit more special.  It arrived next day - which I guess is more a reflection on luck with the lottery that is the Royal Mail nowadays - but the card was certainly created and in the post very quickly too.(OOOps - confused this with one I'd bought from Elsie's Luxury Cards who deserve the above feedback!)

records.title: Ordered an anniversary card which has…
records.text: Ordered an anniversary card which has arrived in time but no separate envelope inside, only the outer mailed one. Card is perfectly fine and not like the uniform cards from the shops.

records.title: Well i just got confused.
records.text: Well i just got confused after 40 odd years and 74 just entitled too, I left the dam thing in the basket and i thought i ordered it twice? But rather late for Valentines I thought It ruddy well arrived on time and loved the extra envelope Well didn't expect that one, only one little gripe the card could have been better turned out however we both had a good laugh. Thank-you.

records.title: Arrived late.. But good service
records.text: Ordered on the Wednesday before mother's day, arrived on Tuesday two days after. Card was fine but annoyed it didn't arrive on time.Update: I emailed the team expressing my upset and I received a reply quickly which resolved the issue. The handler addressed the issue and resolved it quickly and pleasantly.

records.title: Good cards but could be improved
records.text: I'm happy with the cards and inbuilt gifts I got. Quick delivery, has cards that are exclusive and topical with the option of having a gift built into the card.The only negative thing I would say is that they are quite expensive without taking advantage of deals and the chocolate bar in the card I got doesn't let the card stand up by itself and it very loosely built into the card so falls out.

records.title: Paid for NDD and it didn’t come
records.text: Everything spot on except from paying for next day delivery and it coming a day AFTER the birthday. Apart from that it’s a great site

records.title: Original designs and a wide choice
records.text: Original designs and a wide choice. Searching the website does involve a lot of trawling and results aren't always appropriate for the search criteria. Excellent, very quick service and good discounts for larger quantities. My recent order was delivered within 24 hours but, for the first time, the cards were not such good quality as all of them had not been folded quite in the middle so the fronts of the cards were slightly narrower than the back, leaving a visible overlap.

records.title: Great cards, I’ll be back!
records.text: I’m a regular customer of Thortful cards and really value finding the perfect one for friends and family which I can’t find anywhere else. If I’m honest, there are far too many crude cards that pop up when I try to search using ‘normal’ search terms but I guess some people find them amusing, ditto the wealth of cards aimed at getting drunk. The service is usually speedy and the cards are good quality. Wish there was a way of checking what and when I’d previously ordered something, to avoid me sending the same card to the same person (or quickly ordering it again for somebody else!)…

records.title: I like Thortful but!
records.text: I like Thortful but could you please get a facility were I can state the recipient's occasion date. Then if a card /gift is ordered and due to delivery restrictions such as weekends and bank holidays have a label put on it stating 'DO NOT OPEN UNTIL.......the date!

records.title: Great Timesaver
records.text: I like the opportunity of sending a real, physical card without the bother of having to go to a shop, stamp and find a post box to send it to the recipient. Thortful does all that work  for me. So that is a fantastic, very appreciated service,  which I have been using for many years already. I awarded 4, instead of 5 stars because 1. There is quite a limited wording facility on the message section of the card... would be nice if this could be expanded. Please, Thortful?2. Would prefer more clever/witty cards without the smut and focus on alcohol consumption. But otherwise, I warmly recommend their efficient and pleasant service.

records.title: The most recent use of Thortful was to…
records.text: The most recent use of Thortful was to send a Thank You card and gift (flowers). Not sure if I missed the information-  it seemed to take a few days longer than I expected - but it was Christmas and the recipients said nice things about it. I would have liked a bit more choice of accompanying gifts but it is a very reliable and good service normally

records.title: Problem solved
records.text: Disappointed the card I sent did not arrive within the time specified. Was compensated with full refund plus 50% discount off next card. I have used Thortful on several occasions and this was the first time my card was not delivered as requested and fault was with the Royal Mail, so in short, the service Thortful provide is only as good ( or bad ) as the Royal Mail. Will stick to E-Cards in future 👍.

records.title: Always delighted with items received…
records.text: Always delighted with items received spoilt sadly by Royal Mail and the lack of deliveries.  My last order didn't arrive in time despite ordering in plenty of time for a birthday.  This time i've ordered 4 weeks in advance so far not received.  Not the fault of Thortful but again Royal Mail

records.title: Order arrived late
records.text: I’ve ordered from thortful before and it’s gone really well. This time it arrived 2 days late for my mothers birthday.I understand that during christmas period the royal mail will be experiencing delays, but this should be accounted for on delivery estimates by thortful.

records.title: 4 for £10 offer
records.text: Multiple cards ordered on the 4 for £10 offer, cards lovely when they came but unfortunately arrived to late for the first birthday I wanted it for

records.title: Ordered to be delivered on the 9th for…
records.text: Ordered to be delivered on the 9th for a birthday on the 11th, delivered on the 12th. Fab card and chocolate but very disappointed it was late.

records.title: Try to buy cards well in advance
records.text: A promise of guaranteed delivery presumably by Thortful and the Royal Mail was broken.I find Thortful brilliant for choice of cards and their polite, sincere communication BUT tell yourself like I have - DON'T LEAVE CARDS until the last minute; even in these modern times, guaranteed delivery is iffy.

records.title: Cards are lovely but the last one I…
records.text: Cards are lovely but the last one I sent didn't arrive on tine. Very dissapounted

records.title: cards a lot thinner than before
records.text: Lots of choice but difficult to search as keywords don’t work properly. Also frustrating that you sometimes find cards on pages that you can’t find within categories. As a regular buyer, I’ve noticed that the card quality of my recent purchase is lower - card and envelope are both much thinner than they used to be.

records.title: Four cards but only got two envelopes
records.text: Four cards but only got two envelopes , cards were good quality though

records.title: Wry expensive
records.text: Very nice cards, but ridiculously expensive

records.title: Difficulty in navigating your website.
records.text: I find the website is difficult to navigate. Once I find a card l like it is difficult to find it again.Also I have never been able to pay by PayPal

records.title: Not next day delivery
records.text: Placed order for Father's Day card early a.m. on Friday 14th within order time frame window asserting 'in time for Father's Day' . Card did not arrive until Monday 17th despite email saying card was on its way. I realise P.O. is going down the toilet but Thortful should not be relying on Royal Mail to deliver a next day service when order has simply been posted using a first class frank-especially over the weekend dates.

records.title: Great range but awful delivery time
records.text: Love the wide range of unique cards available and that independent artists can add designs, however, even with a week or two's notice, the cards have always arrived late..and that includes putting a date thats 2 days early to compensate. Which kinda defeats the object really.

records.title: Good choice of cards but not cheap
records.text: Good choice of cards and it’s nice they support lots of independent illustrators. I had no issues with delivery and it was dispatched and delivered quickly. However, HUGELY inflated prices on gifts. I know you’re paying for convenience, but £13.50 (incl delivery) for a card and bar of chocolate?! The same chocolate costs £2.50-3.00 in the supermarket. It’s good for if you’re absolutely desperate for a quick gift delivered, but not cheap!

records.title: Website could be improved
records.text: Great selection of cards but I find the website is poor. I tried ordering cards for family in advance, taking advantage of the 4x£10 offer & scheduling them for delivery over the months of the year. Doing that was a challenge but then I kept getting reminders to send cards at those various birthdays. The website didn’t appear to allow me to look at my scheduled to check what was already ordered.

records.title: Great cards, very slow delivery
records.text: Fantastic cards- a great range of cards all of high quality and easy to search and save under favourites etc. Sadly, postage has become slower and slower. Even when ordering next day delivery it took 4 working days to arrive. Ordered Father's day cards that didn't arrive in time. So if you want quality cards, order here but order early!

records.title: I was a little disappointed as I…
records.text: I was a little disappointed as I ordered the card for next day delivery to arrive on Saturday for Father’s Day Sunday and it came the day after Father’s Day. This may have been our postal service that let the side down as it would have been nicer to have given the card on Sunday. Anyway, the card itself when it arrived I was pleased with, it looked as advertised and good quality.

records.title: Cards are becoming regularly late
records.text: Cards are becoming regularly late . Fathers Day card didn’t arrive Friday or Saturday. Birthday cards x 2 late as well this year , so it’s not worth risking using them anymore . It looks unthortful!

records.title: Great Cards- poor delivery service
records.text: Cards are great. Good quality. Delivery service poor. I ordered on Sunday knowing that next day delivery would mean my order will come on Tuesday so paid for it.  I had a message saying they will arrive between 10 and 11am however nothing received.  Tracking indicated it was in Yorkshire.  Cards arrived on Wednesday which was a day too late.

records.title: I didn’t see the card as sent to…
records.text: I didn’t see the card as sent to recipient so can’t comment on quality etc - they thanked me for the card but no other comment. Ordered before 6pm for despatch 1st class that day - whilst not guaranteed to arrive next day I was hopeful so why I ordered for the first time. But arrived the day after so wouldn’t bother again as quite expensive and could have posted myself to arrive in two days.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: No issue with the ordering process or time of delivery but the quality for the price I paid was poor. I recently ordered a Father’s Day card & when it arrived I was surprised and disappointed to find it was made of thin cardboard that looked and felt cheap! I could have got one from a supermarket that was of better quality for the price I paid here but I liked the joke/meaning on the card which was why I ordered but probably wouldn’t again.

records.title: My order was meant to be with me by…
records.text: My order was meant to be with me by Saturday 15th June but didn't arrive until Wednesday 19th June much to my dismay as it was a father's day card! Can't fault the process of finding the right card for a very good price!

records.title: Cheap looking
records.text: Drawings are OK but the quality of the cards on which cards are printed affects the resolution making cards look very cheap. Very disappointed. The response, below, does not address the issue. I did not ask for print to be done on glossy paper. My point was that, by increasing size of design, the resolution has been lost. Company have since offered to reprint (no good as too late) or to credit my account (also not much use as I won't be using this company again).

records.title: Charged 2 delivery fees for 1 order…
records.text: Charged 2 delivery fees for 1 order (which apparently is justified because Thortful’s fulfilment process comes from 2 locations (terrible), only to then be left waiting over a week for cards to arrive. I do not recommend this retailer.

records.title: Three days no delivery .emails and chat…
records.text: Three days no delivery .emails and chat option do not work .totally shambles will not use or recommend

records.title: Good choice but bad delivery
records.text: Good choice of cards with an easy to use website but unfortunately I have waited over a week for my card to be delivered after paying for first class postage. By this time the occasion I purchased the card for has passed. I think Thortful should consider another choice of delivery service rather than royal mail.

records.title: Really poor
records.text: Really poor. I paid additional money to add chocolate to the inside of the card but it looks awful, not like a card at all and no envelope. I’m going to have to go out and buy a replacement card for my wife’s anniversary.

records.title: Delivery and no arrival
records.text: Father's Day today and ordered three cards last Tuesday with estimated delivery of Wednesday or Thursday, haven't arrived. This is the third order that hasn't arrived on time or at all, wife's birthday and our anniversary cards didn't get here on time. I have now totally lost confidence in Thortful which is a real shame as the cards are fabulous.

records.title: Thortful have usually been highly…
records.text: Thortful have usually been highly efficient, with incredible quirky cards. My son always uses them.  However, the 2 stars are directly due an Tech issue yesterday, which caused me to lose the message I had typed but it would not save! So I closed the online App and restarted again and again, all to no avail.  I used the Chat box which was the ridiculous Robot, which told me that the issue would be dealt with within 24 hours.  I wanted the card mailed yesterday, not 24 hours later. I gave up!

records.title: The sweets inside the card are horrible…
records.text: The sweets inside the card are horrible my grandchild and my daughter said they don’t taste right very disappointed won’t be ordering again as I have already sent my feedback last week and didn’t get a reply

records.title: Order not arrived
records.text: Email sent on a Sunday so I appreciate not having a reply but no reply on Monday either. I’m waiting for a delivery of cards that have cost over £14 and were due to arrive Friday/Saturday and have still not arrived on Monday. I appreciate that delivery is out of your hands but a response would be nice re the tracking of the order.

records.title: Never received card
records.text: I have ordered a few times and never had an issue. I ordered for Father’s Day this year and not only did not receive the card on time but as of today have not received it at all and it has been over a week. More disappointed than anything as I emailed customer support and never got a response. Love their card selection but I don’t think I will order again.

description: Welcome to the home of luxury hot tubs and spas. Visit our hot tubs page now to view our range, or head to our pool tables or freight forwarding pages to see our other services.

records.title: Highly recommended!
records.text: We had our hot tub from Combined Shipping in 2022 and have had it serviced/drained down every year by them too. The service is always quick, courteous and professional, whether that be people in the office, or engineers who visit the property. Can’t recommend them highly enough.

records.title: Amazing service amazing company
records.text: Amazing service from the team talked us through the different hot tubs available and what would suit us advised us which chemicals were the best and safest to use, fast smooth delivery and set up went very smoothly. After care has been second to none they have always been on the end of the phone offering advice.

records.title: Ultimate hot tub
records.text: Our Ultimate hot tub spa was ordered at a great price from Combined and the logistics for delivery and installation were all well managed and completed as per order. Good afterservice for fine tuning operation and for ongoing products to keep the spa clean. Very happy with Combined and all their services :)Very happy with the unit and expect to be adding a heat pump from Combined in 2025

records.title: Excellent Customer Service and value for money
records.text: We purchased a Rose Hot Tub from Combined Shipping. I was initially concerned about ordering a Hot Tub which was to be made overseas then shipped to the UK, but other customer's reviews were positive and price was much cheaper than buying from a showroom so my concerns were allayed.A few months after enjoying our Hot Tub, we had a technical issue when re-filling the Tub. This was resolved quickly over the telephone and Whatsapp. The Customer Service Team and the Engineer we dealt with were both friendly and knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend Combined Shipping Company to anyone looking to buy a Hot Tub.

records.title: Best Purchase for the Whole Family!
records.text: We love our new hot tub—it’s been amazing for family time! It comfortably fits all of us, the jets are powerful yet relaxing, and it’s so easy to maintain. The kids have a blast, and it’s our go-to spot to unwind after a long day. Truly one of the best purchases we’ve made!

records.title: Reliable, fast and helpful.
records.text: Reliable, fast and great offers. Have used customer service before too and they were efficient, friendly and helpful. Have bought my filters here for 4 years and will continue to do so.

records.title: Our experience with the company was…
records.text: Our experience with the company was very good.Start with the delivery. It was impressive.We had a difficult lay out and the company delivery men were great to negotiate.The service after 1 year was very good, conducted very professionally.When we ordered products they were always delivered on time. Good aftercare service.Thank you.

records.title: Absolutely fantastic company
records.text: Absolutely fantastic company. Always on hand to help since we bought our tub 6 years ago. Just had a service which was excellent. Highly recommend.

records.title: leaky tub put right for a…
records.text: I've been dealing with them for a number of years since buying our tub & when we encountered a leak they quickly identified the problem & promptly completed the repair.

records.title: Great hot tub
records.text: Great hot tub, Bought the Atlantic a couple of years ago but still providing so much fun for the family

records.title: Great service experience
records.text: Engineer turned up on time, got on with the job (as I'd messaged to say I was busy) and completed the service  well. Only gave a 4 as he was unable to get the power supply to the Blue tooth speaker working so we need to replace/get an external one but he was helpful in having a look at it for us whilst he had the tub open. Happy with the Tiny Hot Tub we had from Combined Shipping which is still all good and no issues (other than blue tooth speaker) 3 years on.

records.title: Our Hot Tub is fantastic
records.text: Our Harmony Plus hot tub is fantastic, it's lovely and relaxing during the summer time and really invigorating during the winter months.

records.title: Thrilled with our hot tub
records.text: Thrilled with our hot tub , we use it most days , abs have been in it in the snow ! Great communication regarding delivery abs they respond straight away if any queries which is reassuring . Delivered and  installed professionally . We chose the ‘ white Pearl ‘ lining for ours and highly recommended , it’s lovely . Thankyou x

records.title: Great product - User manual for product would have been useful
records.text: We ordered the twin lounger due to its small size and the limited access space available.The delivery guys were really friendly and helpful and positioned the tub where requested.We have used the tub and it is great fun, I can feel the benefits already. We did have to contact Combined Shipping with a few questions on how to switch the jets on at both sides. It would have been useful to have a user manual for the model that we purchased as we have had to guess a few things and google generic answers for the rest. Overall a great product.

records.title: Great tub but slight problem
records.text: We received our hot tub on 18th May. The team that fitted it we very good and helpful, but after a week we found that the water was not as clear as should be no matter what we did with the chemicals. Our friend who recommended your hot tubs came over to have a look and said that he uses chlorine and not bromine (which I was told to use), because water is very hard in this area, this seamed to solve the matter, but yet again it is not as clear as it was. We have also seen a ring of possibly skin residue around the tub which we clear daily  I have cleaned the filter with a hose, so not sure if this is normal. Otherwise we find the tub very good, with water blowers and fountain and Bluetooth music which makes it very relaxing

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, great product. Had to wait a while for delivery but this was down to the pandemic not Combined Shipping. I think my only gripe would be is, you should invest in a vehicle with a crane on the back. These things weigh a ton and 2 guys moving or lifting was impossible. I had to get the farmer to do it for me. A small crane to lift in elevated  locations would have given your delivery team a better chance of success in delivering to its final destination. Overall 9/10 for service, communication, support and advice. Delivery on the day took the 10/10 accolade off you.

records.title: Aurora Hot Tub
records.text: Hi we ordered the Aurora hot tub in lockdown took a while to arrive butIt's great and it looks good, used Combined's helpline initially and then downloaded all the info online, great service thank you.

records.title: I purchase my Hot Tub in the 1st half…
records.text: I purchase my Hot Tub in the 1st half of 2021 and was advised that it would take two to three months to arrive.  In the end this was accurate as shipping containers are misplaced globally due to the Pandemic and this plus docking permissions added a few weeks to the shipping time.  During this period I was given updates periodically if and when there was a change to expected arrival dates.  On the day of arrival the team were great and placed the Hot Tub in exactly the position I required and then provided full instructions on how to use it.  The product itself was the low end 2kw heater whish requires the insulating cover to be on in order for the unit to heat the water in winter otherwise the heat loss vs heat input cancel out and no heating takes place on cold days but the electrical bill goes up.  That being said, the hot tub has been great and I have had no problems with it at all.

records.title: The delivery team were excellent in…
records.text: The delivery team were excellent in positioning the tub.  The quality of the tub is superb and at a fantastic price.  I would have given 5 stars however the communication could have been better.  I had to chase for updates.

records.title: Took a little longer than expected for…
records.text: Took a little longer than expected for delivery but worth the wait

records.title: The hot was a just I was looking at a…
records.text: The hot was a just I was looking at a great price, I needed to wait a few months due to shipping issues and these were they could improve no communication from them to me I was the one doing the chasing, the delivery once it was arranged cam on time and swift overall it's now in place and looks good

records.title: We did have problems at first with out…
records.text: We did have problems at first with out Hot Tub.. it would cut out after 2 cycles.. after a few emails and phone calls Combined Shipping sent out an engineer who had to replace the circuit board, since then we have not had any problems and we absolutely love the Hot Tub. Combined Shipping are definitely the best value on the market!!! .. would totally recommend

records.title: Fantastic value for money
records.text: Fantastic value for money. high spec tub at low cost. tub was 2 months overdue due to covid and shipping from States but kept well informed by email. Made loads of use since lockdowns. easy to operate and maintain. Great service all round. Wish I could add a picture to show how much we enjoy it!

records.title: Lovely hot-tub
records.text: Lovely hot-tub, excellent value for money. Delivery took longer than anticipated but that was largely down to situation with covid.Delivery drivers did there best to position tub on site which wasn’t easy and we was thankful they did it, although they were reluctant.haven’t needed any after sales care yet but what dialogue I’ve had has been good. I hope they are good because a hot tub is an expensive item if you need help or goes wrong. I’ve ordered more filters from them and would use there products to keep it all in house.

records.title: Customer service superb
records.text: We bought a tub from combined shipping in June this year, what can I say.. superb customer service delivery men were second to none the only reason I knocked a star off was because when we got our tub delivered it stopped working, turned out it was a mother board issue, no biggy but we had to wait a week and a half before it was fixed, I realise this has been an exceptionally strange year and demand has been high but if there's a problem they should have a network of service engineers that can cover the whole of the UK. But I would still recommend, they are at least 1k cheaper than in my area (West Coast scotland)..

records.title: Excellent communication throughout the…
records.text: Excellent communication throughout the purchasing stage and finer details explained.Delivery and positioning was fast and tidy.Installation was excellent and all details explained in full.Would highly recommend these as a company.Gaz

records.title: Mixed feels
records.text: Mixed feels, second hot tub from CS upgraded from Moonlight to a Rose, growing family.6 months for delivery CV19 and shipping problems around the world, more communication would have been helpful. Day before delivery phone call, check tub installed wrong touch screen, 3-6 months to get the one I wanted so refund for the lesser model. Delivery guys fantastic could`nt be more friendly, installer nice guy but rushed install did`nt supply glands scruffy install standard and i had install the in touch.. paid for install little annoyed with standard.The Rose, its self far more powerful and even the cheap seats have good power and options very good features children love it. Negatives the new type lifter is rubbish and cover just does`nt fit correctly loosing lots of heat over night. Appears to loose a lot of temp over night and appears to take a lot longer to heat up the the old model. The in touch helps control the power usage filtering and heating, due to the rise in energy costs we are now running at £6-7 per day with solar panels, big increase not CS fault of course. Would recommend the intouch unit to control costs. the slopping sides mean you can balance your drinks on the side so had to purchase clip on cup holders.don`t like the access panel have to remove the lifters nut and bolts to get access, not good.  cover and filter just does`nt work for me.Product after 1 months use very good product time will tell if the quality aspect stands the test of time.

records.title: Could have been a better experience
records.text: Can’t fault the delivery guys, they where amazing. Hot tub turned up with two big scratches inside and a lid holder that did not fit and should not have been sold with it, called up about the scratches to be sent a tiny used bit of sand paper and a empty bottle of T Cut 2 weeks later. Was told the lid holder doesn’t fit and should never had been sold it to send it back at our own cost and be happy as it’s over 14 days they won’t refund anything. Update the lovely Hannah contacted me after reading this review apologised for what had happened refunded the lid and postage.

records.title: Waited 6 Months for Tub
records.text: Waited 6 Months for Tub! Was delivered 9.20 at night! Communication very poor. Delivery men did their best with inadequate equipment. Basically they had to drag it into place on a skid. Didn't do much for my lawn. Nearly £4,000 for tub and found out another £20 would have been charged to take away the packaging! Better instructions would also have been nice. Like other Reviewer was told to adjust loose Headreast with a screwdriver.

records.title: Combined shipping delivered to us a…
records.text: Combined shipping delivered to us a beautiful Orion 8 hot tub. The delivery guys very excellent and the installation guys also very professional. On inspection one of the led lights In the tub wasn’t working. This was called through to the office staff by the installation man and we was told that a service engineer would be out ASAP to correct the fault. Unfortunately after 3 weeks later of not hearing from combined shipping I called to be told that they had no notes on this fault/problem. They did agree to put a light in the post for us but refused to send out an engineer. Left to us to take off the fitted cover arms. The fitted side panel and then try to rectify the fault. This I find unacceptable. After sales service is a big fat 0

records.title: The process of purchasing a hot tub…
records.text: The process of purchasing a hot tub from the Combined Shipping Company was very simple, however, depite me sending them dimension and photographs of my property and neighbours property in order to assist with locating the hot tub vis my neighbours property this was not forwarded to their delivery staff which caused some debate and anxiety around posissioning.Nevertheless, both delivery staff were helpful and accommodating taking time to explain the do's and don't around first time use which was very informative and helpful.

records.title: Hot tub great / Service poor
records.text: Hot tub was perfect, real good product for the price.Issue was with delivery and poor customer service follow up. Didn't arrive on the time slot and then had to go on the school run, paid for the positioning only to come home and found they'd ripped off all the new decking trim and left before we got back.Then customer service did not want to take any responsibility what so ever. As mentioned great product but be wary of delivery!

records.title: Hot Tub Delivery took an age !
records.text: Hot Tub Delivery took an age !! Ordered on June 6th arrived October 14th Poor communication .. no updates on delivery.. I had to keep emailing “combined shipping” only to be told that it was the viruses fault.. Paid for kerb delivery .. then had to pay the delivery drivers to move it the extra 5ft into the gate . Product really good !!

records.title: Hot Tub took a while due to covid
records.text: Hot Tub took a while due to covid, ordered wifi module (Balboa) but didn't work spent a few calls trying to sort but no joy, sent another one out and i sent the original back (never arrived so I'm told) now have a £250 module that doesn't work so out of pocket. Bad reviews on this module anyway.Ordered charcoal but came black,was told I could return but have to pay delivery cost !, having waited months I accepted it.Hot Tub is great, hope I get the service IF there's a problem , Cant fault the product .....just the module.

records.title: Poor quality jets and filters
records.text: Poor quality jets and filters. 1) Filter had very poorly spaced folds that reduced efficiency, and 2) one jet retaining clip broke during normal use within warranty period and unwilling to replace free of charge because they claimed it was caused by "contact with body and chemical imbalances", i.e. clearly not 'fit for purpose'!Their after sales service could benefit from some improvement.

records.title: Very poor communication
records.text: Very poor communication,  hot tub arrived with a damaged base, their response was its a protection casing which can’t be repaired. For the maintenance kit which was ordered in July now December and made in UK, we have still not received. I understand covid has played a part in the kits delay but 5 months and still no date of when we will receive is very poor.  The hot tub apart for damage is very good, if you can source this hot tub elsewhere I would advise to do so. They have now offered a refund

records.title: Don’t expect too much if it’s faulty!
records.text: The hot tubs from this company are great - really good quality and high specifications for the money.However, if something is faulty, please do not expect too much!  My hot tub was shipped with a faulty Bluetooth unit.  Even though the hot tub was brand new, Combined Shipping would not repair it - the best they would do was send a replacement unit in the post for me to install myself.  The wires on the replacement unit, did not match the wires on the faulty unit, and the job required me to dismantle several large panels from the hot tub.  Their technical support recommended that I open the electrical control panel and start stripping wires and botching together a repair.  I am not an electrician and so consequently (even though I paid for a hot tub with Bluetooth) I am left with no Bluetooth.  So overall I would say they are good value if they work, but if you get a faulty one, or have issues you will quickly wish you’d bought from somewhere else.  I’m now having to pay lawyers fees to sort it all out which quickly eliminates any cost savings I had made by shopping here!

They then charged me for a redelivery. There was no apology for their poor service. I will never deal with this company again. They have no idea about customer service. Avoid in my opinion.

records.title: Warranty not fit for purpose
records.text: Warranty not fit for purpose. If you have any problems or need a part their tech team just say it’s down to chemical damage. a pump should last 7-10 years. The warranty they give is not fit for purpose. When you call to complain they then say you have to log it your self on the site as they don’t enjoy being spoken to in a certain manner. They just then Keep repeating it’s the ph levels it’s chemical damage it bla bla but we can get an engineer out for £150 and £299 for a part you can buy for £230. Every time we’ve had an issue they will not replace a part and just keep saying the same thing. The email back from the advisor also stated This leak is caused by the wet end seal degrading in the pump, this happens when the water has become acidic for a period, unfortunately it doesn’t take much of a drop and for particularly long for this to happen. We would advise replacing the pump, as this is chemical damage unfortunately its not covered by the warranty,So if it doesn't take much more than a drop then it’s been excluded from the warranty knowing this is going to happen.So for a pump that should last 7-10 years and a hot tub that’s been maintained correctly. The pump is 28 days from the end of the 2 year warranty but apparently from the videos sent it’s the chemical levels. Why sell hot tubs if you know not more than a drop could affect the pump! The pump is also leaking and humming. So the pump and your warranty are both not fit for purpose. Awful company and customer service has been dreadful.

description:

Our philosophy is simple; we work for you, our customers, not our suppliers.

Why? because our customers pay our wages not our suppliers. Therefore we are here for you. We want you to enjoy your customer experience with us so you will return to us with confidence.

The best of both worlds

Low price and high quality.

High standards of service and support, backed by 40 years of relevant experience.

records.text: The product is great, well planned and well cross referenced. The mind maps are an excellent tool which give you an overview of the topic with drill down facility to the detailed solutions. A very time saving tool among the many others in the product.

records.title: Taxwise claims department
records.text: We have worked with Taxwise for many years and their help and assistance have been much appreciated. This year I have received specific valuable help on a claim from Anne Grundy and the client  and I appreciated this a lot.very happy to recommend the company

records.title: Helen knowledgeable about how iCroner…
records.text: Helen knowledgeable about how iCroner works, we couldn't have managed to optimally use the site without her knowledge and advice.

records.title: The actual training session was good
records.text: The actual training session was good - and Helen was very knowledgeable. The actual screen set up was very clear, and Helen kept checking that we understood. The only issue was having to view as online training ( because of COVID19) and the technical issues that gave us - my screen kept dropping out for example - this may have been as a result of the internet ( everyone using it) as oppsosed to anything to do with Croner I.

records.title: Very good presentation
records.text: Very good presentation and introduction to the product. Helen the presenter, was very knowledgeable and presented well

records.title: Croner-i Library Demonstration
records.text: Thanks Helen Marshall for your demonstration on the Croner-i Library. The training session was very helpful and everything was well explained. Helen was very nice and friendly!Thanks

records.title: Croner i library training
records.text: I am new to croner i and found this useful to know that there are lots of material in the library that will be useful to my role in PAYE.

records.title: Informative Training Session
records.text: Training led by Helen was very informative. The wealth of resources available and best use of these was made evident.

records.title: Problems accessing Croner-i have been resolved.
records.text: I had problems accessing my account on Croner-i. This has now been rectified.

records.title: Easy and fast communications
records.text: Easy and fast communications, great platofrm to use with lots of helpful info!

records.title: i am new to this service but impressed…
records.text: i am new to this service but impressed by the speed of delivery of latest tax and other related news.

records.title: excellent presentation by Helen
records.text: excellent presentation by Helen I wish all presentations where done like this as it was informative and done in a friendly and professional manner

records.title: For the past 10 years or so I have used…
records.text: For the past 10 years or so I have used Cronor-I's accountancy continuining professional development courses.I generally found them very helpful both in the structure and technical content as well as facilitating cross referencing to other relevant publications.The only aspect which I have sometimes found less user-friendly is the technology,such as navigating from the learning module to the related quiz and this is sometimes quite " clunky".

records.title: In a short time
records.text: In a short time, I was provided with a good overview of the tool, with use of relevant examples.

records.title: I have recently started using the…
records.text: I have recently started using the Croner suite of reference materials and found them to be comprehensive, easy to navigate and accessible in their language. The introductory webinar was a good starting point and clearly delivered.

records.title: Great product. Shady sales practices.
records.text: I can't fault the quality or scope of material on Croner-i. You can find pretty much anything general material you need in practice. This includes case law, worked examples, a useful disclosure checking tool, summaries of HMRC manuals and so on. I've no doubt this is a good product.However. As a micro-practice I found the pricing frustrating and in all honesty I did not get enough value from the product. Of more concern was the automatic renewal. I took care in the initial negotiation to signup for an annual contract. What was buried in small print was that it auto-renews and 3 months written notice of cancellation must be given. This is an unfair contract term and if I hadn't known better I would have paid it.It's a pity because I would probably have renewed anyway were it not for this, but like most people my reaction to unfair business practice is to take my custom elsewhere.

records.title: Although a swift response each time
records.text: Although a swift response each time, in checking the proofs there were the same errors made on a number of occasions.

records.title: Be careful of getting into a horrible contract
records.text: On the whole, good at the actual service they provide, however their contracts are brutal bordering on predatory, to cancel, you need to write prior to 3 months of the end of your contract or they sign you up for another 3-5 years with a 7% increase. Crazy!

records.title: Been using Corner Taxwise for a few…
records.text: Been using Corner Taxwise for a few year, they have been quite good with assisting personal tax and corporation tax. However, their VAT department has been terrible. Spoke to a few of the VAT advisors, they all seem to be very short temper and rude.  make me feel like an idiot just because I asked them for help.  if people know everything, they would've out of job.

records.title: Warning
records.text: Warning: Avoid Croner I – A Cautionary TaleI strongly advise against entering into any agreements with Croner I. Our experience has been frustrating, marked by aggressive sales tactics and misleading promises. The sales team promised any-time cancellation and even offered “free months,” but these claims proved false. They contacted us using untraceable mobile numbers and WhatsApp, leaving no record of conversations.After signing, we found ourselves locked into a five-year contract. When we tried to cancel just two weeks later, we were told the cancellation team would contact us, but Jennifer from the team was unhelpful and seemed uninterested in assisting us. Instead, we were hit with demands to pay the full five-year amount. Since then, we’ve been bombarded with calls and emails demanding payment.It seems their focus is more on relentless sales pressure than on providing effective service I recommend exploring other options, as the templates provided are not helpful or efficient for the intended purpose. They may not meet the necessary requirements or provide the needed clarity to effectively address the task. I will share my experience in all care agency groups to warn others never to engage with Croner I. There are numerous complaints about similar issues, and I believe this company should be scrutinized more closely.Please take this as a warning if you value your business and peace of mind.

records.title: Worst company to deal with
records.text: Worst company to deal with! Appalling customer service! Quoted one price and put different price on the agreement! Now saying you signed it, it's a binding contract despite showing the actual quotation! It's a nightmare company to deal with! Can't even speak to my account manager nor does he respond any email!Beware! Beware!! Beware!!! Keep safe distance from this scam company!

records.title: Read the contract carefully
records.text: Read the contract carefully, automatically renews after initial term. They do not remind you that it is up for renewalBetter companies out there

records.title: Avoid
records.text: Avoid.  Very pushy up front, tell you all sorts of rubbish about all the things they provide and how often it gets updated with content etc, then try to up sell you via sales pitches disguised as "reviews" then refuse to engage with you when you have a complaint about anything.

records.title: Update
records.text: Update: if you get a reply from a Lauren trying to "help" RUN!!!More and more lies, total waste of time and ignored the feedback of the rude manager.Gladly tried to tell me i had insufficent funds in my account which is why they collected 3 months payments in one go when i can 100% show bank statements batting that out that ball park. Swindlers and liars.

records.title: The company is not strong on paperwork…
records.text: The company's weak on paperwork and client engagement for me.  I was insured with Croner Taxwise for 10 years and I only received one letter -- one recently received stating  that they were discontinuing my policy.  I never made a claim -- thank goodness.  They made no recommendations where I should go next.For me... I feel they are not overly helpful.

records.title: This company is unethical and…
records.text: This company is unethical and dishonest, watch your Bank accounts as this company will continue to take  direct debit from your bank with no authority and will take them over a year to refund. Very poor customer services and very inefficient process for dealing with problem. Their contract is very unfair and treat customers very bad. Their sales tactic is very dishonest,  most content for taxation is out of date and badly written. Stay away from this company.
