records.title: Another Isle of Man Import
records.text: Another Isle of Man Import.  I was also told my transfer would be straight forward and done in a few days. 6 or 7 weeks later with constant promises from the dealer I gave up waiting and went with My Car Import. Truly impressed with the service with my car registered within a few weeks (would have been a lot quicker if I hadn't forgotten to post the certificate to them). Once completed the tax and transfer of the MOT from the dealer was transferred to my new registration.  They even managed to transfer it to the previous UK registration number which makes the history of the car cleaner. I can't fault the service,  so a big thanks from me!

records.title: Thank you My Car Import
records.text: I don't usually post reviews but in this instance it may help someone else avoid the stressful experience of trying to manage their own car import process.In desperation I turned to Google for a solution. Yes I was anxious about contracting a company I knew nothing about.....Thank goodness I did! Ryan and James certainly came to my rescue and sorted my car out in a professional and friendly supportive manner. I truly wish I had gone this route in the very beginning.A very speedy turn aroundThank you!

records.title: Their efficiency is not UK style
records.text: I don’t always write reviews on social media, but the service from My Car Import(MCI) was excellent, I can’t thank them enough. MCI helped to bring my Toyota Alphard from Japan to UK. The whole process was definitely stress-free and smooth. Since I didn’t have experience of importing car to UK, I was worried at the beginning and asked lots of questions. Thankfully, MCI addressed all my concerns promptly and patiently. (I am amazed by their efficiency which is not typical “UK style”, you know:p)MCI always informed me any updates of my car and what would be the next step. All the paperwork and registration to DVLA was quick and smooth. Painless!!!One more thing, they even recommended me a very professional bidding agent. Thanks Jack recommended Brendan for me. He helped me to find my car in Japan in a good price. I like my car and it is already perfect to me. Thanks the whole team of MCI! Especially, Jack, Steph, Will, Steven, Chloe. I would definitely recommend MCI!

records.title: First class service from beginning to…
records.text: First class service from beginning to end.Very easy initial registration, followed up by emails and phone calls as requested. All completed in a few short weeks and they even supplied a pair of age-related style numberplate.Would certainly use again and will definitely recommend.

records.title: Great help to a first time importer
records.text: The website is very clear, the quotation is very detailed, the online system for submitting the paperwork is very straightforward and communication throughout the process is excellent.  I’d never imported a car before (in this case from Guernsey) so was pleased to find these guys. They did all they  promised and there expectation of the DVLA timescales was spot on.

records.title: Car importers experts
records.text: They took care of everything for us. They were true to their quote and were flexible enough when we changed our mind on collection. I can not recommend their total service enough. The staff were friendly and always answered any question I had promptly.

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: Fantastic service. My case was a bit complicated and I was not confident I would ever be able to register my foreign car in the UK. I attempted to do it by myself in the past, but these attempts were never successful. Contacting My Car Import was a bit of a ‘last chance’ situation, but they resolved the whole thing in only a few weeks! Everything went very smoothly and the communication was always very clear, I was kept updated at every step of the process. My car was picked up and dropped off at my doorstep, and I didn’t have to worry a minute about it.My only regret is not to have contacted them sooner!

records.title: Moving headaches
records.text: They say moving is one of the most stressful experiences. The process of registering cars on top of moving house just adds to the stress levels. We used My Car Import to assist. Their website keeps you up to date on what you need to do and application status - whilst being able to get decisions from DVLA far quicker than individuals. Personally think their service is worth the fee in terms of one less headache for movers as well as a faster outcome. Would recommend.

records.title: Reimportaion of vehicle to UK.
records.text: From start to finish the process with my car import was straight forward. I would recommend the service and company if anyone is in need of an agent to reimport: a previously registered car back into the UK. You get what you pay for. Thanks to the team for getting me back on the road in a timely and swiftly manner. Number plates arrived within 48 hours and the new V5 arrived in a timely manner also.

records.title: I couldn’t recommend them more highly
records.text: I couldn’t recommend them more highly. Simple, trouble free, great communication, speedy and professional.

records.title: Importing car
records.text: When started the import procedureI registered with my car import I received an email with a link to a portalWas put off a bit as I am not computer savvy, but found the portal really easy to use 👍, you can track the progress via the portal, all goodReally quick and easy

records.title: My car from the Isle Of Man
records.text: I recently imported a car from the Isle Of Man, I was told this should be easy and straightforward, it took about ten weeks to get the car finally on the UK roads. I can't really blame "My Car Import" for the delay as I needed a dating certificate from Honda - these were the people who really should be looking at "getting their act together" as they were the ones that made me wait.Overall, the experience was OK I can't say 'pleasant' as it never is spending a big wad of money but they did get the job done. I was informed of my new registration number on Wednesday lunchtime and the plates came on Thursday morning - so I WAS impressed that this part of the process was done so quickly.I think I should have been aware of hidden costs, as I had to pay extra for the letter from Honda.Would I use them again ? - Yes, but knowing I might have to wait. And I should add they were always easy and pleasant to speak too.

records.title: I have been importing cars for over a decade
records.text: I have been importing cars for over a decade now, but never wanted to touch one that involved the IVA route (under 10yrs old) due to the extra hoops to get it registered. I reached out to MyCarImport to help with this side but unfortunately there was a few small issues along the way. The main was the IVA service that was offered at being two weeks actually took four weeks, normally I would accept this but I was under time pressure to get the IVA done and when I phoned and booked I had made this clear I wanted it to be done as quick as possible. The two weeks sounded perfect (currently 20days for the public to do a booking)Once the IVA test was eventually booked the process was quick though, the actual day of testing was good, clean facilities and welcoming staff. Little over a hour and my car had been passed and was ready for registering. The next issue was a bit of miscommunication which lead to a few emails back and forth, but again MyCarImports dealt professionally with it and a good outcome was had. I was offered by MyCarImports to register my car as a goodwill gesture for the delay in the IVA test. Now iv registered lots of cars so i know the process well, but MyCarImports offer fast track on this process. Taking it from three weeks (for me) to under 10 days with them. I was happy to have this done and thought it was a very nice gesture from a large company to do this.They delivered on this promise and in 7 days time i had my new plates and car registered, three days later the V5 arrived all correct.Even with some of the issues I entailed I would still look at using MyCarImport to do my future IVA tests and this will now allow me to import more newer cars into the UK. Thank you again for the registering the G350D.

records.title: Good but not best
records.text: Well informed procedure with transparent pricing.  But MyCarImport put their company logo in my car plate without my consent.  My car plate is not supposed to  promoting for anyone whatsoever.

records.title: Good experience
records.text: Good experience. Slightly overpriced since I did most of the research and paperwork, up until the DVLA registration. Although the team was very helpful, everything was done quick and smoothly, and I got a small discount. I just wish I had done everything with them from the beginning to make the most out of my Monet.

records.title: Overall it was a great experience…
records.text: Overall it was a great experience although there were a few times where I had to chase for updates up until the point of collection of the car. Happy that it all worked out in the end and the driver was great as he sent me a video and text me nearly every day with progress.

records.title: Generally a really good service
records.text: Generally a really good service and would recommend for importing a car from the other side of the world.Always helpful and timely responses (maybe a bit more on progress details).My only real disappointment is the charge for the delayed transit (which I understand but could have been absorbed?) and linked to this the time taken was longer than expected (noting our household goods left later and arrived earlier). Overall positive. Thank you

records.title: MyCarImport remote assistance with import
records.text: MCI helped remotely with the import of a Russian registered used car into the UK (HMRC/DVLA). The car was already in the UK.MCI was helpful, quick and responsive, making the process relatively smooth and understandable.Only bump was the valuation of the car for import tax purposes (Transfer of Residence was not an option in this case). MCI invoiced the tax based on the agreed valuation suggesting the tax had been assessed and the valuation accepted by HMRC, which was not the case. This was eventually put right with further input.All in all a good experience. Would use again.

records.title: Smooth process and communicative
records.text: Great experience, the whole process took 3 months. Staff communicated to us regularly by e-mail  throughout, office at Derby were friendly and professional when we picked up the car. Their online portal is easy to use and helpful at tracking the import process and any documentation requirements. We had the speedometer changed, there was no other issues with the car. We picked it up in great condition.The only reason I am not rating 5 stars is that the HK end at drop off was a bit chaotic. The place was hard to find and their HK partner did not seem to be expecting us.

records.title: Great, easy, efficient and cost effective
records.text: The process was easy and efficient. Dropping the vehicle off and using the portal to provide the necessary details was problem free and the cost was surprisingly reasonable. My only criticism would be that once back in the UK the updates weren't as frequent and required me to check the portal rather than being prompted for actions, which were often weeks apart from each other. Nonetheless, they were responsive and friendly. I would recommend using My Car Import for your vehicle import needs

records.title: Having been out of the UK for 16 years…
records.text: Having been out of the UK for 16 years and not being up to date with various import and general vehicle licensing regulations, it was a boon to find a firm that dealt with these issues. My vehicle was 8 years old and initially I had doubts about value for money, however, I decided to stick with my Toyota and think it will be cost effective in the medium term.Thanks to the team at My Car Import!

records.title: A very efficient and fast process
records.text: A very efficient and fast process. Excellent communication with both the garage in Germany and me. The conversion was clearly communicated via video and I would definitely use again. However the vehicle was registered as incorrect taxation class with dvla so 1 star off

records.title: Importing a car from Holland.
records.text: My overall experience with this company was very good. Unfortunately there was a delay because the DVLA wanted to physically inspect my car. This delay could of course not be contributed to my car import. The rest of the procedure took place efficiently and in reasonable time. They arranged for the payment of duties, organised the registration document and provided me with period correct number plates that seem of very decent quality. I would certainly use the same company again

records.title: A good service
records.text: A good service . A bit slow to get started a some my calls didn’t get returned early on in the process  , but it all comes together in the end . A big thanks to Emma Aplin who was right on the ball and always got back to you and dealt with any issues right away . So if you use this service always “ask Emma.”.

records.title: Worth considering exporting your loved car to the UK
records.text: If you are relocating from Hong Kong to the UK, I would highly recommend to consider bringing your cars with you through My Car Import.  Used cars in the UK have crazy prices....My Car Import has partner companies which take your car to the port, you can choose paying either HKD or GBP. They have a portal which is easy to follow where you are in terms of the process.I chose to pay more to get my car earlier (5 weeks journey from HK to the UK).Although it took a couple of weeks longer than initially estimated, we are so happy to keep our favourite car (Toyota PRADO).Just a note - I suggest to check car insurances for your car in the UK in case your car isn't common ones here as we are now paying car insurance more than double for our PRADO as it's not a standard model in the UK...Anyway - My Car Import gives you clear estimate and they are very reachable for any queries you might have!Good luck!

records.title: Review of service
records.text: I was very happy with the service given. There were delays in yhe process but I believe this relates to DVLA. One improvement I would make would be for the speed dials changed from kmph to mph.Overall I was happy with the service, would recommend others to use this service. Thank you for everyone's help with.

records.title: I chose mycarimport to help transport…
records.text: I chose mycarimport to help transport and register a classic car from the Netherlands. Overall a good experience. The online portal is easier to use and, having had experience with the DVLA myself, I can confirm the registration lead times quoted are accurate and superior to dealing with the DVLA as a private individual. There was quite a delay in getting to the UK, with the date being changed several times. After the fourth delay, mycarimport agreed to send out a single-car transporter to pick the vehicle up after which the matter was resolved within a week. The DVLA also wanted to inspect the vehicle before registration, which further delayed things. But that wasn't anything to do with mci really.Overall a good level of communication and service. I'd use them again, perhaps not for transportation but certainly for speeding up registration process and removing any concerns when filling out the V55/5.

records.title: Great on site service
records.text: On the day of the visit everything went very smoothly and after care was good during the process although the responses via email were a little slow at times.

records.title: Simple to import
records.text: Just one phone call to get the ball rolling and then 99% conducted electronically by email or messaging.It really couldn’t have been easier and took all the worry and stress out of what could’ve been a journey through a minefield of forms and regulations.Of course you can do all this yourself if you know the system, but if you only import one vehicle in a lifetime this has definitely been worth the money involved.Start to finish took 2 1/2 months, but that was compounded by Christmas and New Year delays and a postal strike to boot.Expenses are clearly defined at the start before there is any commitment.It would be nice to have a timeline guideline as well if this were possible.If I were to import another vehicle, would I use them again, definitely. Would I be tempted to try it myself definitely not!On my one visit to the premises to have the vehicle MOT, and converted, the staff could not have been friendlier or more helpful, and there was a comfortable lounge to rest in, which also accommodated my two small dogs! I was surprised and amazed at the sheer size, scope and professionalism of the business as a whole, and I would highly recommend it!

records.title: Car imported from Hong Kong - OK
records.text: Car imported from Hong Kong, total expenses £4921.68 for a RORO shipment, and it took 5 months before I can pick my ride up from their depot. The car is intact and felt good when I did pick her up. Feedback on their services:1. they do have a portal to keep everything in track2. however, if you do need some extra information from them, about 50% of my call when to the reception, they always say they will make note of your call and have people call me back, which never happen. (i might just call them later on or another day)3. if you manage to get the real office people to pick up your call, they do did they job pretty good.4. they did remove the rare light cover to install the fog light, but some little dust/leaf remain inside the cover, nothing serious

records.title: Overall services are satisfied
records.text: Overall services are satisfied especially the Hong Kong local agent Terry & his team are very helpful. Chloe at my car import also very kind. Only two things I am unexpected and a little disappointment as below:1) The red sea surcharge at GBP660- was required in the mid of shipping journey which may be too much.2) Some scratches found beneath the front bumper while collecting the car on 2 Aug and still no updated reply.

records.title: Had a bit of an issue but now resolved by MCI - thank you. My car imports collected my HD Trike on…
records.text: My car imports collected my HD Trike on Nov 14 - 2022 and finally delivered it to me today. Arrived in the UK Feb 2nd and unfortunately MCI missed two inspection appointments - was finally cleared for registration after 4 months in their depot. Delivered today with a dead battery, covered in dust, and exhaust pipes full of debris. Was not a very happy customer. I approached MCI for a solution to return to me an operating vehicle and they have responded positively to get me on the road so I am happy to say top marks for responding positively.

records.title: Additional charges
records.text: I believe it would be better if the invoice can list out more detail about the services, including all the services and its charges that will be handled and incurred by the partner-company in Hong Kong.  Besides, the extra cost to facilitate the examination and tests in the UK should be told in advance to all the customers who would like to put their belongings inside the car, particularly in the back seats.

records.title: Brilliant company but they failed to deliver on time
records.text: Brilliant company with excellent and incredibly friendly and professional costumer service. However I was disappointed with their inability to deliver on time. I will try to elaborate. I specifically chose them because the excellent reviews they had and because they ensure me by phone that there was plenty of time to have the car registered by Christmas (28 working days to be precise, not inclusing Sat), when I really needed it done. The person I talked to said that while I applied for the UK MOT, they were going to make the costums declaration and valutation to be ahead of time and place the registration with the dvla by the time the MOT was issued. To my surprise, when I provided the MOT 1 week later they hadn't started the process. Thankfully there was still plenty of time, they assured me.Unfortunately, the both the UK borders bit and the dvla took slightly longer than anticipated, and on Monday before Christmas and only after calling them I learned that the regitration request for my car had been rejected, and it wasn't clear why. Hence, they had to resubmit my case. The dvla finally approved it after Christmas, and because I had no car and there were rail strikes, it was incredibly inconvinient to say the least.On the other hand, they were excellent in every other aspect. I even got the license plates the day after they hear from the dvla. And for that and the really good team they have I've decided to give them 3 stars. I really hope if import my car reads this comment, they could take my complaint in a constructive matter to improve their service. I know they have the capacity to do so and I believe they can deliver.

records.title: Smooth process in the beginning but…
records.text: Smooth process in the beginning but many bumps from the middle till the end

records.title: OK but could have been better
records.text: Difficult one this. On the one hand everything was ultimately delivered as promised and that is the most important thing. But communication could have been so much better. At one point I was asked about shipping details when they themselves were doing the shipping! Also they are quick to ask for payment, not so quick to let you know what was happening. Their portal promises much but again, a key date - sending details to the DVLA was put on the portal but i received no automated mail to tell me so. It was only after me chasing and then a mail several days later from them telling me the portal had been updated with the new status. Would I use them again? Yes, possibly. There were no huge hiccups. Worth looking at some other agents though, and be prepared for a bit of a battle on the communication front.

records.title: Disappointed on sudden raised for £350 in the middle time during vehicle transportation
records.text: Disappointed on raising for £350 during the transportation, it was not acceptable for we have agreed the amount beforehand

records.title: Tbh the website and portal were very…
records.text: Tbh the website and portal were very good for getting information but I’ve just imported a landcruiser from South Africa and can’t give better than 2 stars!Had to phone several times to push on loading in SA (Joburg) as local agents kept saying the vehicle was too big even though i’d paid for shipping at start of process. Then when vehicle arrived in UK i had to push to get MOT’d which they say was an oversight. Had to get work carried out to pass MOT which they did (windscreen washer pump and new pipework to jets) £375 and have discovered when driving home they don’t work! 2 rear lens covers for rear brake lights again £391. Overall very dissapointed in what should have been and was stated as a very easy process. My advice would be to get any work carried out locally before landing in UK unless you have very deep pockets!!!

records.title: poor communication and delays
records.text: I unfortunately cannot give My Car Import a good rating due to firstly, the huge delay I experienced with the MOT and registration process.  I was initially informed that the whole process from collection in South Africa to delivery in the UK would be 12-15 weeks.  There were delays in shipping which MCI cannot be faulted for.  However, instead of the promised 4 weeks' timeframe (following arrival in the UK) for the MOT and registration, it took 8 weeks for my car to be processed and finally delivered to me.  I expected there to be some adjustments which would be required in order to align my vehicle to the UK standards.  However, I didn’t think that the work required (a catalytic converter fitted) would be something that would not be able to fixed in a timeous manner.  This delay had a huge impact on my financial and mental wellbeing, given that I required my vehicle for work purposes.  The second (and worse) frustration for me was the lack of timeous communication. My emails asking for updates went unanswered and when I did get feedback it was vague.  I understand the company was going through some staffing challenges at the time and hope that this has now been sorted.  The rest of the service I received from MCI was great and I was appreciative of Gavin and Jack stepping in to assist when things were going nowhere. I expect that my experience was perhaps bad luck and/or timing but nevertheless it had a huge negative impact on me that I feel it important to provide this feedback.

records.title: After over two months, MOT and a lot more
records.text: They did get my car through MOT, they also returned my car to me with masking tape on it from reinstalling the windshield after the seal was redone, dirty, cigerette ashes everywhere, and with several computer faults.  They failed to communicate that the head ligjts purchased to replace mine where out of spec for the car, and caused the main computer fault.  They barely responded to my request for updates, seeing that they had my car from 7 December 23 to 12 February 24.  Then the owner or director got angry with me when I called them on the carpet.  SHYSTERS at best, buyer beware is the inly thing I can say.

records.title: Hi I'm a bit disgruntled
records.text: Hi I'm a bit unhappy. Firstly they did not explain to me that the 2x Harley Davidsons will not be crated as advertised. They simply strapped them over the width of a large container. It was not clear in our communications that there would have been additional cost to crate. One was damaged at the back and had to be repaired at my cost. Delivery took 3 months longer than expected. I also paid for replacement batteries and behold it arrived with my original flat battery. My one Harley, a Dyna Streetbob is a 1585cc bike. It has been registered as a 1202cc. So far they have failed to correct it. My largest complaint is cost. There is no upfront transparency of cost. It ends up being a discovery journey as SA distances them from UK MyCarImports.However I have received my bikes and MyCarImport has been responding to my questions. Cannot fault them on that.

records.title: Follow up to MOT and a lot more
records.text: Following my first 2 star review, I was contacted by Will Smith of MCI and while he was polite and informed me that the reason for my issues with them has been resolved, I am still trying to get my car back to 100%.  While I appreciate them fixing their issue, it does not fix mine, it does not change the fact that the initial work on my car was done in a  half-ass (real-term) way, took weeks longer that initial promised and upon initial return, it was obvious that they missed the mark.  At the end of the day, Will, thanks for reaching back but I cannot with good conscious give MCI anymore consideration other than to to say, maybe I should get a partial refund for the poor work that was done, for the headache the poor work caused, for the extended time my car was in your workshop and for the lack of communication regarding my car, except for the emails with invoices, which you are very good at sending out.

records.title: Communication Issue
records.text: Why there is no email on the platform? And why no one takes the phone?

records.title: Customer Service
records.text: After trying to articulate and write a review of the experience with My Car Import, I struggled as much as they did with my service. Exporting my vehicle and trailer from Dubai to UK, took six months to the day and significantly more money and stress than I ever imagined. I am still unable to nail down exactly what the problem was, but feel it was a plethora of small inexcusable mistakes rapped up in very poor customer service/management. The customer dash board is very poor, unclear and only as good as the information being input by My Car Import in the first place, which is hit and miss at best. I acknowledge that transporting and importing is a challenging process, but this should be simple day to day operations for My Car Import. It is your choice to engage with My Car Import if needing to transport you vehicle from anywhere in the world, but ensure you are totally clear with the process and service you are expecting with them before you proceed.

records.title: The questions you need to ask…
records.text: This company did exactly what it said it would do and imported my car from Australia. However, I made a rookie mistake when seeking a quote. I asked how long the car would take to arrive in the UK when I should have asked, how long will it sit in their UK workshop before my car is ready for collection. Had I have known this was just days short of two months for a fog light, mot and registration I would have either not bothered importing a car I needed to wait nearly 6 months for in total or gone elsewhere.

records.title: Dissapointing Experience
records.text: Its been over a month since the day that car arrived in UK but still they haven't completed the speedometer convertion and rear foglight installation. I did booking, document submission and payments in well advance. Very inefficient service..do not select this service if you value your time..because they don't.

My car has been with them at the UK depot for nearly 4 weeks now and hasn’t even reached the “test” stage. They’re full of empty promises but nothing actually happens. It’s been nearly 5 months overall since my car was collected for exportation from Australia to the UK. The process was not easy as promised. I’m sure there are other companies who can do a much better job. Avoid!

description:
Skypax is a premium international package forwarding service shipping globally from the UK. Our thousands of satisfied customers love our high quality service and personal customer support. We take the hassle out of shopping UK stores from abroad.


Get your unique UK street address immediately when you sign up, and use it as often as you like to receive parcels. Ship when you choose and track the package to your door.


Or use our personal shopping service and our concierge team will purchase items on your behalf. We can even pick up items in-store in London.

Sometimes I had to send emails so as to get updates about my package. But again I must commend their customer support team because they responded to emails and acted accordingly. This was my personal experience with SKYPAX thus the 4/5 rating.

records.title: Everything was awesome and done…
records.text: Everything was awesome and done quickly! One little issue was that there was nothing clearly telling me I had to separately release the item for shipment after SkyPax obtained!I would definitely use them again!!!

records.title: Easy to manage packages
records.text: Easy to manage packages, and a great service for getting things to Australia. Just a little slow booking on packages once they've been delivered. But otherwise, very happy.

records.title: I can't find any reciept for the payment
records.text: There is no login on the main page, you must first choose join now and then go to menu from there. After payment, I got no reciept on email and there is no place to find package history. I find these things very strange for a big company like this. Shipping is a bit above average, but it worked out well :)

records.title: Very good service all around, highly recommended
records.text: Very good service all around,  a perfect 5 star service if only items received can processed a bit faster than currently the case.

records.title: Skybox is always very reliable but expensive
records.text: Skybox is always very reliable. but the freight charges are so high they make you think twice about using the service.

records.title: Very good, could be quicker
records.text: Took nearly a week after package arrived for it to be in Skypax system for re-shipment. After that, perfect experience!

records.title: A bit expensive per shipment but good…
records.text: A bit expensive per shipment but good service and given no ongoing fees its great if you ship rarely.

records.title: Always good
records.text: Always good service ,tried you many times it works , when companies don’t ship to Malta SKYPAX does it.

records.title: Package has not show up in my Suite and…
records.text: Package has not show up in my Suite and it's been over 48 hours. The package that was sent to my suite is tracked and it shows it has been deliveredEdit:Package eventually showed up in my Suite.

records.title: Very frustrating company…
records.text: Edit:  since writing this review, Skypax have gotten in contact (over a week to reply) and they reduce their rates to the agreed amount.A very frustrating company to interact with, they performed a 'bate and switch' and they don't respond to emails....  After agreeing with Skypax on details of a package for them to forward to me, I ordered the package.  Skypax then increased the price by more than 2.5x, after I questioned them on this, they stopped responding to my emails.

records.title: Slow to process
records.text: I don't receive a notification from Skypax that an item has been received until 2 to 3 days after it's been received. I use other proxy services and the items are always processed within 24 hours. Also packing can be a lot better considering shipping cost are so high. I've received leather goods in plastic bags.

records.title: Handling was uncomplicated but in my…
records.text: Handling was uncomplicated but in my opinion too slow. Package was delivered Friday at noon. I’m my Warehouse I saw it next Wednesday at noon. It was dispatched with DHL Express on Thursday and then it took another day for shipping and customs. So for fresh beer it‘s an eternity 🤷🏻‍♂️

records.title: Good, but could use a bit of improvement
records.text: While the service was ultimately good, I did have to call a few days after my package had been delivered to your address in order for them to find it and ship it out to me.  I would have expected that I would be contacted when the package arrived.  Otherwise, the service was as expected.

records.title: Glad the package arrived
records.text: Glad the package arrived. It got stuck at customs a long time, and had to pay and additional fee to release it. thought it would never arrive, but it did in the end.Overall happy with skypax services, just this time communication could have been improved

records.title: Easy to use but still awaiting my…
records.text: Easy to use but still awaiting my package. My order was dispatched from the UK to the US on May 12th, but I still don't have it as of May 29th, and no tracking update has been available. I would have appreciated a continuous tracking update across shipping services (DHL to USPS, etc.).

records.title: I like that this company exists
records.text: I like that this company exists. I have a lot of trust issues with the internet and so far this has worked ok. I would like more communication about the progress of my parcel. But every time I contact customer support they do reply, after a day or so. And I placed my order in mid November and it seems as though it may not be here till mid Jan. So if you order something give yourself plenty of time.

records.title: So disappointed
records.text: My package is a special edition book and the beautiful packaging is part of the experience. I knew it had to be opened, but was deeply disappointed when I received my book wrapped in a cut piece of cardboard instead of the pretty box, with the tissue and sticker ripped. I will be canceling my Locked Library subscription because the shipping ruins the experience.

records.title: Slow turnaround time
records.text: Skypax are not the cheapest parcel forwarding service available but I still use it as they’re reliable. That said, there has been a noticeable increase in processing time with my last 3 experiences. It takes 2 working days to log each delivery + 2 working days for each handling request + 2 working days for dispatch. That means it often takes well over a week from Skypax receiving the shipment to dispatch - significantly slower than other similar services. If I’m paying a premium, I expect a premium service which is not the case anymore. Skypax really need to improve their turnaround time if they want to hang on to their customers and keep charging higher rates than the rest of the market.

records.title: It was processed good
records.text: It was processed good, and delivered fast. But very expensive. There are no standard shipping options, only premium (fast). I have calculated before chosing this site, and then it was more expensive, when it went for real. Not realy happy, but it was kind of only way to get packages from UK to SLO, so that's how it is.

records.title: The time in which my parcel was…
records.text: The time in which my parcel was delivered to Skypax and when it was actually input in the system for me to see was a bit too lengthy. Also the pricing on the courier from Skypax UK to Seychelles leaves a lot to be desired on as it was over 4 times the amount i normally for a parcel of that size directly from UK.

records.title: Shipping is very expensive
records.text: Shipping is very expensive. Tried this site based on recommendations from a friend. Was not aware that shipping costs to USA would be that high. Package came within 2 weeks. Product was in good condition.

records.title: Great Service but INSANE cost
records.text: Paid £12 to sign up, then bought 3 cremes (150g package, worth a total of £25!!!), and paid Skypax another £41to SHIP it to the Netherlands and now being charged another €24.66 import taxes with PostNL. So I paid £73 to ship the 3 cremes worth less than £25... There is cheaper services out there, as well as cheaper flights to go shopping in the UK myself....

records.title: Excellent service but pricey
records.text: Excellent service and items packaged and delivered very quickly. An option to nominate Royal Mail would be appreciated: sometimes speed isn't the most important factor and spending twice the value of the goods for transport means this service will be used as a last resort.

records.title: Skypax packs well for a price
records.text: Skypax delivers what they promise.  However, you should know, in advance, you will pay for ever action you request.

records.title: Skypax UK vs. skypax US
records.text: I have used both skypax UK and skypax US for several times now to ship clothes to Hungary.About skypax UK:They provide excellent service, definitely deserve 5/5 stars. By shipping with Royal Mail I usually pay 21gbp which is about 25,5$ and my parcels always arrive within 1,5-2 weeks These parcels are always light, containing only a dress or some blouses and I find the pricing reasonable. The parcels arrive in light plastic bags.About skypax US:I'm really not satisfied with skypax US for various reasons, however I yet to find a better parcel forwarder service in the US.Their cheapest shipping option is Globetrack, which also includes standard liability and that's about the only thing I find positive in their service. To ship clothes that weigh the same as the ones I'd ship from the UK for 25,5$ they charge 40-50$. They always repack the incoming parcels into a large paper box and put some wrapping paper under, resulting in a big package that weighs more than the original incoming package. If some kind of liquid would spill on the package during the transportation, the contents would probably be damaged. I don't understand why there isn't an option to keep the original packaging, or if they really have to open it to check the item's value, then pack it again into a plastic bag.For my most recent parcel I have requested to repack a blouse and make it as small as possible, which cost 5$. Guess how much cheaper the shipping became? By 5$, and I still paid 38,7$ to ship a blouse which weighed less than 500g with the packaging. (just to clarify: at least when they repacked my parcel they also put my blouse into a transparent plastic bag, so that's probably an improvement) Globetrack also takes a really long time to deliver my parcel (about 3 weeks), but I really don't mind.Their other options are DHL, Fedex and UPS, however for these carriers the shipping fee starts around 100$, which is ridiculous.Overall I give skypax US 3/5.

records.title: Rates are getting more expensive
records.text: Rates are getting more expensive. Not sure if it’s worth paying the shipping charges for now

records.title: Good job!
records.text: It went quickly and smoothly but I did not expect that I need to pay additional delivery fee.

records.title: Service is very good
records.text: Service is very good. Postage costs are becoming much more expensive than in previous years, rendering the cost/benefit trade off problematic.

records.title: Overpriced and slow
records.text: Sadly, shipping costs are way too overpriced for a 1.7kg (chargeable weight 2.64kg) package. I paid £40, and it took 3 weeks! I ordered something else from Japan, also using a shipment forwarder, at half that price and it got here in 10 days.

records.title: Takes time and expensive
records.text: Takes time for the parcel to be registered, and takes time to have them dispatched. Shipping is also quite pricey. A lot higher from the initial quote that I had, then had to pay taxes into EU. Overall I didn’t save anything. It ended up to be twice more expensive and longer.

records.title: The parcel took too long to arrive
records.text: The parcel took too long to arrive. It was in receipt for 2 days before it was shipped and didn't get it on time. I will just no longer order from UK. Since Brexit, it doesn't make any sense shopping from UK.

records.title: Not worth it. Save your money
records.text: Sorry, this service although fast the actual costs (as in multiple) was insane. You dont save anything, and are paying more than a premium. The cost of them shipping out is one fee that doesnt include the added duties charges. You are better off ordering direct from the retailer and paying the global ship fees than paying double (almost triple) the costs using skypax. My box inside the packing box was ripped and damaged.

records.title: Photograph of Package for Upsell
records.text: I ordered a record album that Skypax handled for me. The seller shipped the album in a folder style package with little protection. I had no idea that the packaging was so flimsy.  Skypax should provide the package dimensions, weight, and photograph of the package it receives. This way it has an opportunity to sell additional services to further protect packages. Had I seen how the item was shipped, I would have paid Skypax more to help reduce damages during shipping.

records.title: Slow and expensive
records.text: Service time too long. Up to 4-5 workdays from arrival acc. Track & Trace to item was checked in in suite and information was sent. Same long process time to merge different packages into one parcel for disoatch while still charging 5 GBP per unit for merging. Shipping to EU / DK with UPS on expensive side too.

records.title: Below average service
records.text: The shipping rate was pretty expensive for the size of the package.  It was not packed well for the international journey it was doing, resulted in the metal tin of the collectors edition that i purchased being badly dented and damaged.  Part of it was loose in the box and there was no protective packaging apart from one peice of solid cardboard.

records.title: Takes long to process
records.text: Takes long to process, limited options for freight. DHL seems to be prioritized but they really sucks in Mauritius. My package arrived in Mauritius on 25th March and i got delivery on 3rd April.

records.title: Go elsewhere…
records.text: I ordered something that in my country is regarded as prescribed medicine. So I used skypax to reship to me using as I hoped a more stealthy approach. Skypax sent the package to me labeled rather than health supplements as agreed they put the actual name of the product. Somehow it made it through but I needed up paying the skypax handling fees, DHL £40 charge and a customs charge of £23 on arrival. So I payed over half the price of the actual product to skypax… Go elsewhere…

records.title: Extremely overpriced
records.text: Paying 12 GBP to just create an account is quite mad. They also take a 30 GBP fee for an order, which I guess yea they need to earn from this somehow but I don't get the signup fee.Overall my package which is worth like 70 GBP came up to over 200 GBP (also counting in UPS shipment and customs).Would probably just mail a package to a friend in the UK and have them mail it to you themselves.
